AI.tldr: DCCD是一种两阶段无训练推理方法，通过先生成无约束草稿再进行约束解码，将语义规划与结构强制分离，显著提升结构化输出的准确性和参数效率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成可执行输出时，单个语法错误就可能导致输出不可用。传统约束解码通过掩码和重归一化逐token强制有效性，但当模型对有效延续分配低概率时，会扭曲生成过程，导致局部有效但语义错误的轨迹。
AI.method: 提出Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding (DCCD)，一种简单的两阶段无训练推理过程：首先生成无约束草稿，然后基于该草稿应用约束解码以保证有效性。通过KL投影视角分析DCCD，显示草稿条件化增加了可行质量并减少了硬约束引起的累积"投影税"，可选择最佳K个草稿选择。
AI.result: 在结构化推理基准测试中，DCCD将严格结构化准确率比标准约束解码提升高达24个百分点（例如在GSM8K上，1B模型从15.2%提升到39.0%），使较小模型对能够匹配或超越更大的约束基线，显著提高参数效率。
AI.conclusion: DCCD通过将语义规划与结构强制分离，有效解决了传统约束解码在模型对有效延续分配低概率时的问题，显著提升了结构化生成的准确性和效率，为语言模型生成结构化输出提供了更优的解决方案。

title: BeamPERL: Parameter-Efficient RL with Verifiable Rewards Specializes Compact LLMs for Structured Beam Mechanics Reasoning
summary: Can reinforcement learning with hard, verifiable rewards teach a compact language model to reason about physics, or does it primarily learn to pattern-match toward correct answers? We study this question by training a 1.5B-parameter reasoning model on beam statics, a classic engineering problem, using parameter-efficient RLVR with binary correctness rewards from symbolic solvers, without teacher-generated reasoning traces. The best BeamPERL checkpoint achieves a 66.7% improvement in Pass@1 over the base model. However, the learned competence is anisotropic: the model generalizes compositionally (more loads) but fails under topological shifts (moved supports) that require the same equilibrium equations. Intermediate checkpoints yield the strongest reasoning, while continued optimization degrades robustness while maintaining reward. These findings reveal a key limitation of outcome-level alignment: reinforcement learning with exact physics rewards induces procedural solution templates rather than internalization of governing equations. The precision of the reward signal - even when analytically exact - does not by itself guarantee transferable physical reasoning. Our results suggest that verifiable rewards may need to be paired with structured reasoning scaffolding to move beyond template matching toward robust scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了强化学习能否让小型语言模型真正理解物理推理，还是仅仅学习模式匹配。通过在梁静力学问题上训练1.5B参数模型，使用精确的二元奖励信号，发现模型获得了66.7%的性能提升，但学习到的能力是各向异性的：能组合泛化但无法应对拓扑变化，表明强化学习主要诱导了程序化解决方案模板而非真正的物理方程理解。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究强化学习能否让紧凑的语言模型真正学会物理推理，还是仅仅学习模式匹配正确答案。具体关注使用硬性、可验证的奖励信号（来自符号求解器的二元正确性奖励）能否教会模型物理推理，而不依赖教师生成的推理轨迹。
AI.method: 方法是在梁静力学（经典工程问题）上训练1.5B参数推理模型，使用参数高效的RLVR（强化学习与可验证奖励）方法，仅依赖符号求解器提供的二元正确性奖励，不使用教师生成的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 最佳BeamPERL检查点在Pass@1指标上相比基础模型提升了66.7%。但学习到的能力是各向异性的：模型能组合泛化（更多载荷），但在需要相同平衡方程的拓扑变化（移动支撑）下失败。中间检查点产生最强的推理能力，而持续优化会降低鲁棒性同时保持奖励。这表明模型主要学习了程序化解决方案模板而非内部化控制方程。
AI.conclusion: 结论是结果级对齐存在关键限制：即使使用精确的物理奖励，强化学习主要诱导程序化解决方案模板而非真正的物理方程内化。奖励信号的精确性（即使是分析上精确的）本身不能保证可迁移的物理推理。可验证的奖励可能需要与结构化推理支架相结合，才能超越模板匹配实现稳健的科学推理。

title: RAGTrack: Language-aware RGBT Tracking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: This work is accepted by CVPR2026. More modifications may be performed
summary: RGB-Thermal (RGBT) tracking aims to achieve robust object localization across diverse environmental conditions by fusing visible and thermal infrared modalities. However, existing RGBT trackers rely solely on initial-frame visual information for target modeling, failing to adapt to appearance variations due to the absence of language guidance. Furthermore, current methods suffer from redundant search regions and heterogeneous modality gaps, causing background distraction. To address these issues, we first introduce textual descriptions into RGBT tracking benchmarks. This is accomplished through a pipeline that leverages Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to automatically produce texual annotations. Afterwards, we propose RAGTrack, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework for robust RGBT tracking. To this end, we introduce a Multi-modal Transformer Encoder (MTE) for unified visual-language modeling. Then, we design an Adaptive Token Fusion (ATF) to select target-relevant tokens and perform channel exchanges based on cross-modal correlations, mitigating search redundancies and modality gaps. Finally, we propose a Context-aware Reasoning Module (CRM) to maintain a dynamic knowledge base and employ a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enable temporal linguistic reasoning for robust target modeling. Extensive experiments on four RGBT benchmarks demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging scenarios. The source code is available https://github.com/IdolLab/RAGTrack.

AI.tldr: RAGTrack：一种基于检索增强生成的新型RGB-T热成像跟踪框架，通过引入文本描述和多模态大语言模型，解决了传统RGB-T跟踪中目标建模不灵活、搜索区域冗余和模态差异等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-T跟踪器仅依赖初始帧视觉信息进行目标建模，缺乏语言指导来适应外观变化；同时存在搜索区域冗余和模态差异问题，导致背景干扰。
AI.method: 1) 利用多模态大语言模型自动生成文本标注；2) 提出多模态Transformer编码器统一视觉-语言建模；3) 设计自适应令牌融合选择目标相关令牌并基于跨模态相关性进行通道交换；4) 提出上下文感知推理模块维护动态知识库，采用检索增强生成实现时序语言推理。
AI.result: 在四个RGB-T基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该框架在各种挑战性场景下实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: RAGTrack通过引入文本描述和检索增强生成框架，有效解决了RGB-T跟踪中的目标建模、搜索冗余和模态差异问题，实现了鲁棒的跨模态目标跟踪。

title: Token-Oriented Object Notation vs JSON: A Benchmark of Plain and Constrained Decoding Generation
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Benchmark code and data available at https://github.com/vetertann/TOON-generation-benchmark
summary:
Recently presented Token-Oriented Object Notation (TOON) aims to replace JSON as a serialization format for passing structured data to LLMs with significantly reduced token usage. While showing solid accuracy in LLM comprehension, there is a lack of tests against JSON generation. Though never present in training data, TOON syntax is simple enough to suggest one-shot in-context learning could support accurate generation. The inevitable prompt overhead can be an acceptable trade-off for shorter completions.
  To test this, we conducted a benchmark creating several test cases with regard to structural complexity, a validation pipeline, and comparing plain JSON generation vs structured output (via constrained decoding) JSON generation vs TOON one-shot in-context learning generation. JSON structured output was included to establish a minimum token budget baseline and to set a starting point for future experiments testing TOON constrained decoding inference enforcement.
  Key findings: TOON shows promising accuracy/token consumption ratio for in-domain generation tasks, though this advantage is often reduced by the "prompt tax" of instructional overhead in shorter contexts. Plain JSON generation shows the best one-shot and final accuracy, even compared with constrained decoding structured output, where the only significant advantage is the lowest token usage as a trade-off for slightly decreased accuracy overall and significant degradation for some models. Notably, for simple structures, this "lowest token usage" of constrained decoding outperformed even TOON, hinting that TOON enforcing via frameworks such as xgrammar may not yield the desired results. Furthermore, the results suggest a scaling hypothesis: TOON's true efficiency potential likely follows a non-linear curve, shining only beyond a specific point where cumulative syntax savings amortize the initial prompt overhead.

AI.tldr: TOON作为JSON的替代序列化格式，在LLM理解中表现良好但缺乏生成测试。研究发现TOON在上下文学习生成中准确率/令牌消耗比有潜力，但提示开销会削弱优势，而普通JSON生成在准确率上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: TOON旨在替代JSON作为向LLM传递结构化数据的序列化格式，显著减少令牌使用。虽然TOON在LLM理解中显示出良好的准确性，但缺乏对JSON生成的测试。研究旨在测试TOON通过上下文学习进行准确生成的能力。
AI.method: 创建了多个关于结构复杂性的测试案例，建立验证流程，比较了普通JSON生成、结构化输出（通过约束解码）JSON生成和TOON一次性上下文学习生成。JSON结构化输出被用作最小令牌预算基线。
AI.result: TOON在领域内生成任务中显示出有前景的准确率/令牌消耗比，但提示开销在较短上下文中会削弱这一优势。普通JSON生成在一次性准确率和最终准确率上表现最佳，即使与约束解码结构化输出相比也是如此。约束解码的唯一显著优势是最低的令牌使用，但以准确率略微下降为代价。对于简单结构，约束解码的"最低令牌使用"甚至优于TOON。
AI.conclusion: TOON的真正效率潜力可能遵循非线性曲线，只有在超过特定点后，累积的语法节省才能摊销初始提示开销。TOON通过xgrammar等框架强制执行可能不会产生预期效果，而普通JSON生成在准确率方面仍然是最佳选择。

title: Towards Realistic Personalization: Evaluating Long-Horizon Preference Following in Personalized User-LLM Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly serving as personal assistants, where users share complex and diverse preferences over extended interactions. However, assessing how well LLMs can follow these preferences in realistic, long-term situations remains underexplored. This work proposes RealPref, a benchmark for evaluating realistic preference-following in personalized user-LLM interactions. RealPref features 100 user profiles, 1300 personalized preferences, four types of preference expression (ranging from explicit to implicit), and long-horizon interaction histories. It includes three types of test questions (multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended), with detailed rubrics for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Results indicate that LLM performance significantly drops as context length grows and preference expression becomes more implicit, and that generalizing user preference understanding to unseen scenarios poses further challenges. RealPref and these findings provide a foundation for future research to develop user-aware LLM assistants that better adapt to individual needs. The code is available at https://github.com/GG14127/RealPref.

AI.tldr: RealPref是一个评估LLM在个性化交互中遵循用户偏好的基准测试，包含100个用户档案、1300个偏好、4种偏好表达方式和长时程交互历史，结果显示LLM性能随上下文增长和偏好表达隐晦而显著下降。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地作为个人助手使用，用户会在长期交互中分享复杂多样的偏好，但目前缺乏评估LLM在现实长期情境中遵循这些偏好能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出RealPref基准测试，包含100个用户档案、1300个个性化偏好、4种偏好表达方式（从显式到隐式）和长时程交互历史，采用三种测试问题类型（多项选择、对错判断和开放式问题），并设计了详细的LLM作为评判者的评估标准。
AI.result: LLM性能随着上下文长度增加和偏好表达变得更加隐晦而显著下降，将用户偏好理解推广到未见场景面临进一步挑战。
AI.conclusion: RealPref基准测试及相关发现为未来研究开发更好地适应个体需求的用户感知型LLM助手奠定了基础。

title: TopicENA: Enabling Epistemic Network Analysis at Scale through Automated Topic-Based Coding
summary: Epistemic Network Analysis (ENA) is a method for investigating the relational structure of concepts in text by representing co-occurring concepts as networks. Traditional ENA, however, relies heavily on manual expert coding, which limits its scalability and real-world applicability to large text corpora. Topic modeling provides an automated approach to extracting concept-level representations from text and can serve as an alternative to manual coding. To tackle this limitation, the present study merges BERTopic with ENA and introduces TopicENA, a topic-based epistemic network analysis framework. TopicENA substitutes manual concept coding with automatically generated topics while maintaining ENA's capacity for modeling structural associations among concepts. To explain the impact of modeling choices on TopicENA outcomes, three analysis cases are presented. The first case assesses the effect of topic granularity, indicating that coarse-grained topics are preferable for large datasets, whereas fine-grained topics are more effective for smaller datasets. The second case examines topic inclusion thresholds and finds that threshold values should be adjusted according to topic quality indicators to balance network consistency and interpretability. The third case tests TopicENA's scalability by applying it to a substantially larger dataset than those used in previous ENA studies. Collectively, these cases illustrate that TopicENA facilitates practical and interpretable ENA analysis at scale and offers concrete guidance for configuring topic-based ENA pipelines in large-scale text analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出TopicENA框架，将BERTopic与ENA结合，用自动生成的主题替代手动编码，实现大规模文本的认知网络分析。
AI.motivation: 传统认知网络分析(ENA)依赖专家手动编码，限制了其在大规模文本语料库中的可扩展性和实际应用性。需要一种自动化方法来克服这一限制。
AI.method: 提出TopicENA框架，将BERTopic主题建模与ENA结合，用自动生成的主题替代手动概念编码，同时保持ENA对概念间结构关联的建模能力。通过三个分析案例评估建模选择对结果的影响。
AI.result: 1) 主题粒度影响：大数据集适合粗粒度主题，小数据集适合细粒度主题；2) 主题包含阈值应根据主题质量指标调整以平衡网络一致性和可解释性；3) TopicENA可成功应用于比以往ENA研究大得多的数据集，证明其可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: TopicENA实现了大规模、实用且可解释的ENA分析，为基于主题的ENA流水线配置提供了具体指导，解决了传统ENA手动编码的可扩展性限制。

title: Agentics 2.0: Logical Transduction Algebra for Agentic Data Workflows
summary: Agentic AI is rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to enterprise deployments, where requirements extend to meet the software quality attributes of reliability, scalability, and observability beyond plausible text generation. We present Agentics 2.0, a lightweight, Python-native framework for building high-quality, structured, explainable, and type-safe agentic data workflows. At the core of Agentics 2.0, the logical transduction algebra formalizes a large language model inference call as a typed semantic transformation, which we call a transducible function that enforces schema validity and the locality of evidence. The transducible functions compose into larger programs via algebraically grounded operators and execute as stateless asynchronous calls in parallel in asynchronous Map-Reduce programs. The proposed framework provides semantic reliability through strong typing, semantic observability through evidence tracing between slots of the input and output types, and scalability through stateless parallel execution. We instantiate reusable design patterns and evaluate the programs in Agentics 2.0 on challenging benchmarks, including DiscoveryBench for data-driven discovery and Archer for NL-to-SQL semantic parsing, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: Agentics 2.0是一个轻量级Python框架，通过逻辑转换代数将LLM推理形式化为类型安全的语义转换，提供可靠性、可观察性和可扩展性的智能体数据工作流。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI正从研究原型转向企业部署，需要满足可靠性、可扩展性和可观察性等软件质量属性，而不仅仅是生成合理的文本。
AI.method: 提出逻辑转换代数，将大语言模型推理调用形式化为类型化的语义转换（可转换函数），通过代数算子组合成更大程序，并以无状态异步并行方式执行。
AI.result: 在DiscoveryBench数据驱动发现和Archer NL-to-SQL语义解析等挑战性基准测试中展示了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: Agentics 2.0框架通过强类型化、证据追踪和无状态并行执行，为构建高质量、结构化、可解释和类型安全的智能体数据工作流提供了有效解决方案。

title: Image-based Prompt Injection: Hijacking Multimodal LLMs through Visually Embedded Adversarial Instructions
comment: 7 pages, published in 2025 3rd International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM), Vienna, Austria
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) integrate vision and text to power applications, but this integration introduces new vulnerabilities. We study Image-based Prompt Injection (IPI), a black-box attack in which adversarial instructions are embedded into natural images to override model behavior. Our end-to-end IPI pipeline incorporates segmentation-based region selection, adaptive font scaling, and background-aware rendering to conceal prompts from human perception while preserving model interpretability. Using the COCO dataset and GPT-4-turbo, we evaluate 12 adversarial prompt strategies and multiple embedding configurations. The results show that IPI can reliably manipulate the output of the model, with the most effective configuration achieving up to 64\% attack success under stealth constraints. These findings highlight IPI as a practical threat in black-box settings and underscore the need for defenses against multimodal prompt injection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于图像的提示注入攻击（IPI），这是一种黑盒攻击方法，通过将对抗性指令嵌入自然图像来覆盖多模态大语言模型的行为。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型整合视觉和文本带来了新的安全漏洞。虽然文本提示注入已被广泛研究，但基于图像的提示注入攻击尚未得到充分探索，这种攻击可能在实际应用中构成严重威胁。
AI.method: 开发了一个端到端的IPI管道，包含基于分割的区域选择、自适应字体缩放和背景感知渲染技术，以隐藏对抗性提示不被人类察觉，同时保持模型可解释性。使用COCO数据集和GPT-4-turbo评估了12种对抗性提示策略和多种嵌入配置。
AI.result: IPI能够可靠地操纵模型输出，在隐身约束下，最有效的配置实现了高达64%的攻击成功率。这表明IPI在黑盒设置中构成实际威胁。
AI.conclusion: 基于图像的提示注入攻击是多模态大语言模型的一个实际安全威胁，需要开发相应的防御机制来应对这种新型攻击。

title: Old Habits Die Hard: How Conversational History Geometrically Traps LLMs
summary: How does the conversational past of large language models (LLMs) influence their future performance? Recent work suggests that LLMs are affected by their conversational history in unexpected ways. For instance, hallucinations in prior interactions may influence subsequent model responses. In this work, we introduce History-Echoes, a framework that investigates how conversational history biases subsequent generations. The framework explores this bias from two perspectives: probabilistically, we model conversations as Markov chains to quantify state consistency; geometrically, we measure the consistency of consecutive hidden representations. Across three model families and six datasets spanning diverse phenomena, our analysis reveals a strong correlation between the two perspectives. By bridging these perspectives, we demonstrate that behavioral persistence manifests as a geometric trap, where gaps in the latent space confine the model's trajectory. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/OldHabitsDieHard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了History-Echoes框架，研究大型语言模型的对话历史如何影响其后续生成，发现历史偏差会导致模型陷入几何陷阱。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型的对话历史如何影响其未来表现，特别是历史中的幻觉等问题如何影响后续模型响应。
AI.method: 提出History-Echoes框架，从两个角度分析对话历史偏差：概率角度将对话建模为马尔可夫链量化状态一致性；几何角度测量连续隐藏表示的一致性。
AI.result: 在三个模型系列和六个涵盖不同现象的数据集上，分析显示两个视角之间存在强相关性，行为持续性表现为几何陷阱，潜在空间中的间隙限制了模型的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过桥接概率和几何视角，证明了对话历史偏差会导致模型陷入几何陷阱，为理解LLM的对话历史影响提供了新视角。

title: $τ$-Knowledge: Evaluating Conversational Agents over Unstructured Knowledge
summary: Conversational agents are increasingly deployed in knowledge-intensive settings, where correct behavior depends on retrieving and applying domain-specific knowledge from large, proprietary, and unstructured corpora during live interactions with users. Yet most existing benchmarks evaluate retrieval or tool use independently of each other, creating a gap in realistic, fully agentic evaluation over unstructured data in long-horizon interactions. We introduce $τ$-Knowledge, an extension of $τ$-Bench for evaluating agents in environments where success depends on coordinating external, natural-language knowledge with tool outputs to produce verifiable, policy-compliant state changes. Our new domain, $τ$-Banking, models realistic fintech customer support workflows in which agents must navigate roughly 700 interconnected knowledge documents while executing tool-mediated account updates. Across embedding-based retrieval and terminal-based search, even frontier models with high reasoning budgets achieve only $\sim$25.5% pass^1, with reliability degrading sharply over repeated trials. Agents struggle to retrieve the correct documents from densely interlinked knowledge bases and to reason accurately over complex internal policies. Overall, $τ$-Knowledge provides a realistic testbed for developing agents that integrate unstructured knowledge in human-facing deployments.

AI.tldr: τ-Knowledge扩展了τ-Bench，用于评估在需要协调外部自然语言知识和工具输出的环境中工作的智能体，特别是在τ-Banking金融科技客服场景中，即使前沿模型在密集知识库检索和复杂政策推理方面表现不佳（仅约25.5%成功率）。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数基准测试独立评估检索或工具使用，缺乏对智能体在长时程交互中处理非结构化数据的真实评估，而知识密集型场景中智能体的正确行为依赖于从大型专有非结构化语料库中检索和应用领域知识。
AI.method: 引入τ-Knowledge作为τ-Bench的扩展，创建τ-Banking领域模拟真实的金融科技客服工作流，智能体需要导航约700个互连知识文档，同时执行工具介导的账户更新，评估嵌入检索和终端搜索两种方式。
AI.result: 即使使用前沿模型和高推理预算，智能体仅能达到约25.5%的成功率，且在重复试验中可靠性急剧下降。智能体难以从密集互连的知识库中检索正确文档，也无法准确推理复杂的内部政策。
AI.conclusion: τ-Knowledge为开发在人类交互部署中集成非结构化知识的智能体提供了真实的测试平台，揭示了当前智能体在知识密集型任务中的显著局限性。

title: InfinityStory: Unlimited Video Generation with World Consistency and Character-Aware Shot Transitions
summary: Generating long-form storytelling videos with consistent visual narratives remains a significant challenge in video synthesis. We present a novel framework, dataset, and a model that address three critical limitations: background consistency across shots, seamless multi-subject shot-to-shot transitions, and scalability to hour-long narratives. Our approach introduces a background-consistent generation pipeline that maintains visual coherence across scenes while preserving character identity and spatial relationships. We further propose a transition-aware video synthesis module that generates smooth shot transitions for complex scenarios involving multiple subjects entering or exiting frames, going beyond the single-subject limitations of prior work. To support this, we contribute with a synthetic dataset of 10,000 multi-subject transition sequences covering underrepresented dynamic scene compositions. On VBench, InfinityStory achieves the highest Background Consistency (88.94), highest Subject Consistency (82.11), and the best overall average rank (2.80), showing improved stability, smoother transitions, and better temporal coherence.

AI.tldr: InfinityStory框架解决了长视频生成中的背景一致性、多主体镜头过渡和可扩展性问题，在VBench评测中取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 当前视频合成技术在生成具有一致视觉叙事的长篇故事视频方面存在三个关键限制：镜头间的背景一致性不足、多主体镜头过渡不流畅、以及难以扩展到小时级叙事长度。
AI.method: 提出了背景一致性生成管道保持场景视觉连贯性，同时保留角色身份和空间关系；开发了过渡感知视频合成模块处理多主体进出画面的复杂场景过渡；创建了包含10,000个多主体过渡序列的合成数据集。
AI.result: 在VBench评测中，InfinityStory获得最高背景一致性分数(88.94)、最高主体一致性分数(82.11)和最佳总体平均排名(2.80)，显示出改进的稳定性、更平滑的过渡和更好的时间连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了长视频生成中的关键挑战，通过背景一致性管道和过渡感知合成实现了更稳定、连贯的长篇故事视频生成，超越了先前工作的单主体限制。

title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic AI for WebGIS Development
comment: Paper submitted to Transactions in GIS
summary: WebGIS development requires rigor, yet agentic AI frequently fails due to five large language model (LLM) limitations: context constraints, cross-session forgetting, stochasticity, instruction failure, and adaptation rigidity. We propose a dual-helix governance framework reframing these challenges as structural governance problems that model capacity alone cannot resolve. We implement the framework as a 3-track architecture (Knowledge, Behavior, Skills) that uses a knowledge graph substrate to stabilize execution by externalizing domain facts and enforcing executable protocols, complemented by a self-learning cycle for autonomous knowledge growth. Applying this to the FutureShorelines WebGIS tool, a governed agent refactored a 2,265-line monolithic codebase into modular ES6 components. Results demonstrated a 51\% reduction in cyclomatic complexity and a 7-point increase in maintainability index. A comparative experiment against a zero-shot LLM confirms that externalized governance, not just model capability, drives operational reliability in geospatial engineering. This approach is implemented in the open-source AgentLoom governance toolkit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双螺旋治理框架，将WebGIS开发中LLM的五大限制重构为治理问题，通过知识图谱基板和三层架构稳定执行，在FutureShorelines工具中实现代码重构，复杂度降低51%，可维护性提升7点。
AI.motivation: WebGIS开发需要严谨性，但当前基于大语言模型的智能体经常失败，主要受限于五大问题：上下文约束、跨会话遗忘、随机性、指令失败和适应僵化。这些限制无法仅通过模型能力解决，需要结构性治理框架。
AI.method: 提出双螺旋治理框架，将其实现为三层架构：知识层、行为层和技能层。使用知识图谱基板外部化领域事实并强制执行可执行协议，辅以自学习循环实现自主知识增长。该框架在开源AgentLoom治理工具包中实现。
AI.result: 将框架应用于FutureShorelines WebGIS工具，治理后的智能体将2,265行单体代码库重构为模块化ES6组件。结果显示圈复杂度降低51%，可维护性指数提升7点。对比实验证实外部化治理（而非仅模型能力）驱动了地理空间工程的操作可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在WebGIS开发中的限制本质上是治理问题而非能力问题。双螺旋治理框架通过外部化知识和强制执行协议，结合自学习机制，显著提升了智能体在复杂工程任务中的可靠性和可维护性。该方法为地理空间工程中的AI治理提供了可行方案。

title: One-Step Face Restoration via Shortcut-Enhanced Coupling Flow
summary: Face restoration has advanced significantly with generative models like diffusion models and flow matching (FM), which learn continuous-time mappings between distributions. However, existing FM-based approaches often start from Gaussian noise, ignoring the inherent dependency between low-quality (LQ) and high-quality (HQ) data, resulting in path crossovers, curved trajectories, and multi-step sampling requirements. To address these issues, we propose Shortcut-enhanced Coupling flow for Face Restoration (SCFlowFR). First, it establishes a \textit{data-dependent coupling} that explicitly models the LQ--HQ dependency, minimizing path crossovers and promoting near-linear transport. Second, we employ conditional mean estimation to obtain a coarse prediction that refines the source anchor to tighten coupling and conditions the velocity field to stabilize large-step updates. Third, a shortcut constraint supervises average velocities over arbitrary time intervals, enabling accurate one-step inference. Experiments demonstrate that SCFlowFR achieves state-of-the-art one-step face restoration quality with inference speed comparable to traditional non-diffusion methods.

AI.tldr: SCFlowFR是一种用于人脸修复的增强耦合流方法，通过数据依赖耦合、条件均值估计和捷径约束，实现高质量的一步推理，速度与传统非扩散方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的方法通常从高斯噪声开始，忽略了低质量（LQ）和高质量（HQ）数据之间的内在依赖关系，导致路径交叉、弯曲轨迹和多步采样需求。
AI.method: 1. 建立数据依赖耦合，显式建模LQ-HQ依赖关系，最小化路径交叉并促进近线性传输；2. 使用条件均值估计获得粗预测，细化源锚点以加强耦合并稳定大步更新；3. 通过捷径约束监督任意时间间隔内的平均速度，实现准确的一步推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，SCFlowFR在一步人脸修复质量上达到最先进水平，推理速度与传统非扩散方法相当。
AI.conclusion: SCFlowFR通过数据依赖耦合、条件均值估计和捷径约束，有效解决了现有流匹配方法在人脸修复中的问题，实现了高质量、高效率的一步推理。

title: Entropic-Time Inference: Self-Organizing Large Language Model Decoding Beyond Attention
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) inference engines optimize throughput and latency under fixed decoding rules, treating generation as a linear progression in token time. We propose a fundamentally different paradigm: entropic\-time inference, where decoding is governed by the flow of uncertainty rather than token index. We introduce a self\-organizing inference architecture that jointly couples scheduling, attention sparsification, and sampling temperature under a unified entropy control objective. Our method extends vLLM with entropy-aware scheduling, entropic pruning of paged attention blocks, and adaptive temperature control that stabilizes generation near a target entropy regime. This transforms inference into a resource\-intelligent thermodynamic process that allocates computation where uncertainty reduction is maximized. We present a concrete systems design, pseudocode, and integration plan, demonstrating how entropy can serve as a first\-class control signal for scalable LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于熵时间的新型LLM推理范式，用不确定性流而非token索引控制解码过程，通过熵感知调度、注意力剪枝和自适应温度控制优化推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理引擎在固定解码规则下优化吞吐量和延迟，将生成视为token时间的线性进程，这种范式存在效率限制。需要一种基于不确定性流的更智能推理方法。
AI.method: 提出熵时间推理范式，包含：1）熵感知调度；2）分页注意力块的熵剪枝；3）自适应温度控制，使生成稳定在目标熵区间。这些组件在统一熵控制目标下协同工作。
AI.result: 将推理转化为资源智能的热力学过程，计算资源分配在不确定性减少最大化的地方。提供了具体的系统设计、伪代码和集成方案。
AI.conclusion: 熵可以作为可扩展LLM推理的一级控制信号，实现更高效的推理过程，这是对传统线性token时间推理范式的根本性改变。

title: The Logovista English--Japanese Machine Translation System
summary:
This paper documents the architecture, development practices, and preserved artifacts of the Logovista English--Japanese machine translation system, a large, explicitly rule-based MT system that was developed and sold commercially from the early 1990s through at least 2012. The system combined hand-authored grammatical rules, a large central dictionary encoding syntactic and semantic constraints, and chart-based parsing with weighted interpretation scoring to manage extensive structural ambiguity.
  The account emphasizes how the system was extended and maintained under real-world usage pressures, including regression control, ambiguity management, and the limits encountered as coverage expanded. Unlike many rule-based MT systems described primarily in research settings, Logovista was deployed for decades and evolved continuously in response to practical requirements. The paper is intended as a technical and historical record rather than an argument for reviving rule-based MT, and describes the software and linguistic resources that have been preserved for potential future study.

AI.tldr: Logovista是一个从1990年代到2012年商业化的英日机器翻译系统，采用基于规则的方法，结合手工语法规则、大型中心词典和图表解析，在真实使用压力下持续演化。
AI.motivation: 记录Logovista英日机器翻译系统的架构、开发实践和保存的成果，为这个在真实商业环境中部署数十年的基于规则MT系统提供技术和历史记录，而非主张复兴基于规则的方法。
AI.method: 系统结合手工编写的语法规则、大型中心词典（编码句法和语义约束）、基于图表的解析以及加权解释评分来管理广泛的结构歧义。在真实使用压力下进行扩展和维护，包括回归控制、歧义管理等方法。
AI.result: Logovista系统成功商业化部署数十年，在真实世界使用压力下持续演化，积累了丰富的软件和语言资源，这些资源已被保存供未来研究使用。
AI.conclusion: 该论文主要作为技术和历史记录，描述了Logovista这个长期商业部署的基于规则MT系统的架构、开发实践和保存的资源，为未来研究提供了有价值的参考案例。

title: InEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Intermediate Logical Pathways for Intelligent Image Editing Models
summary: Multimodal generative models have made significant strides in image editing, demonstrating impressive performance on a variety of static tasks. However, their proficiency typically does not extend to complex scenarios requiring dynamic reasoning, leaving them ill-equipped to model the coherent, intermediate logical pathways that constitute a multi-step evolution from an initial state to a final one. This capacity is crucial for unlocking a deeper level of procedural and causal understanding in visual manipulation. To systematically measure this critical limitation, we introduce InEdit-Bench, the first evaluation benchmark dedicated to reasoning over intermediate pathways in image editing. InEdit-Bench comprises meticulously annotated test cases covering four fundamental task categories: state transition, dynamic process, temporal sequence, and scientific simulation. Additionally, to enable fine-grained evaluation, we propose a set of assessment criteria to evaluate the logical coherence and visual naturalness of the generated pathways, as well as the model's fidelity to specified path constraints. Our comprehensive evaluation of 14 representative image editing models on InEdit-Bench reveals significant and widespread shortcomings in this domain. By providing a standardized and challenging benchmark, we aim for InEdit-Bench to catalyze research and steer development towards more dynamic, reason-aware, and intelligent multimodal generative models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了InEdit-Bench，首个专注于图像编辑中中间推理路径评估的基准测试，揭示了现有多模态生成模型在动态推理能力上的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成模型在图像编辑方面表现出色，但缺乏对复杂动态场景的推理能力，无法建模从初始状态到最终状态的多步演化逻辑路径。这种能力对于实现更深层次的程序和因果理解至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了InEdit-Bench评估基准，包含四个基本任务类别：状态转换、动态过程、时间序列和科学模拟。同时提出了一套评估标准，用于评估生成路径的逻辑连贯性、视觉自然性以及模型对指定路径约束的忠实度。
AI.result: 对14个代表性图像编辑模型的综合评估显示，该领域存在显著且普遍的缺陷，现有模型在动态推理能力方面表现不足。
AI.conclusion: InEdit-Bench作为一个标准化且具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在推动研究并引导开发更具动态性、推理意识和智能的多模态生成模型。

title: Escaping the BLEU Trap: A Signal-Grounded Framework with Decoupled Semantic Guidance for EEG-to-Text Decoding
summary: Decoding natural language from non-invasive EEG signals is a promising yet challenging task. However, current state-of-the-art models remain constrained by three fundamental limitations: Semantic Bias (mode collapse into generic templates), Signal Neglect (hallucination based on linguistic priors rather than neural inputs), and the BLEU Trap, where evaluation metrics are artificially inflated by high-frequency stopwords, masking a lack of true semantic fidelity. To address these challenges, we propose SemKey, a novel multi-stage framework that enforces signal-grounded generation through four decoupled semantic objectives: sentiment, topic, length, and surprisal. We redesign the interaction between the neural encoder and the Large Language Model (LLM) by injecting semantic prompts as Queries and EEG embeddings as Key-Value pairs, strictly forcing the model to attend to neural inputs. Furthermore, we move beyond standard translation metrics by adopting N-way Retrieval Accuracy and Fréchet Distance to rigorously assess diversity and alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively eliminates hallucinations on noise inputs and achieves SOTA performance on these robust protocols. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://github.com/xmed-lab/SemKey.

AI.tldr: SemKey：一种通过解耦语义目标（情感、主题、长度、意外性）来强制信号接地生成的多阶段框架，解决了EEG解码中的语义偏差、信号忽视和BLEU陷阱问题。
AI.motivation: 当前非侵入性EEG信号解码模型存在三个基本限制：语义偏差（模式崩溃为通用模板）、信号忽视（基于语言先验而非神经输入的幻觉）以及BLEU陷阱（评估指标因高频停用词而人为膨胀，掩盖了真实语义保真度的缺乏）。
AI.method: 提出SemKey多阶段框架，通过四个解耦的语义目标（情感、主题、长度、意外性）强制信号接地生成；重新设计神经编码器与大型语言模型之间的交互，将语义提示作为查询，EEG嵌入作为键值对，强制模型关注神经输入；采用N-way检索准确率和Fréchet距离进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能有效消除噪声输入上的幻觉，并在这些稳健协议上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SemKey框架通过语义解耦和强制信号接地，解决了EEG解码中的关键挑战，为从神经信号中解码自然语言提供了更可靠的方法。

title: Machine Pareidolia: Protecting Facial Image with Emotional Editing
comment: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 40
summary: The proliferation of facial recognition (FR) systems has raised privacy concerns in the digital realm, as malicious uses of FR models pose a significant threat. Traditional countermeasures, such as makeup style transfer, have suffered from low transferability in black-box settings and limited applicability across various demographic groups, including males and individuals with darker skin tones. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel facial privacy protection method, dubbed \textbf{MAP}, a pioneering approach that employs human emotion modifications to disguise original identities as target identities in facial images. Our method uniquely fine-tunes a score network to learn dual objectives, target identity and human expression, which are jointly optimized through gradient projection to ensure convergence at a shared local optimum. Additionally, we enhance the perceptual quality of protected images by applying local smoothness regularization and optimizing the score matching loss within our network. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our innovative approach surpasses previous baselines, including noise-based, makeup-based, and freeform attribute methods, in both qualitative fidelity and quantitative metrics. Furthermore, MAP proves its effectiveness against an online FR API and shows advanced adaptability in uncommon photographic scenarios.

AI.tldr: MAP是一种新颖的面部隐私保护方法，通过情感修改将原始身份伪装为目标身份，在保护隐私的同时保持图像质量，在黑盒设置中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 面部识别系统的普及引发了隐私担忧，传统对抗方法（如化妆风格迁移）在黑盒设置中可迁移性低，且对不同人口群体（如男性、深肤色人群）适用性有限。
AI.method: MAP通过微调评分网络学习双重目标（目标身份和人类表情），使用梯度投影联合优化确保收敛到共享局部最优解，并应用局部平滑正则化和评分匹配损失优化来提升感知质量。
AI.result: 实验表明MAP在定性保真度和定量指标上均优于之前的基线方法（包括基于噪声、化妆和自由形式属性的方法），对在线FR API有效且在罕见摄影场景中具有高级适应性。
AI.conclusion: MAP是一种有效的面部隐私保护方法，通过情感修改实现身份伪装，解决了传统方法在黑盒设置和不同人口群体中的局限性，在真实场景中表现出色。

title: How does fine-tuning improve sensorimotor representations in large language models?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit a significant "embodiment gap", where their text-based representations fail to align with human sensorimotor experiences. This study systematically investigates whether and how task-specific fine-tuning can bridge this gap. Utilizing Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and dimension-specific correlation metrics, we demonstrate that the internal representations of LLMs can be steered toward more embodied, grounded patterns through fine-tuning. Furthermore, the results show that while sensorimotor improvements generalize robustly across languages and related sensory-motor dimensions, they are highly sensitive to the learning objective, failing to transfer across two disparate task formats.

AI.tldr: 研究发现通过任务特定的微调可以缩小大语言模型的"具身化差距"，使其内部表征更接近人类的感知运动经验，但这种改进对学习目标敏感且难以跨任务格式迁移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在显著的"具身化差距"，其基于文本的表征与人类的感知运动经验不匹配。本研究旨在探索任务特定的微调是否以及如何能够弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 使用表征相似性分析（RSA）和维度特定的相关性度量方法，系统研究任务特定微调对大语言模型内部表征的影响。
AI.result: 研究表明，通过微调可以引导大语言模型的内部表征朝着更具身化、更接地气的模式发展。感知运动能力的改进在不同语言和相关的感知运动维度上具有鲁棒的泛化性，但对学习目标高度敏感，无法在两种不同的任务格式之间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的微调能够有效缩小大语言模型的具身化差距，但改进效果受学习目标约束，难以跨任务格式迁移，这为未来设计更有效的具身化学习策略提供了重要启示。

title: EvoPrune: Early-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in vision-language tasks, but their inference efficiency is severely limited by the exponential growth of visual tokens in complex scenarios such as high-resolution images and videos. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly operate after visual encoding, overlooking the substantial computational cost incurred during the encoding stage. To address this issue, we propose EvoPrune, an early-stage visual token pruning method for MLLMs that performs pruning directly during visual encoding. Specifically, EvoPrune employs a layer-wise pruning strategy guided by token similarity, diversity, and attention-based importance to retain the most informative visual tokens at selected encoding layers. Extensive experiments on image and video benchmarks validate the effectiveness of EvoPrune. In particular, on the VideoMME dataset, EvoPrune achieves 2$\times$ inference speedup with less than 1% performance degradation, demonstrating its potential for latency-sensitive MLLM deployment.

AI.tldr: EvoPrune是一种针对多模态大语言模型的早期视觉token剪枝方法，在视觉编码阶段直接进行剪枝，显著提升推理效率，在视频任务上实现2倍加速且性能损失小于1%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉语言任务上表现出色，但在高分辨率图像和视频等复杂场景中，视觉token数量呈指数增长，严重限制了推理效率。现有视觉token剪枝方法主要在视觉编码后操作，忽略了编码阶段的大量计算成本。
AI.method: EvoPrune采用分层剪枝策略，在选定的编码层中基于token相似性、多样性和基于注意力的重要性指导，保留信息量最大的视觉token。该方法直接在视觉编码过程中进行早期剪枝。
AI.result: 在图像和视频基准测试上的广泛实验验证了EvoPrune的有效性。特别是在VideoMME数据集上，EvoPrune实现了2倍的推理加速，性能下降小于1%。
AI.conclusion: EvoPrune通过早期视觉token剪枝有效解决了MLLMs推理效率瓶颈问题，展示了其在延迟敏感的多模态大语言模型部署中的潜力。

title: Towards Self-Robust LLMs: Intrinsic Prompt Noise Resistance via CoIPO
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable and steadily improving performance across a wide range of tasks. However, LLM performance may be highly sensitive to prompt variations especially in scenarios with limited openness or strict output formatting requirements, indicating insufficient robustness. In real-world applications, user prompts provided to LLMs often contain imperfections, which may undermine the quality of the model's responses. To address this issue, previous work has primarily focused on preprocessing prompts, employing external tools or even LLMs to refine prompt formulations in advance. However, these approaches overlook the intrinsic robustness of LLMs, and their reliance on external components introduces additional computational overhead and uncertainty. In this work, we propose a Contrastive Learning-based Inverse Direct Preference Optimization (CoIPO) method that minimizes the discrepancy between the label-aligned logits produced by the model under a clean prompt and its noisy counterpart, and conduct a detailed analysis using mutual information theory. We augment the FLAN dataset by constructing paired prompts, each consisting of a clean prompt and its corresponding noisy version for training. Additionally, to evaluate the effectiveness, we develop NoisyPromptBench, a benchmark enhanced and derived from the existing PromptBench. Experimental results conducted on NoisyPromptBench demonstrate that our proposed method achieves a significant improvement in average accuracy over the current state-of-the-art approaches. The source code of CoIPO, pair-wise FLAN datasets, and NoisyPromptBench have already been released on https://github.com/vegetable-yx/CoIPO.

AI.tldr: CoIPO方法通过对比学习优化LLM对噪声提示的鲁棒性，在NoisyPromptBench上显著提升平均准确率
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在实际应用中面临用户提示不完美的问题，现有方法依赖外部工具预处理提示，忽略了LLM内在鲁棒性，且引入额外计算开销和不确定性
AI.method: 提出基于对比学习的逆直接偏好优化方法，最小化干净提示和噪声提示下模型产生的标签对齐logits之间的差异，使用互信息理论进行分析，并在FLAN数据集上构建配对提示进行训练
AI.result: 在NoisyPromptBench基准测试中，CoIPO方法相比当前最先进方法实现了显著的平均准确率提升
AI.conclusion: CoIPO方法有效提升了LLM对噪声提示的鲁棒性，无需依赖外部组件，相关代码、数据集和基准测试已开源

title: Error as Signal: Stiffness-Aware Diffusion Sampling via Embedded Runge-Kutta Guidance
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) has established the foundation for guidance mechanisms in diffusion models, showing that well-designed guidance proxies significantly improve conditional generation and sample quality. Autoguidance (AG) has extended this idea, but it relies on an auxiliary network and leaves solver-induced errors unaddressed. In stiff regions, the ODE trajectory changes sharply, where local truncation error (LTE) becomes a critical factor that deteriorates sample quality. Our key observation is that these errors align with the dominant eigenvector, motivating us to leverage the solver-induced error as a guidance signal. We propose Embedded Runge-Kutta Guidance (ERK-Guid), which exploits detected stiffness to reduce LTE and stabilize sampling. We theoretically and empirically analyze stiffness and eigenvector estimators with solver errors to motivate the design of ERK-Guid. Our experiments on both synthetic datasets and the popular benchmark dataset, ImageNet, demonstrate that ERK-Guid consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/ERK-Guid.

AI.tldr: 提出ERK-Guid方法，利用求解器诱导误差作为指导信号，通过检测刚度来减少局部截断误差，稳定扩散模型采样过程
AI.motivation: 现有Classifier-Free Guidance和Autoguidance方法存在局限性：AG依赖辅助网络且未解决求解器诱导误差；在刚度区域中ODE轨迹急剧变化，局部截断误差成为影响样本质量的关键因素
AI.method: 提出Embedded Runge-Kutta Guidance (ERK-Guid)，利用检测到的刚度来减少局部截断误差，通过求解器诱导误差作为指导信号，稳定采样过程
AI.result: 在合成数据集和ImageNet基准测试中，ERK-Guid一致优于现有最先进方法
AI.conclusion: ERK-Guid通过利用求解器诱导误差作为指导信号，有效解决了刚度区域中的局部截断误差问题，提升了扩散模型的采样质量和稳定性

title: The Influence of Iconicity in Transfer Learning for Sign Language Recognition
summary: Most sign language recognition research relies on Transfer Learning (TL) from vision-based datasets such as ImageNet. Some extend this to alternatively available language datasets, often focusing on signs with cross-linguistic similarities. This body of work examines the necessity of these likenesses on effective knowledge transfer by comparing TL performance between iconic signs of two different sign language pairs: Chinese to Arabic and Greek to Flemish. Google Mediapipe was utilised as an input feature extractor, enabling spatial information of these signs to be processed with a Multilayer Perceptron architecture and the temporal information with a Gated Recurrent Unit. Experimental results showed a 7.02% improvement for Arabic and 1.07% for Flemish when conducting iconic TL from Chinese and Greek respectively.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了手语识别中迁移学习的有效性，通过比较中文-阿拉伯语和希腊语-佛兰芒语两对手语对中象似性手势的迁移学习表现，发现象似性手势的迁移学习能带来性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大多数手语识别研究依赖于从视觉数据集（如ImageNet）进行迁移学习，有些研究扩展到其他可用语言数据集，但通常关注具有跨语言相似性的手势。本研究旨在探讨这些相似性对有效知识转移的必要性。
AI.method: 使用Google Mediapipe作为输入特征提取器，将手势的空间信息通过多层感知机处理，时间信息通过门控循环单元处理。比较了中文到阿拉伯语和希腊语到佛兰芒语两对手语对中象似性手势的迁移学习性能。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，从中文到阿拉伯语的象似性迁移学习带来了7.02%的性能提升，从希腊语到佛兰芒语的迁移学习带来了1.07%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 象似性手势的迁移学习在手语识别中是有效的，即使对于不同语言对也能带来性能提升，但提升幅度因语言对而异。

title: LDP-Slicing: Local Differential Privacy for Images via Randomized Bit-Plane Slicing
summary: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) is the gold standard trust model for privacy-preserving machine learning by guaranteeing privacy at the data source. However, its application to image data has long been considered impractical due to the high dimensionality of pixel space. Canonical LDP mechanisms are designed for low-dimensional data, resulting in severe utility degradation when applied to high-dimensional pixel spaces. This paper demonstrates that this utility loss is not inherent to LDP, but from its application to an inappropriate data representation. We introduce LDP-Slicing, a lightweight, training-free framework that resolves this domain mismatch. Our key insight is to decompose pixel values into a sequence of binary bit-planes. This transformation allows us to apply the LDP mechanism directly to the bit-level representation. To further strengthen privacy and preserve utility, we integrate a perceptual obfuscation module that mitigates human-perceivable leakage and an optimization-based privacy budget allocation strategy. This pipeline satisfies rigorous pixel-level $\varepsilon$-LDP while producing images that retain high utility for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on face recognition and image classification demonstrate that LDP-Slicing outperforms existing DP/LDP baselines under comparable privacy budgets, with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: LDP-Slicing：一种轻量级、无需训练的框架，通过将像素值分解为二进制位平面，解决了局部差分隐私在图像数据上的应用难题，在保持隐私的同时显著提升了图像效用。
AI.motivation: 传统局部差分隐私机制设计用于低维数据，直接应用于高维像素空间会导致严重的效用损失，这限制了LDP在图像数据上的实际应用。
AI.method: 1. 将像素值分解为二进制位平面序列；2. 在比特级表示上直接应用LDP机制；3. 集成感知混淆模块减轻人类可感知的信息泄露；4. 采用基于优化的隐私预算分配策略。
AI.result: 在面部识别和图像分类任务上的大量实验表明，LDP-Slicing在可比隐私预算下优于现有的DP/LDP基线方法，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: LDP-Slicing证明了局部差分隐私在图像数据上的效用损失并非固有缺陷，而是源于数据表示的不匹配，通过适当的比特级表示转换可以同时实现严格的像素级ε-LDP和高下游任务效用。

title: Retcon -- a Prompt-Based Technique for Precise Control of LLMs in Conversations
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 appendixes with prompts and examples
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) allow agents to execute complex natural language tasks. Many LLM applications, such as support agents, teaching assistants, and interactive bots, involve multi-turn conversations. However, it remains challenging to control LLMs in the context of such interactions, particularly when the LLM behavior needs to be adjustable over the course of the conversation. In this paper, we present Retcon, a few-shot prompting technique designed to provide turn-level control over LLMs in conversations. We then demonstrate that it performs significantly better than zero-shot and traditional few-shot prompting.

AI.tldr: Retcon是一种少样本提示技术，能够在对话中提供回合级别的LLM控制，相比零样本和传统少样本提示表现显著更好。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在多轮对话应用中广泛使用，但在对话过程中需要调整LLM行为时，控制LLM仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出了Retcon，一种少样本提示技术，专门设计用于在对话中提供回合级别的LLM控制。
AI.result: Retcon在性能上显著优于零样本和传统少样本提示方法。
AI.conclusion: Retcon技术能够有效解决对话中LLM控制问题，为多轮对话应用提供了更好的控制能力。

title: Glass Segmentation with Fusion of Learned and General Visual Features
summary: Glass surface segmentation from RGB images is a challenging task, since glass as a transparent material distinctly lacks visual characteristics. However, glass segmentation is critical for scene understanding and robotics, as transparent glass surfaces must be identified as solid material. This paper presents a novel architecture for glass segmentation, deploying a dual-backbone producing general visual features as well as task-specific learned visual features. General visual features are produced by a frozen DINOv3 vision foundation model, and the task-specific features are generated with a Swin model trained in a supervised manner. Resulting multi-scale feature representations are downsampled with residual Squeeze-and-Excitation Channel Reduction, and fed into a Mask2Former Decoder, producing the final segmentation masks. The architecture was evaluated on four commonly used glass segmentation datasets, achieving state-of-the-art results on several accuracy metrics. The model also has a competitive inference speed compared to the previous state-of-the-art method, and surpasses it when using a lighter DINOv3 backbone variant. The implementation source code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/ojalar/lgnet

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于玻璃表面分割的新型双主干网络架构，结合了冻结的DINOv3视觉基础模型和Swin Transformer，在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 玻璃作为透明材料缺乏视觉特征，使得从RGB图像进行玻璃分割具有挑战性，但这对场景理解和机器人应用至关重要，因为透明玻璃表面需要被识别为固体材料。
AI.method: 采用双主干架构：冻结的DINOv3视觉基础模型生成通用视觉特征，监督训练的Swin模型生成任务特定特征。多尺度特征表示通过残差Squeeze-and-Excitation通道降维处理，然后输入Mask2Former解码器生成最终分割掩码。
AI.result: 在四个常用玻璃分割数据集上评估，在多个准确度指标上达到最先进结果。与之前的最先进方法相比具有竞争力的推理速度，使用更轻量级DINOv3变体时性能更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双主干架构有效解决了玻璃分割的挑战，结合了基础模型的通用视觉特征和任务特定特征学习，在精度和速度方面都表现出色，为玻璃分割任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Quantum-Inspired Self-Attention in a Large Language Model
summary: Recent advances in Natural Language Processing have been predominantly driven by transformer-based architectures, which rely heavily on self-attention mechanisms to model relationships between tokens in a sequence. Similarly, the field of Quantum Natural Language Processing, which seeks to leverage quantum principles to address challenges in language understanding and generation tasks, has seen the recent development of quantum self-attention mechanisms. We propose a classical quantum-inspired self-attention (QISA) mechanism and integrate it into the full autoregressive language modeling pipeline of GPT-1. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first integration of this kind, as previous quantum self-attention mechanisms have been primarily tested on text classification. In our experiments, QISA achieves better performance when compared to standard self-attention on the metrics character error rate ($15.5\times$ better), word error rate ($4.7 \times $) and cross-entropy loss ($13 \times$). This is achieved while only requiring a $ 2.6\times$ longer inference time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个经典量子启发的自注意力机制（QISA），并将其集成到GPT-1的完整自回归语言建模流程中，在字符错误率、词错误率和交叉熵损失方面显著优于标准自注意力机制。
AI.motivation: 自然语言处理领域主要依赖基于transformer的架构，这些架构严重依赖自注意力机制来建模序列中token之间的关系。量子自然语言处理领域最近也开发了量子自注意力机制，但主要应用于文本分类任务。本研究旨在将量子启发的自注意力机制集成到完整的语言建模流程中。
AI.method: 提出了经典量子启发的自注意力机制（QISA），并将其集成到GPT-1的完整自回归语言建模流程中。这是首次将此类机制集成到完整的语言建模流程中，而不仅仅是文本分类任务。
AI.result: QISA在字符错误率（15.5倍更好）、词错误率（4.7倍更好）和交叉熵损失（13倍更好）等指标上显著优于标准自注意力机制，仅需要2.6倍更长的推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发的自注意力机制可以成功集成到完整的语言建模流程中，并在多个性能指标上显著优于传统自注意力机制，为量子启发的NLP方法提供了新的应用前景。

title: Automated Concept Discovery for LLM-as-a-Judge Preference Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as scalable evaluators of model outputs, but their preference judgments exhibit systematic biases and can diverge from human evaluations. Prior work on LLM-as-a-judge has largely focused on a small, predefined set of hypothesized biases, leaving open the problem of automatically discovering unknown drivers of LLM preferences. We address this gap by studying several embedding-level concept extraction methods for analyzing LLM judge behavior. We compare these methods in terms of interpretability and predictiveness, finding that sparse autoencoder-based approaches recover substantially more interpretable preference features than alternatives while remaining competitive in predicting LLM decisions. Using over 27k paired responses from multiple human preference datasets and judgments from three LLMs, we analyze LLM judgments and compare them to those of human annotators. Our method both validates existing results, such as the tendency for LLMs to prefer refusal of sensitive requests at higher rates than humans, and uncovers new trends across both general and domain-specific datasets, including biases toward responses that emphasize concreteness and empathy in approaching new situations, toward detail and formality in academic advice, and against legal guidance that promotes active steps like calling police and filing lawsuits. Our results show that automated concept discovery enables systematic analysis of LLM judge preferences without predefined bias taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出使用稀疏自编码器等嵌入级概念提取方法，自动发现LLM作为评估者时的偏好特征，无需预定义偏见分类，揭示了LLM与人类评估者的系统性差异。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作模型输出的可扩展评估者，但它们的偏好判断存在系统性偏见，且可能与人类评估结果不一致。先前研究主要关注少量预定义的假设偏见，缺乏自动发现未知LLM偏好驱动因素的方法。
AI.method: 研究比较了多种嵌入级概念提取方法，特别是稀疏自编码器方法，用于分析LLM评估者行为。使用超过27,000对来自多个人类偏好数据集的响应，以及三个LLM的评估结果，分析LLM判断并与人类标注者进行比较。
AI.result: 稀疏自编码器方法比其他方法恢复出更易解释的偏好特征，同时在预测LLM决策方面保持竞争力。研究验证了现有结果（如LLM更倾向于拒绝敏感请求），并发现了新的趋势：偏好强调具体性和共情的方法、学术建议中的细节和正式性，以及反对提倡报警和诉讼等主动步骤的法律指导。
AI.conclusion: 自动概念发现方法能够在不依赖预定义偏见分类的情况下，对LLM评估者偏好进行系统性分析，为理解LLM评估行为提供了新工具。

title: PROSPECT: Unified Streaming Vision-Language Navigation via Semantic--Spatial Fusion and Latent Predictive Representation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced zero-shot end-to-end Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), yet robust navigation requires not only semantic understanding but also predictive modeling of environment dynamics and spatial structure. We propose PROSPECT, a unified streaming navigation agent that couples a streaming Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy with latent predictive representation learning. PROSPECT uses CUT3R as a streaming 3D foundation spatial encoder to produce long-context, absolute-scale spatial features, and fuses them with SigLIP semantic features via cross-attention. During training, we introduce learnable stream query tokens that query the streaming context and predict next-step 2D and 3D latent features (rather than pixels or explicit modalities), supervised in the latent spaces of frozen SigLIP and CUT3R teachers. The predictive branch shapes internal representations without inference overhead. Experiments on VLN-CE benchmarks and real-robot deployment demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and improved long-horizon robustness under diverse lighting. We will release code for the community soon.

AI.tldr: PROSPECT是一个统一的流式导航智能体，结合流式视觉-语言-动作策略和潜在预测表示学习，通过预测2D和3D潜在特征来增强导航的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在视觉语言导航中虽然取得了进展，但鲁棒的导航不仅需要语义理解，还需要对环境动态和空间结构进行预测建模。
AI.method: 使用CUT3R作为流式3D基础空间编码器生成长上下文绝对尺度空间特征，通过交叉注意力与SigLIP语义特征融合；引入可学习的流查询令牌来预测下一步的2D和3D潜在特征，在冻结的SigLIP和CUT3R教师模型的潜在空间中进行监督训练。
AI.result: 在VLN-CE基准测试和真实机器人部署中展示了最先进的性能，并在不同光照条件下提高了长时程导航的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PROSPECT通过结合流式视觉-语言-动作策略和潜在预测表示学习，实现了更鲁棒的零样本端到端视觉语言导航，预测分支在不增加推理开销的情况下塑造了内部表示。

title: From We to Me: Theory Informed Narrative Shift with Abductive Reasoning
summary: Effective communication often relies on aligning a message with an audience's narrative and worldview. Narrative shift involves transforming text to reflect a different narrative framework while preserving its original core message--a task we demonstrate is significantly challenging for current Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this, we propose a neurosymbolic approach grounded in social science theory and abductive reasoning. Our method automatically extracts rules to abduce the specific story elements needed to guide an LLM through a consistent and targeted narrative transformation. Across multiple LLMs, abduction-guided transformed stories shifted the narrative while maintaining the fidelity with the original story. For example, with GPT-4o we outperform the zero-shot LLM baseline by 55.88% for collectivistic to individualistic narrative shift while maintaining superior semantic similarity with the original stories (40.4% improvement in KL divergence). For individualistic to collectivistic transformation, we achieve comparable improvements. We show similar performance across both directions for Llama-4, and Grok-4 and competitive performance for Deepseek-R1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于社会科学理论和溯因推理的神经符号方法，用于实现文本的叙事转换，在保持原始核心信息的同时将文本调整为不同的叙事框架，相比现有LLM基线有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 有效的沟通需要将信息与受众的叙事和世界观对齐。叙事转换任务要求将文本转换为反映不同叙事框架的形式，同时保持原始核心信息，这对当前的大型语言模型来说是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于社会科学理论和溯因推理的神经符号方法。该方法自动提取规则，通过溯因推理确定所需的故事元素，指导LLM进行一致且有目标的叙事转换。
AI.result: 在多个LLM上，溯因推理指导的转换故事成功实现了叙事转换，同时保持了与原始故事的一致性。例如，使用GPT-4o时，在集体主义到个人主义的叙事转换上比零样本LLM基线提升了55.88%，同时保持了更好的语义相似性（KL散度改善40.4%）。在个人主义到集体主义的转换上也取得了类似的改进。在Llama-4、Grok-4和Deepseek-R1模型上都表现出了相似的性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的神经符号方法能够有效指导LLM进行叙事转换，在保持原始故事核心信息的同时实现不同叙事框架的转换，相比现有方法有显著改进，为解决LLM在叙事对齐任务上的挑战提供了有效方案。

title: DAGE: Dual-Stream Architecture for Efficient and Fine-Grained Geometry Estimation
summary: Estimating accurate, view-consistent geometry and camera poses from uncalibrated multi-view/video inputs remains challenging - especially at high spatial resolutions and over long sequences. We present DAGE, a dual-stream transformer whose main novelty is to disentangle global coherence from fine detail. A low-resolution stream operates on aggressively downsampled frames with alternating frame/global attention to build a view-consistent representation and estimate cameras efficiently, while a high-resolution stream processes the original images per-frame to preserve sharp boundaries and small structures. A lightweight adapter fuses these streams via cross-attention, injecting global context without disturbing the pretrained single-frame pathway. This design scales resolution and clip length independently, supports inputs up to 2K, and maintains practical inference cost. DAGE delivers sharp depth/pointmaps, strong cross-view consistency, and accurate poses, establishing new state-of-the-art results for video geometry estimation and multi-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: DAGE是一个双流Transformer，通过分离全局一致性和细节处理，实现高分辨率、长序列的无标定多视角/视频几何估计
AI.motivation: 从无标定的多视角/视频输入中估计准确、视角一致的几何和相机姿态仍然具有挑战性，特别是在高空间分辨率和长序列情况下
AI.method: 提出双流Transformer：低分辨率流处理下采样帧，通过交替帧/全局注意力构建视角一致表示并估计相机姿态；高分辨率流处理原始图像以保留锐利边界和小结构；轻量级适配器通过交叉注意力融合两流
AI.result: DAGE能够处理高达2K分辨率的输入，独立扩展分辨率和片段长度，保持实用推理成本，产生锐利的深度/点云图、强跨视角一致性和准确姿态
AI.conclusion: DAGE在视频几何估计和多视角重建方面建立了新的最先进结果

title: DIALEVAL: Automated Type-Theoretic Evaluation of LLM Instruction Following
summary: Evaluating instruction following in Large Language Models requires decomposing instructions into verifiable requirements and assessing satisfaction--tasks currently dependent on manual annotation and uniform criteria that do not align with human judgment patterns. We present DIALEVAL, a type-theoretic framework using dual LLM agents to automate instruction decomposition into typed predicates and implement type-specific satisfaction semantics. The framework enforces formal atomicity and independence constraints during automated extraction, then applies differentiated evaluation criteria--semantic equivalence for content predicates, exact precision for numerical predicates--mirroring empirically observed human assessment patterns. Extended to multi-turn dialogues through history-aware satisfaction functions, DIALEVAL enables evaluation in conversational contexts where single-turn methods fail. Validation demonstrates 90.38% accuracy (26.45% error reduction over baselines) and substantially stronger correlation with human judgment for complex instructions.

AI.tldr: DIALEVAL：一个基于类型理论的框架，使用双LLM代理自动将指令分解为类型化谓词，并应用类型特定的满足语义来评估LLM的指令遵循能力
AI.motivation: 当前评估大型语言模型指令遵循能力的方法依赖于人工标注和统一标准，这些方法不符合人类判断模式，需要自动化且更符合人类评估模式的解决方案
AI.method: 使用双LLM代理框架，将指令自动分解为类型化谓词（如内容谓词、数值谓词），在提取过程中强制执行形式原子性和独立性约束，然后应用差异化的评估标准（语义等价用于内容谓词，精确匹配用于数值谓词）
AI.result: 验证显示DIALEVAL达到90.38%的准确率（比基线减少26.45%的错误率），并且在复杂指令评估中与人类判断有显著更强的相关性
AI.conclusion: DIALEVAL通过类型理论框架和差异化评估标准，实现了自动化、符合人类判断模式的指令遵循评估，并能扩展到多轮对话场景

title: Seeing as Experts Do: A Knowledge-Augmented Agent for Open-Set Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding is shifting from static classification to knowledge-augmented reasoning, where models must justify as well as recognise. Existing approaches remain limited by closed-set taxonomies and single-label prediction, leading to significant degradation under open-set or context-dependent conditions. We present the Knowledge-Augmented Fine-Grained Reasoning Agent (KFRA), a unified framework that transforms fine-grained perception into evidence-driven reasoning. KFRA operates through a three-stage closed reasoning loop that emulates expert analysis. It first performs open-vocabulary detection and web-scale retrieval to generate category hypotheses. It then conducts discriminative regions localisation by aligning textual knowledge with visual evidence through a global-to-local focusing mechanism. Finally, it integrates all multimodal evidence within a large multimodal model to perform interpretable reasoning. Unlike existing agents that treat retrieval and reasoning as independent processes, KFRA establishes a retrieval-grounding coupling that converts retrieved knowledge into spatially grounded evidence for verification. This design enables factual, interpretable, and task-agnostic reasoning across diverse fine-grained scenarios. To evaluate this capability, we construct FGExpertBench, a benchmark designed to assess reasoning depth and cross-task generalisation across six knowledge dimensions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KFRA consistently surpasses both standalone large multimodal models and current agent frameworks, achieving up to 19 percent improvement in reasoning accuracy and delivering evidence-grounded interpretability in open-set fine-grained visual understanding.

AI.tldr: KFRA是一个知识增强的细粒度推理代理，通过开放词汇检测、判别区域定位和多模态证据整合的三阶段闭环推理，将细粒度感知转化为证据驱动的推理，在开放集细粒度视觉理解中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度视觉理解方法受限于封闭集分类和单标签预测，在开放集或上下文依赖条件下性能显著下降。需要将细粒度感知从静态分类转变为知识增强的推理，使模型不仅能识别还能提供解释。
AI.method: KFRA采用三阶段闭环推理：1) 开放词汇检测和网络规模检索生成类别假设；2) 通过全局到局部的聚焦机制将文本知识与视觉证据对齐，进行判别区域定位；3) 在大规模多模态模型中整合所有多模态证据进行可解释推理。关键创新是检索-接地耦合，将检索到的知识转化为空间接地的证据进行验证。
AI.result: 在FGExpertBench基准测试中，KFRA在六个知识维度上持续超越独立的大规模多模态模型和现有代理框架，推理准确率提升高达19%，并在开放集细粒度视觉理解中提供证据接地的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: KFRA通过将细粒度感知转化为证据驱动的推理，实现了事实性、可解释性和任务无关的推理，为开放集细粒度视觉理解提供了统一的框架，显著提升了推理深度和跨任务泛化能力。

title: Discern Truth from Falsehood: Reducing Over-Refusal via Contrastive Refinement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) aligned for safety often suffer from over-refusal, the tendency to reject seemingly toxic or benign prompts by misclassifying them as toxic. This behavior undermines models' helpfulness and restricts usability in sensitive or nuanced contexts. While prior work has proposed mitigation strategies such as data augmentation and activation steering, these approaches often face a trade-off: reducing over-refusal typically degrades the model's ability to reject genuinely harmful content. We argue that this issue arises from the ambiguous influence of toxic and seemingly toxic prompts on the model's learning dynamics. To address it, we introduce a preceding alignment stage, DCR: Discernment via Contrastive Refinement. Both theoretically and empirically, we demonstrate that contrastive refinement improves an LLM's capacity to distinguish truly toxic prompts from superficially toxic ones. Evaluation across diverse benchmarks shows that our method effectively reduces over-refusal while preserving the safety benefits of alignment. Importantly, it achieves this with minimal degradation of general capabilities, offering a more principled and robust direction for safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCR方法，通过对比精炼提升LLM区分真正有害与表面有害提示的能力，在减少过度拒绝的同时保持安全对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐的大型语言模型经常出现过度拒绝问题，即错误地将看似有毒或良性的提示分类为有害而拒绝回答。这种行为削弱了模型的帮助性，限制了其在敏感或微妙情境中的可用性。现有缓解策略通常面临权衡：减少过度拒绝往往会降低模型拒绝真正有害内容的能力。
AI.method: 提出DCR（Discernment via Contrastive Refinement）方法，这是一个前置的对齐阶段。该方法通过对比精炼来提升LLM区分真正有毒提示与表面有毒提示的能力。从理论和实证两方面证明了对比精炼的有效性。
AI.result: 在多样化基准测试中，DCR方法有效减少了过度拒绝问题，同时保持了安全对齐的益处。重要的是，该方法在实现这一目标时对模型的一般能力影响最小。
AI.conclusion: DCR方法为安全对齐提供了一个更原则化和稳健的方向，能够在减少过度拒绝的同时保持安全性能，且对模型一般能力影响最小。

title: Controlling Chat Style in Language Models via Single-Direction Editing
summary: Controlling stylistic attributes in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging, with existing approaches relying on either prompt engineering or post-training alignment. This paper investigates this challenge through the lens of representation engineering, testing the hypothesis that distinct stylistic attributes - from emotional tone to linguistic structure - are encoded as linear directions in the model's activation space. We provide strong empirical evidence for this hypothesis across a wide range of styles and, based on this finding, present a lightweight, training-free method for precise style control. Our approach supports linear style composition, enhances safety by ablating undesirable behaviors, and, as confirmed by experiments on over a dozen models, achieves high style adherence while preserving core capabilities at minimal computational cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于表示工程的轻量级、无需训练的方法，通过线性方向控制LLM的风格属性，支持风格组合并增强安全性。
AI.motivation: 当前控制大语言模型风格属性的方法主要依赖提示工程或训练后对齐，这些方法存在局限性，需要探索更有效、轻量的控制方式。
AI.method: 基于表示工程，假设不同风格属性在模型激活空间中编码为线性方向，通过实验验证这一假设，并开发了无需训练的轻量级风格控制方法。
AI.result: 在十多个模型上的实验证实了风格属性确实编码为线性方向，该方法能实现高风格遵从度，同时保持核心能力，计算成本极低。
AI.conclusion: 风格属性在LLM激活空间中确实编码为线性方向，基于此的轻量级控制方法有效支持风格组合和安全增强，为模型风格控制提供了新途径。

title: IntroductionDMD-augmented Unpaired Neural Schrödinger Bridge for Ultra-Low Field MRI Enhancement
summary: Ultra Low Field (64 mT) brain MRI improves accessibility but suffers from reduced image quality compared to 3 T. As paired 64 mT - 3 T scans are scarce, we propose an unpaired 64 mT $\rightarrow$ 3 T translation framework that enhances realism while preserving anatomy. Our method builds upon the Unpaired Neural Schrödinge Bridge (UNSB) with multi-step refinement. To strengthen target distribution alignment, we augment the adversarial objective with DMD2-style diffusion-guided distribution matching using a frozen 3T diffusion teacher. To explicitly constrain global structure beyond patch-level correspondence, we combine PatchNCE with an Anatomical Structure Preservation (ASP) regularizer that enforces soft foreground background consistency and boundary aware constraints. Evaluated on two disjoint cohorts, the proposed framework achieves an improved realism structure trade-off, enhancing distribution level realism on unpaired benchmarks while increasing structural fidelity on the paired cohort compared to unpaired baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无配对的64mT到3T MRI图像转换框架，通过多步精炼和扩散引导的分布匹配来提升图像真实感，同时保持解剖结构
AI.motivation: 超低场（64mT）脑部MRI提高了可及性，但图像质量相比3T有所下降。由于配对的64mT-3T扫描数据稀缺，需要开发无配对的图像转换方法
AI.method: 基于无配对神经薛定谔桥（UNSB）构建多步精炼框架，通过DMD2风格的扩散引导分布匹配增强目标分布对齐，结合PatchNCE和解剖结构保持（ASP）正则化器来约束全局结构
AI.result: 在两个独立队列上评估，该框架在无配对基准上提升了分布级真实感，在配对队列上相比无配对基线提高了结构保真度，实现了更好的真实感-结构权衡
AI.conclusion: 提出的无配对64mT→3T转换框架能够有效增强图像真实感同时保持解剖结构，为超低场MRI图像质量提升提供了有效解决方案

title: IntPro: A Proxy Agent for Context-Aware Intent Understanding via Retrieval-conditioned Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become integral to modern Human-AI collaboration workflows, where accurately understanding user intent serves as a crucial step for generating satisfactory responses. Context-aware intent understanding, which involves inferring user intentions from situational environments, is inherently challenging because it requires reasoning over both the immediate context and the user's underlying motivations that drive their behavior. Moreover, existing approaches often treat intent understanding as a static recognition task, overlooking users' accumulated intent patterns that could provide valuable references for more accurate and generalizable understanding. To address this gap, we propose IntPro, a proxy agent that learns to adapt to individual users via retrieval-conditioned intent inference. We design intent explanations that abstract how contextual signals connect to expressed intents, and store them in an individual intent history library for retrieval. We train IntPro through supervised fine-tuning on retrieval-conditioned trajectories and multi-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tool-aware reward functions, enabling the agent to learn when to leverage historical intent patterns and when to infer directly. Experiments across three diverse scenarios (Highlight-Intent, MIntRec2.0, and Weibo Post-Sync) demonstrate that IntPro achieves strong intent understanding performance with effective context-aware reasoning capabilities across different scenarios and model types.

AI.tldr: IntPro是一个通过检索条件意图推理来适应个体用户的代理系统，它通过存储和检索历史意图模式来提升上下文感知的意图理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型在人类-AI协作中需要准确理解用户意图，但上下文感知的意图理解具有挑战性，因为它需要同时推理即时上下文和用户潜在动机。现有方法通常将意图理解视为静态识别任务，忽略了用户积累的意图模式，而这些模式可以为更准确和可泛化的理解提供有价值的参考。
AI.method: 提出IntPro代理系统，设计意图解释来抽象上下文信号与表达意图的连接关系，并将其存储在个体意图历史库中供检索。通过检索条件轨迹的监督微调和多轮组相对策略优化（GRPO）以及工具感知奖励函数进行训练，使代理能够学习何时利用历史意图模式，何时直接推理。
AI.result: 在三个不同场景（Highlight-Intent、MIntRec2.0和Weibo Post-Sync）的实验表明，IntPro在不同场景和模型类型中实现了强大的意图理解性能，并具有有效的上下文感知推理能力。
AI.conclusion: IntPro通过检索条件意图推理和个体意图历史库的学习机制，成功解决了上下文感知意图理解的挑战，为更准确和可泛化的人类-AI协作意图理解提供了有效解决方案。

title: Controllable and explainable personality sliders for LLMs at inference time
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with specific personas typically relies on expensive and monolithic Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) or RLHF. While effective, these methods require training distinct models for every target personality profile. Inference-time activation steering offers a parameter-efficient alternative, yet naive approaches fail to control multiple traits simultaneously due to destructive vector interference. In this work, we propose a modular framework for continuous, multi-dimensional personality control. Our key innovation is Sequential Adaptive Steering (SAS): a method that orthogonalizes steering vectors by training subsequent probes on the residual stream shifted by prior interventions. This approach transforms steering vectors into reusable primitives, allowing users to instantly synthesize complex, high-fidelity personality profiles by simply adjusting coefficients alpha. We validate our framework on the Big Five personality traits, demonstrating that it outperforms naive baselines in both goal adherence and coherence, enabling precise, holistic personality modulation without updating model parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出SAS方法，通过正交化控制向量实现多维度人格调控，无需更新模型参数
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要为每个人格配置文件训练独立模型，成本高昂；现有推理时激活导向方法无法同时控制多个特质
AI.method: 提出顺序自适应导向(SAS)框架，通过训练后续探针在先前干预的残差流上正交化控制向量，将其转化为可重用基元
AI.result: 在Big Five人格特质上验证，在目标遵循性和连贯性方面优于基线方法，实现精确、整体的人格调控
AI.conclusion: SAS提供模块化框架，通过调整系数即可合成复杂人格配置文件，实现参数高效的多维度人格控制

title: TAP: A Token-Adaptive Predictor Framework for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but remain slow at inference due to the need for repeated full-model denoising passes. We present Token-Adaptive Predictor (TAP), a training-free, probe-driven framework that adaptively selects a predictor for each token at every sampling step. TAP uses a single full evaluation of the model's first layer as a low-cost probe to compute proxy losses for a compact family of candidate predictors (instantiated primarily with Taylor expansions of varying order and horizon), then assigns each token the predictor with the smallest proxy error. This per-token "probe-then-select" strategy exploits heterogeneous temporal dynamics, requires no additional training, and is compatible with various predictor designs. TAP incurs negligible overhead while enabling large speedups with little or no perceptual quality loss. Extensive experiments across multiple diffusion architectures and generation tasks show that TAP substantially improves the accuracy-efficiency frontier compared to fixed global predictors and caching-only baselines.

AI.tldr: TAP是一种无需训练、基于探针驱动的框架，通过自适应为每个token选择预测器来加速扩散模型推理，仅需单次模型第一层评估作为低成本探针，实现显著加速且几乎不损失感知质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽然生成性能强大，但由于需要重复的完整模型去噪过程，推理速度仍然很慢。现有方法通常使用固定的全局预测器，无法充分利用token间的异质性动态特性。
AI.method: TAP采用"探针-选择"策略：1）使用模型第一层的单次评估作为低成本探针；2）为紧凑的候选预测器家族（主要是不同阶数和视野的泰勒展开）计算代理损失；3）为每个token选择代理误差最小的预测器。该方法无需额外训练，兼容各种预测器设计。
AI.result: TAP在多个扩散架构和生成任务上的实验表明，与固定全局预测器和仅缓存基线相比，TAP显著改善了准确率-效率边界，实现了大幅加速且几乎不损失感知质量，同时计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: TAP通过自适应为每个token选择预测器的训练免费框架，有效利用了token间的异质性时间动态，在保持扩散模型高质量生成的同时显著提升了推理效率。

title: Separators in Enhancing Autoregressive Pretraining for Vision Mamba
summary: The state space model Mamba has recently emerged as a promising paradigm in computer vision, attracting significant attention due to its efficient processing of long sequence tasks. Mamba's inherent causal mechanism renders it particularly suitable for autoregressive pretraining. However, current autoregressive pretraining methods are constrained to short sequence tasks, failing to fully exploit Mamba's prowess in handling extended sequences. To address this limitation, we introduce an innovative autoregressive pretraining method for Vision Mamba that substantially extends the input sequence length. We introduce new \textbf{S}epara\textbf{T}ors for \textbf{A}uto\textbf{R}egressive pretraining to demarcate and differentiate between different images, known as \textbf{STAR}. Specifically, we insert identical separators before each image to demarcate its inception. This strategy enables us to quadruple the input sequence length of Vision Mamba while preserving the original dimensions of the dataset images. Employing this long sequence pretraining technique, our STAR-B model achieved an impressive accuracy of 83.5\% on ImageNet-1k, which is highly competitive in Vision Mamba. These results underscore the potential of our method in enhancing the performance of vision models through improved leveraging of long-range dependencies.

AI.tldr: STAR方法通过引入分隔符来区分不同图像，将Vision Mamba的自回归预训练序列长度扩展了四倍，在ImageNet-1k上达到83.5%的准确率。
AI.motivation: Mamba模型在处理长序列任务方面表现出色，但现有的自回归预训练方法仅限于短序列任务，未能充分利用Mamba处理扩展序列的能力。
AI.method: 提出STAR方法，在每张图像前插入相同的分隔符来界定图像起始位置，从而将Vision Mamba的输入序列长度扩展四倍，同时保持数据集图像的原始尺寸。
AI.result: STAR-B模型在ImageNet-1k上达到了83.5%的准确率，在Vision Mamba模型中具有高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过更好地利用长程依赖关系，展示了提升视觉模型性能的潜力，特别是在扩展序列长度方面。

title: StructLens: A Structural Lens for Language Models via Maximum Spanning Trees
summary: Language exhibits inherent structures, a property that explains both language acquisition and language change. Given this characteristic, we expect language models to manifest internal structures as well. While interpretability research has investigated the components of language models, existing approaches focus on local inter-token relationships within layers or modules (e.g., Multi-Head Attention), leaving global inter-layer relationships largely overlooked. To address this gap, we introduce StructLens, an analytical framework designed to reveal how internal structures relate holistically through their inter-token connection within a layer. StructLens constructs maximum spanning trees based on the semantic representations in residual streams, analogous to dependency parsing, and leverages the tree properties to quantify inter-layer distance (or similarity) from a structural perspective. Our findings demonstrate that StructLens yields an inter-layer similarity pattern that is distinctively different from conventional cosine similarity. Moreover, this structure-aware similarity proves to be beneficial for practical tasks, such as layer pruning, highlighting the effectiveness of structural analysis for understanding and optimizing language models. Our code is available at https://github.com/naist-nlp/structlens.

AI.tldr: StructLens是一个分析语言模型内部结构的框架，通过构建基于残差流语义表示的最大生成树来量化层间结构相似性，与传统余弦相似度不同且对层剪枝等任务有益。
AI.motivation: 语言具有内在结构特性，语言模型也应体现内部结构。现有可解释性研究主要关注层内或模块内的局部token关系，而忽略了全局的层间结构关系。
AI.method: 提出StructLens框架，基于残差流中的语义表示构建最大生成树（类似依存句法分析），利用树属性从结构角度量化层间距离或相似性。
AI.result: StructLens产生的层间相似性模式与传统余弦相似度明显不同，这种结构感知的相似性对层剪枝等实际任务有益，证明了结构分析对理解和优化语言模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构分析是理解和优化语言模型的有效方法，StructLens框架能够揭示语言模型内部的全局结构关系，为模型可解释性和优化提供了新视角。

title: AutoHarness: improving LLM agents by automatically synthesizing a code harness
comment: agent harness, code synthesis, self-improvement, code-as-policy, text games
summary: Despite significant strides in language models in the last few years, when used as agents, such models often try to perform actions that are not just suboptimal for a given state, but are strictly prohibited by the external environment. For example, in the recent Kaggle GameArena chess competition, 78% of Gemini-2.5-Flash losses were attributed to illegal moves. Often people manually write "harnesses" around LLMs to prevent such failures. In this paper, we demonstrate that Gemini-2.5-Flash can automatically synthesize such a code harness, using a small number of rounds of iterative code refinement given feedback from the (game) environment. The resulting harness prevents all illegal moves in 145 different TextArena games (both 1-player and 2-player), enabling the smaller Gemini-2.5-Flash model to outperform larger models, such as Gemini-2.5-Pro. Pushing our technique to the limit, we can get Gemini-2.5-Flash to generate the entire policy in code, thus eliminating the need to use the LLM at decision making time. The resulting code-policy receives a higher average reward than Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5.2-High on 16 TextArena 1-player games. Our results show that using a smaller model to synthesize a custom code harness (or entire policy) can outperform a much larger model, while also being more cost effective.

AI.tldr: 使用Gemini-2.5-Flash通过迭代代码精炼自动生成代码约束系统，防止语言模型在游戏环境中做出非法动作，使较小模型性能超越较大模型。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型作为智能体时经常尝试执行外部环境严格禁止的动作（如国际象棋中的非法走法），导致性能损失。传统方法需要人工编写约束代码，效率低下。
AI.method: 让Gemini-2.5-Flash通过少量迭代代码精炼自动合成代码约束系统，利用游戏环境的反馈进行改进。进一步扩展该方法，让模型生成完整的代码策略，消除决策时对LLM的依赖。
AI.result: 生成的约束系统在145个TextArena游戏中完全防止了非法动作，使较小的Gemini-2.5-Flash性能超越较大的Gemini-2.5-Pro。代码策略在16个单人游戏中平均奖励超过Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5.2-High。
AI.conclusion: 使用较小模型合成定制代码约束系统或完整策略可以超越较大模型性能，同时更具成本效益，为LLM智能体部署提供了高效解决方案。

title: Vector-Quantized Soft Label Compression for Dataset Distillation
summary: Dataset distillation is an emerging technique for reducing the computational and storage costs of training machine learning models by synthesizing a small, informative subset of data that captures the essential characteristics of a much larger dataset. Recent methods pair synthetic samples and their augmentations with soft labels from a teacher model, enabling student models to generalize effectively despite the small size of the distilled dataset. While soft labels are critical for effective distillation, the storage and communication overhead they incur, especially when accounting for augmentations, is often overlooked. In practice, each distilled sample is associated with multiple soft labels, making them the dominant contributor to storage costs, particularly in large-class settings such as ImageNet-1K. In this paper, we present a rigorous analysis of bit requirements across dataset distillation frameworks, quantifying the storage demands of both distilled samples and their soft labels. To address the overhead, we introduce a vector-quantized autoencoder (VQAE) for compressing soft labels, achieving substantial compression while preserving the effectiveness of the distilled data. We validate our method on both vision and language distillation benchmarks. On ImageNet-1K, our proposed VQAE achieves 30--40x additional compression over RDED, LPLD, SRE2L, and CDA baselines while retaining over $90\%$ of their original performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用向量量化自编码器(VQAE)压缩数据集蒸馏中的软标签，解决了软标签存储和通信开销过大的问题，在ImageNet-1K上实现了30-40倍的额外压缩，同时保持90%以上的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏技术通过合成小型信息子集来降低机器学习训练的计算和存储成本，但现有方法中软标签（特别是考虑数据增强时）的存储和通信开销被忽视。每个蒸馏样本关联多个软标签，在大规模分类任务（如ImageNet-1K）中成为存储成本的主要贡献者。
AI.method: 首先对数据集蒸馏框架中的比特需求进行严格分析，量化蒸馏样本和软标签的存储需求。然后引入向量量化自编码器(VQAE)来压缩软标签，在保持蒸馏数据有效性的同时实现显著压缩。
AI.result: 在视觉和语言蒸馏基准测试中验证了方法的有效性。在ImageNet-1K上，提出的VQAE方法相比RDED、LPLD、SRE2L和CDA基线实现了30-40倍的额外压缩，同时保持了超过90%的原始性能。
AI.conclusion: 软标签压缩是解决数据集蒸馏存储开销问题的关键，VQAE方法能够在不显著损失性能的情况下大幅减少存储需求，为实际应用中的数据集蒸馏提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Certainty robustness: Evaluating LLM stability under self-challenging prompts
comment: 20 pages, 7 tables Benchmark and evaluation study of large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often present answers with high apparent confidence despite lacking an explicit mechanism for reasoning about certainty or truth. While existing benchmarks primarily evaluate single-turn accuracy, truthfulness or confidence calibration, they do not capture how models behave when their responses are challenged in interactive settings. We introduce the Certainty Robustness Benchmark, a two-turn evaluation framework that measures how LLMs balance stability and adaptability under self-challenging prompts such as uncertainty ("Are you sure?") and explicit contradiction ("You are wrong!"), alongside numeric confidence elicitation. Using 200 reasoning and mathematics questions from LiveBench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art LLMs and distinguish between justified self-corrections and unjustified answer changes. Our results reveal substantial differences in interactive reliability that are not explained by baseline accuracy alone: some models abandon correct answers under conversational pressure, while others demonstrate strong resistance to challenge and better alignment between confidence and correctness. These findings identify certainty robustness as a distinct and critical dimension of LLM evaluation, with important implications for alignment, trustworthiness and real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了"确定性鲁棒性基准"来评估大语言模型在受到挑战时的表现，发现模型在交互压力下的可靠性存在显著差异，这不能仅通过基线准确性来解释。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估单轮准确性、真实性或置信度校准，但无法捕捉模型在交互环境中受到挑战时的行为。大语言模型通常以高度自信呈现答案，但缺乏明确的机制来推理确定性或真实性。
AI.method: 引入确定性鲁棒性基准，这是一个两轮评估框架，测量LLM在自我挑战提示下的稳定性和适应性平衡。使用LiveBench中的200个推理和数学问题，评估四种最先进的LLM，区分合理的自我纠正和不合理的答案变化。
AI.result: 结果显示交互可靠性存在显著差异：一些模型在对话压力下放弃正确答案，而其他模型表现出对挑战的强大抵抗力和置信度与正确性之间更好的对齐。这些差异不能仅通过基线准确性来解释。
AI.conclusion: 确定性鲁棒性是LLM评估的一个独特而关键的维度，对对齐、可信度和实际部署具有重要影响。该基准揭示了模型在交互压力下的行为模式，为更全面的评估提供了新视角。

title: Structure-aware Prompt Adaptation from Seen to Unseen for Open-Vocabulary Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: The goal of Open-Vocabulary Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (OV-CZSL) is to recognize attribute-object compositions in the open-vocabulary setting, where compositions of both seen and unseen attributes and objects are evaluated. Recently, prompt tuning methods have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities in the closed setting, where only compositions of seen attributes and objects are evaluated, i.e., Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL). However, directly applying these methods to OV-CZSL may not be sufficient to generalize to unseen attributes, objects and their compositions, as it is limited to seen attributes and objects. Normally, when faced with unseen concepts, humans adopt analogies with seen concepts that have the similar semantics thereby inferring their meaning (e.g., "wet" and "damp", "shirt" and "jacket"). In this paper, we experimentally show that the distribution of semantically related attributes or objects tends to form consistent local structures in the embedding space. Based on the above structures, we propose Structure-aware Prompt Adaptation (SPA) method, which enables models to generalize from seen to unseen attributes and objects.
