Specifically, in the training stage, we design a Structure-aware Consistency Loss (SCL) that encourages the local structure's consistency of seen attributes and objects in each iteration. In the inference stage, we devise a Structure-guided Adaptation Strategy (SAS) that adaptively aligns the structures of unseen attributes and objects with those of trained seen attributes and objects with similar semantics. Notably, SPA is a plug-and-play method that can be seamlessly integrated into existing CZSL prompt tuning methods. Extensive experiments on OV-CZSL benchmarks demonstrate that SPA achieves competitive closed-set performance while significantly improving open-vocabulary results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPA方法，通过保持语义相关属性/对象在嵌入空间的局部结构一致性，提升开放词汇组合零样本学习性能。
AI.motivation: 现有提示调优方法在封闭组合零样本学习(CZSL)中表现良好，但在开放词汇组合零样本学习(OV-CZSL)中难以泛化到未见属性、对象及其组合。人类面对新概念时会通过与语义相似的已知概念类比来推理，因此研究如何利用嵌入空间中的语义结构一致性来提升模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出结构感知提示适应(SPA)方法：1)训练阶段设计结构一致性损失(SCL)，鼓励每次迭代中可见属性/对象的局部结构一致性；2)推理阶段设计结构引导适应策略(SAS)，自适应地将未见属性/对象的结构与语义相似的已训练可见属性/对象对齐。SPA是即插即用方法，可与现有CZSL提示调优方法无缝集成。
AI.result: 在OV-CZSL基准测试上的大量实验表明，SPA在保持竞争力的封闭集性能的同时，显著提升了开放词汇结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过保持嵌入空间中语义相关概念的结构一致性，SPA方法能够有效提升模型从已知到未知属性、对象的泛化能力，为开放词汇组合零样本学习提供了有效的解决方案。

title: From Narrow to Panoramic Vision: Attention-Guided Cold-Start Reshapes Multimodal Reasoning
summary: The cold-start initialization stage plays a pivotal role in training Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs), yet its mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. To analyze this stage, we introduce the Visual Attention Score (VAS), an attention-based metric that quantifies how much a model attends to visual tokens. We find that reasoning performance is strongly correlated with VAS (r=0.9616): models with higher VAS achieve substantially stronger multimodal reasoning. Surprisingly, multimodal cold-start fails to elevate VAS, resulting in attention distributions close to the base model, whereas text-only cold-start leads to a clear increase. We term this counter-intuitive phenomenon Lazy Attention Localization. To validate its causal role, we design training-free interventions that directly modulate attention allocation during inference, performance gains of 1$-$2% without any retraining. Building on these insights, we further propose Attention-Guided Visual Anchoring and Reflection (AVAR), a comprehensive cold-start framework that integrates visual-anchored data synthesis, attention-guided objectives, and visual-anchored reward shaping. Applied to Qwen2.5-VL-7B, AVAR achieves an average gain of 7.0% across 7 multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Ablation studies further confirm that each component of AVAR contributes step-wise to the overall gains. The code, data, and models are available at https://github.com/lrlbbzl/Qwen-AVAR.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了多模态大推理模型（MLRMs）的冷启动初始化阶段，发现视觉注意力分数（VAS）与推理性能高度相关，并揭示了"懒惰注意力定位"现象。基于此提出了AVAR框架，显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大推理模型的冷启动初始化阶段对训练至关重要，但其工作机制尚未得到充分理解。研究者希望深入分析这一阶段，揭示影响模型性能的关键因素。
AI.method:
1. 提出视觉注意力分数（VAS）作为量化模型对视觉token关注程度的指标
2. 发现VAS与推理性能的高度相关性
3. 揭示"懒惰注意力定位"现象：多模态冷启动未能提升VAS
4. 设计无需训练的干预措施验证因果关系
5. 提出AVAR框架：包括视觉锚定数据合成、注意力引导目标和视觉锚定奖励塑造三个组件
AI.result:
1. VAS与推理性能高度相关（r=0.9616）
2. 无需训练的注意力干预可获得1-2%的性能提升
3. AVAR框架在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，在7个多模态推理基准测试中平均提升7.0%
4. 消融研究证实AVAR各组件对性能提升均有贡献
AI.conclusion: 冷启动初始化阶段对多模态大推理模型的性能至关重要，视觉注意力分配是影响推理能力的关键因素。提出的AVAR框架通过系统化的注意力引导策略，显著提升了模型的多模态推理性能。

title: Fragile Thoughts: How Large Language Models Handle Chain-of-Thought Perturbations
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has emerged as a foundational technique for eliciting reasoning from Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the robustness of this approach to corruptions in intermediate reasoning steps remains poorly understood. This paper presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of LLM robustness to a structured taxonomy of 5 CoT perturbation types: \textit{MathError, UnitConversion, Sycophancy, SkippedSteps,} and \textit{ExtraSteps}. We evaluate 13 models spanning three orders of magnitude in parameter count (3B to 1.5T\footnote{Assumed parameter count of closed models}), testing their ability to complete mathematical reasoning tasks despite perturbations injected at different points in the reasoning chain. Our key findings reveal heterogeneous vulnerability patterns: MathError perturbations produce the most severe degradation in small models (50-60\% accuracy loss) but show strong scaling benefits; UnitConversion remains challenging across all scales (20-30\% loss even for largest models); ExtraSteps incur minimal accuracy degradation (0-6\%) regardless of scale; Sycophancy produces modest effects (7\% loss for small models); and SkippedSteps cause intermediate damage (15\% loss). Scaling relationships follow power-law patterns, with model size serving as a protective factor against some perturbations but offering limited defense against dimensional reasoning tasks. These findings have direct implications for deploying LLMs in multi-stage reasoning pipelines and underscore the necessity of task-specific robustness assessments and mitigation strategies. The code and results are available \href{https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/CoTPerturbation}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大型语言模型对思维链推理中五种扰动的鲁棒性，发现不同扰动类型对模型性能影响差异显著，模型规模对某些扰动有保护作用但对维度推理任务防御有限。
AI.motivation: 思维链提示已成为激发大型语言模型推理能力的基础技术，但其对中间推理步骤中扰动的鲁棒性尚未得到充分理解。本研究旨在系统评估LLM对思维链推理中结构化扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建了5种思维链扰动类型的结构化分类法：数学错误、单位转换、迎合性、跳过步骤和额外步骤。评估了13个模型，参数规模跨越3个数量级（3B到1.5T），测试它们在数学推理任务中面对不同位置注入扰动的能力。
AI.result: 发现异质性脆弱模式：数学错误扰动对小模型影响最严重（50-60%准确率损失）但随规模扩大改善明显；单位转换在所有规模上都具挑战性（即使最大模型也有20-30%损失）；额外步骤影响最小（0-6%损失）；迎合性影响中等（小模型7%损失）；跳过步骤造成中等损害（15%损失）。缩放关系遵循幂律模式，模型规模对某些扰动有保护作用但对维度推理任务防御有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对在多阶段推理管道中部署LLM具有直接意义，强调了任务特定鲁棒性评估和缓解策略的必要性。代码和结果已开源。

title: Universal Pansharpening Foundation Model
summary: Pansharpening generates the high-resolution multi-spectral (MS) image by integrating spatial details from a texture-rich panchromatic (PAN) image and spectral attributes from a low-resolution MS image. Existing methods are predominantly satellite-specific and scene-dependent, which severely limits their generalization across heterogeneous sensors and varied scenes, thereby reducing their real-world practicality. To address these challenges, we present FoundPS, a universal pansharpening foundation model for satellite-agnostic and scene-robust fusion. Specifically, we introduce a modality-interleaved transformer that learns band-wise modal specializations to form reversible spectral affine bases, mapping arbitrary-band MS into a unified latent space via tensor multiplication. Building upon this, we construct a latent diffusion bridge model to progressively evolve latent representations, and incorporate bridge posterior sampling to couple latent diffusion with pixel-space observations, enabling stable and controllable fusion. Furthermore, we devise infinite-dimensional pixel-to-latent interaction mechanisms to comprehensively capture the cross-domain dependencies between PAN observations and MS representations, thereby facilitating complementary information fusion. In addition, to support large-scale training and evaluation, we construct a comprehensive pansharpening benchmark, termed PSBench, consisting of worldwide MS and PAN image pairs from multiple satellites across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FoundPS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, exhibiting superior generalization and robustness across a wide range of pansharpening tasks.

AI.tldr: FoundPS是一个通用的全色锐化基础模型，通过模态交错变换器学习波段模态特性，构建潜在扩散桥模型，实现卫星无关和场景鲁棒的全色锐化融合。
AI.motivation: 现有全色锐化方法主要针对特定卫星和场景，泛化能力差，限制了在实际应用中的实用性。需要开发能够适应不同传感器和场景的通用融合方法。
AI.method: 1) 引入模态交错变换器学习波段模态特性，形成可逆光谱仿射基，将任意波段多光谱图像映射到统一潜在空间；2) 构建潜在扩散桥模型逐步演化潜在表示；3) 采用桥后验采样将潜在扩散与像素空间观测耦合；4) 设计无限维像素到潜在交互机制捕获全色观测与多光谱表示之间的跨域依赖关系。
AI.result: FoundPS在广泛的全色锐化任务中始终优于最先进方法，表现出卓越的泛化能力和鲁棒性。同时构建了PSBench基准数据集，包含来自多个卫星的全球多光谱和全色图像对。
AI.conclusion: FoundPS是一个通用的全色锐化基础模型，能够实现卫星无关和场景鲁棒的融合，解决了现有方法泛化能力差的问题，具有更好的实际应用价值。

title: Training-free Dropout Sampling for Semantic Token Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by proposing tokens with a lightweight draft model and selectively accepting them using a target model. This work introduces DropMatch, a novel approach that matches draft tokens to the predictive distribution of the target model via Monte Carlo dropout applied exclusively to the LM head, enabling sampling-based acceptance decisions. By generating multiple decoding paths, our method forms an empirical token distribution against which draft tokens are evaluated for consistency. This acceptance mechanism enables the model to adaptively control the size of decoding paths under an appropriate dropout probability, preventing substantial distortion of the target model predictive distribution. The proposed method operates in a training-free, data-free, and calibration-free manner, requires no architectural modification to pretrained models, and can be orthogonally integrated with a wide range of existing speculative decoding and inference acceleration techniques. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach increases acceptance length while maintaining competitive task performance, yielding inference speedups ranging from 1.09x to 1.33x over the standard baseline, and up to an additional 1.09x speedup when applied on top of EAGLE3.

AI.tldr: DropMatch是一种新的推测解码方法，通过LM头的蒙特卡洛dropout匹配草稿token与目标模型的预测分布，实现基于采样的接受决策，无需训练、数据或模型修改。
AI.motivation: 推测解码通过轻量级草稿模型提出token并用目标模型选择接受来加速大语言模型推理，但现有方法在匹配草稿token与目标模型预测分布方面存在挑战。
AI.method: DropMatch在LM头上应用蒙特卡洛dropout，生成多个解码路径形成经验token分布，评估草稿token的一致性，自适应控制解码路径大小，防止目标模型预测分布失真。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法增加了接受长度，保持竞争性任务性能，推理加速比标准基线提高1.09x到1.33x，在EAGLE3基础上还能获得额外1.09x加速。
AI.conclusion: DropMatch提供了一种无需训练、数据、校准或模型修改的推测解码方法，可与现有加速技术正交集成，有效提升大语言模型推理效率。

title: All-in-One Image Restoration via Causal-Deconfounding Wavelet-Disentangled Prompt Network
summary: Image restoration represents a promising approach for addressing the inherent defects of image content distortion. Standard image restoration approaches suffer from high storage cost and the requirement towards the known degradation pattern, including type and degree, which can barely be satisfied in dynamic practical scenarios. In contrast, all-in-one image restoration (AiOIR) eliminates multiple degradations within a unified model to circumvent the aforementioned issues. However, according to our causal analysis, we disclose that two significant defects still exacerbate the effectiveness and generalization of AiOIR models: 1) the spurious correlation between non-degradation semantic features and degradation patterns; 2) the biased estimation of degradation patterns. To obtain the true causation between degraded images and restored images, we propose Causal-deconfounding Wavelet-disentangled Prompt Network (CWP-Net) to perform effective AiOIR. CWP-Net introduces two modules for decoupling, i.e., wavelet attention module of encoder and wavelet attention module of decoder. These modules explicitly disentangle the degradation and semantic features to tackle the issue of spurious correlation. To address the issue stemming from the biased estimation of degradation patterns, CWP-Net leverages a wavelet prompt block to generate the alternative variable for causal deconfounding. Extensive experiments on two all-in-one settings prove the effectiveness and superior performance of our proposed CWP-Net over the state-of-the-art AiOIR methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CWP-Net，一种基于因果解耦的小波提示网络，用于解决全场景图像修复中的伪相关性和退化模式估计偏差问题，通过小波注意力模块和提示块实现有效解耦和去混淆。
AI.motivation: 传统图像修复方法存在存储成本高、需要已知退化模式的限制，而全场景图像修复(AiOIR)虽能统一处理多种退化，但仍存在两个关键缺陷：1)非退化语义特征与退化模式之间的伪相关性；2)退化模式的偏差估计，这些限制了AiOIR模型的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出Causal-deconfounding Wavelet-disentangled Prompt Network (CWP-Net)，包含两个核心模块：编码器小波注意力模块和解码器小波注意力模块，用于显式解耦退化特征和语义特征；以及小波提示块，用于生成替代变量进行因果去混淆。
AI.result: 在两个全场景设置上的大量实验证明，CWP-Net相比最先进的AiOIR方法具有更好的有效性和优越性能。
AI.conclusion: CWP-Net通过因果解耦和小波提示机制，成功解决了AiOIR中的伪相关性和退化模式估计偏差问题，实现了更有效的全场景图像修复。

title: The CompMath-MCQ Dataset: Are LLMs Ready for Higher-Level Math?
summary: The evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) on mathematical reasoning has largely focused on elementary problems, competition-style questions, or formal theorem proving, leaving graduate-level and computational mathematics relatively underexplored. We introduce CompMath-MCQ, a new benchmark dataset for assessing LLMs on advanced mathematical reasoning in a multiple-choice setting. The dataset consists of 1{,}500 originally authored questions by professors of graduate-level courses, covering topics including Linear Algebra, Numerical Optimization, Vector Calculus, Probability, and Python-based scientific computing. Three option choices are provided for each question, with exactly one of them being correct. To ensure the absence of data leakage, all questions are newly created and not sourced from existing materials. The validity of questions is verified through a procedure based on cross-LLM disagreement, followed by manual expert review. By adopting a multiple-choice format, our dataset enables objective, reproducible, and bias-free evaluation through lm_eval library. Baseline results with state-of-the-art LLMs indicate that advanced computational mathematical reasoning remains a significant challenge. We release CompMath-MCQ at the following link: https://github.com/biancaraimondi/CompMath-MCQ.git

AI.tldr: CompMath-MCQ是一个包含1500道原创选择题的基准数据集，用于评估大语言模型在研究生级别计算数学推理能力上的表现，涵盖线性代数、数值优化、向量微积分、概率论和Python科学计算等主题。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在数学推理评估主要集中在初级问题、竞赛题或形式化定理证明，而研究生级别和计算数学相对未被充分探索，需要专门的基准来评估模型在高级数学推理方面的能力。
AI.method: 1. 创建包含1500道原创选择题的数据集，由研究生课程教授编写；2. 涵盖线性代数、数值优化、向量微积分、概率论和Python科学计算五个主题；3. 每道题提供三个选项，只有一个正确答案；4. 通过跨LLM分歧分析和专家手动审查确保问题有效性；5. 使用lm_eval库进行客观、可重复、无偏见的评估。
AI.result: 基线测试结果显示，最先进的大语言模型在高级计算数学推理方面仍然面临重大挑战，表明该领域对现有模型来说难度较大。
AI.conclusion: CompMath-MCQ填补了高级数学推理评估的空白，为客观评估大语言模型在研究生级别计算数学能力提供了标准化基准，揭示了当前模型在该领域的局限性。

title: DeepScan: A Training-Free Framework for Visually Grounded Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Humans can robustly localize visual evidence and provide grounded answers even in noisy environments by identifying critical cues and then relating them to the full context in a bottom-up manner. Inspired by this, we propose DeepScan, a training-free framework that combines Hierarchical Scanning, Refocusing, and Evidence-Enhanced Reasoning for visually grounded reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Unlike existing methods that pursue one-shot localization of complete evidence, Hierarchical Scanning performs local cue exploration and multi-scale evidence extraction to recover evidence in a bottom-up manner, effectively mitigating the impacts of distractive context. Refocusing then optimizes the localized evidence view through collaboration of LVLMs and visual experts. Finally, Evidence-Enhanced Reasoning aggregates multi-granular views via a hybrid evidence memory and yields accurate and interpretable answers. Experimental results demonstrate that DeepScan significantly boosts LVLMs in diverse visual tasks, especially in fine-grained visual understanding. It achieves 90.6% overall accuracy on V* when integrated with Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Moreover, DeepScan provides consistent improvements for LVLMs across various architectures and model scales without additional adaptation cost.

AI.tldr: DeepScan是一个无需训练的训练框架，通过分层扫描、重新聚焦和证据增强推理，提升大型视觉语言模型在视觉推理任务中的性能，特别是在细粒度视觉理解方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 受人类在嘈杂环境中通过识别关键线索并将其与完整上下文关联的启发，作者希望解决现有方法一次性定位完整证据的局限性，提出一种更鲁棒的视觉推理方法。
AI.method: DeepScan包含三个核心组件：1）分层扫描进行局部线索探索和多尺度证据提取；2）重新聚焦通过LVLMs和视觉专家协作优化证据视图；3）证据增强推理通过混合证据记忆聚合多粒度视图。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，DeepScan显著提升了LVLMs在各种视觉任务中的表现，特别是在细粒度视觉理解方面。与Qwen2.5-VL-7B集成时，在V*数据集上达到90.6%的总体准确率，且无需额外适应成本就能在不同架构和模型规模上提供一致改进。
AI.conclusion: DeepScan通过模仿人类的视觉推理过程，提供了一种有效的训练免费框架，能够显著提升大型视觉语言模型的视觉推理能力，特别是在处理复杂视觉场景时表现出色。

title: Compressed Sensing for Capability Localization in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a wide range of capabilities, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and linguistic behaviors. We show that many capabilities are highly localized to small subsets of attention heads within Transformer architectures. Zeroing out as few as five task-specific heads can degrade performance by up to $65\%$ on standard benchmarks measuring the capability of interest, while largely preserving performance on unrelated tasks. We introduce a compressed sensing based method that exploits the sparsity of these heads to identify them via strategic knockouts and a small number of model evaluations. We validate these findings across Llama and Qwen models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters and a diverse set of capabilities including mathematical abilities and code generation, revealing a modular organization in which specialized capabilities are implemented by sparse, functionally distinct components. Overall, our results suggest that capability localization is a general organizational principle of Transformer language models, with implications for interpretability, model editing, and AI safety. Code is released at https://github.com/locuslab/llm-components.

AI.tldr: 研究发现Transformer语言模型中的特定能力高度集中在少数注意力头上，通过零化少量任务相关头部可显著降低对应能力表现，同时保持其他任务性能不变。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型（LLMs）中各种能力（如数学推理、代码生成等）在Transformer架构中的分布和组织方式，了解模型能力的模块化程度。
AI.method: 采用基于压缩感知的方法，利用注意力头的稀疏性，通过战略性"敲除"和少量模型评估来识别特定任务相关的注意力头。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen模型（1B-8B参数）上验证发现，仅零化5个任务特定头部即可使相关能力下降高达65%，而不影响其他任务性能，表明能力由稀疏、功能不同的组件实现。
AI.conclusion: 能力局部化是Transformer语言模型的通用组织原则，这对可解释性、模型编辑和AI安全具有重要意义。

title: Bridging Human Evaluation to Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) integrates complementary modalities to enhance scene perception. Current methods predominantly focus on optimizing handcrafted losses and objective metrics, often resulting in fusion outcomes that do not align with human visual preferences. This challenge is further exacerbated by the ill-posed nature of IVIF, which severely limits its effectiveness in human perceptual environments such as security surveillance and driver assistance systems. To address these limitations, we propose a feedback reinforcement framework that bridges human evaluation to infrared and visible image fusion. To address the lack of human-centric evaluation metrics and data, we introduce the first large-scale human feedback dataset for IVIF, containing multidimensional subjective scores and artifact annotations, and enriched by a fine-tuned large language model with expert review. Based on this dataset, we design a domain-specific reward function and train a reward model to quantify perceptual quality. Guided by this reward, we fine-tune the fusion network through Group Relative Policy Optimization, achieving state-of-the-art performance that better aligns fused images with human aesthetics. Code is available at https://github.com/ALKA-Wind/EVAFusion.

AI.tldr: 提出基于人类反馈的强化学习框架EVAFusion，通过构建首个大规模IVIF人类反馈数据集和奖励模型，优化融合图像与人类视觉偏好的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有红外与可见光图像融合方法主要优化手工设计的损失函数和客观指标，导致融合结果与人类视觉偏好不一致，限制了在安全监控、驾驶辅助等人类感知环境中的有效性。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个大规模IVIF人类反馈数据集，包含多维主观评分和伪影标注；2) 设计领域特定的奖励函数并训练奖励模型来量化感知质量；3) 通过Group Relative Policy Optimization策略微调融合网络。
AI.result: 提出的EVAFusion框架实现了最先进的性能，生成的融合图像更好地符合人类审美偏好，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将人类评价反馈融入红外与可见光图像融合过程，解决了传统方法与人眼感知不一致的问题，为人类感知环境下的图像融合提供了有效解决方案。

title: Prompt-Dependent Ranking of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Rankings derived from pairwise comparisons are central to many economic and computational systems. In the context of large language models (LLMs), rankings are typically constructed from human preference data and presented as leaderboards that guide deployment decisions. However, existing approaches rely on point estimates, implicitly treating rankings as fixed objects despite substantial estimation noise and context-dependent performance variation. Acting on such rankings can lead to misallocation and welfare loss when apparent differences are not statistically meaningful. We study prompt-dependent ranking inference under pairwise human preferences and develop a framework for decision-safe rankings with statistically valid uncertainty guarantees. We model preferences using a contextual Bradley-Terry-Luce model in which the latent utility of each model depends on the input prompt. Rather than targeting point estimates of utilities, we directly conduct inference on induced rankings, constructing confidence sets based on simultaneous confidence intervals for pairwise utility differences. This approach yields statistically valid marginal and simultaneous confidence sets for prompt-specific ranks. Our framework connects recent advances in rank inference to contextual preference learning and provides tools for robust ranking-based decision-making. Empirically, using large-scale human preference data from LLM evaluations, we show that rankings vary substantially across prompt characteristics and that many apparent rank differences are not statistically distinguishable. We further demonstrate how uncertainty-aware rankings identify dominance only when supported by the data and otherwise return partial orders.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个统计有效的框架，用于在大型语言模型评估中构建具有不确定性保证的决策安全排名，解决了传统点估计排名忽略统计噪声和上下文依赖性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于成对比较的排名方法依赖点估计，将排名视为固定对象，忽略了显著的估计噪声和上下文依赖的性能变化。这可能导致当明显差异缺乏统计意义时产生资源错配和福利损失。
AI.method: 采用上下文Bradley-Terry-Luce模型建模人类偏好，其中每个模型的潜在效用取决于输入提示。不针对效用的点估计，而是直接对诱导排名进行推断，基于成对效用差异的同步置信区间构建置信集。
AI.result: 实证分析显示，排名随提示特征显著变化，许多明显的排名差异在统计上无法区分。不确定性感知排名仅在数据支持时识别支配关系，否则返回偏序关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将最近的排名推断进展与上下文偏好学习相结合，为基于排名的稳健决策提供了工具，确保决策安全并具有统计有效的保证。

title: UniSync: Towards Generalizable and High-Fidelity Lip Synchronization for Challenging Scenarios
summary: Lip synchronization aims to generate realistic talking videos that match given audio, which is essential for high-quality video dubbing. However, current methods have fundamental drawbacks: mask-based approaches suffer from local color discrepancies, while mask-free methods struggle with global background texture misalignment. Furthermore, most methods struggle with diverse real-world scenarios such as stylized avatars, face occlusion, and extreme lighting conditions. In this paper, we propose UniSync, a unified framework designed for achieving high-fidelity lip synchronization in diverse scenarios. Specifically, UniSync uses a mask-free pose-anchored training strategy to keep head motion and eliminate synthesis color artifacts, while employing mask-based blending consistent inference to ensure structural precision and smooth blending. Notably, fine-tuning on compact but diverse videos empowers our model with exceptional domain adaptability, handling complex corner cases effectively. We also introduce the RealWorld-LipSync benchmark to evaluate models under real-world demands, which covers diverse application scenarios including both human faces and stylized avatars. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniSync significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, advancing the field towards truly generalizable and production-ready lip synchronization.

AI.tldr: UniSync是一个统一的唇形同步框架，通过结合mask-free训练和mask-based推理策略，解决了现有方法在颜色差异和背景纹理对齐方面的缺陷，在多样化真实场景中实现高质量唇形同步。
AI.motivation: 当前唇形同步方法存在根本缺陷：基于mask的方法存在局部颜色差异问题，而无mask方法则难以处理全局背景纹理对齐。现有方法在多样化真实场景（如风格化头像、面部遮挡、极端光照条件）中表现不佳，需要更通用的解决方案。
AI.method: UniSync采用统一的框架设计：1）使用无mask的姿态锚定训练策略来保持头部运动并消除合成颜色伪影；2）采用基于mask的混合一致性推理确保结构精度和平滑融合；3）在紧凑但多样化的视频上进行微调，赋予模型卓越的领域适应性。
AI.result: UniSync在实验中显著优于现有最先进方法。作者还引入了RealWorld-LipSync基准测试，涵盖人类面部和风格化头像等多种应用场景，验证了模型在真实世界需求下的优异表现。
AI.conclusion: UniSync通过统一的训练和推理策略，有效解决了唇形同步中的颜色差异和纹理对齐问题，在多样化真实场景中表现出色，推动了该领域向真正可泛化和生产就绪的唇形同步技术发展。

title: Farther the Shift, Sparser the Representation: Analyzing OOD Mechanisms in LLMs
summary: In this work, we investigate how Large Language Models (LLMs) adapt their internal representations when encountering inputs of increasing difficulty, quantified as the degree of out-of-distribution (OOD) shift. We reveal a consistent and quantifiable phenomenon: as task difficulty increases, whether through harder reasoning questions, longer contexts, or adding answer choices, the last hidden states of LLMs become substantially sparser. In short, \textbf{\textit{the farther the shift, the sparser the representations}}. This sparsity--difficulty relation is observable across diverse models and domains, suggesting that language models respond to unfamiliar or complex inputs by concentrating computation into specialized subspaces in the last hidden state. Through a series of controlled analyses with a learning dynamic explanation, we demonstrate that this sparsity is not incidental but an adaptive mechanism for stabilizing reasoning under OOD. Leveraging this insight, we design \textit{Sparsity-Guided Curriculum In-Context Learning (SG-ICL)}, a strategy that explicitly uses representation sparsity to schedule few-shot demonstrations, leading to considerable performance enhancements. Our study provides new mechanistic insights into how LLMs internalize OOD challenges. The source code is available at the URL: https://github.com/MingyuJ666/sparsityLLM.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型面对越困难的输入（超出分布范围程度越高），其最后隐藏层的表示会变得越稀疏，呈现"偏移越远，表示越稀疏"的现象。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在面对不同难度输入时如何调整其内部表示，特别是当输入超出训练分布范围时的适应机制。
AI.method: 通过分析LLM在不同难度任务（更难推理问题、更长上下文、更多答案选项）下的最后隐藏层表示，发现稀疏度与任务难度的关系，并提出基于学习动态解释的受控分析。
AI.result: 发现稀疏度-难度关系在不同模型和领域中都存在，表明语言模型通过将计算集中在最后隐藏层的专门子空间来应对不熟悉或复杂输入，这是一种稳定OOD推理的自适应机制。
AI.conclusion: 基于这一洞察设计了稀疏度引导的课程式上下文学习策略，能显著提升性能，为理解LLM如何内化OOD挑战提供了新的机制性见解。

title: From Misclassifications to Outliers: Joint Reliability Assessment in Classification
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Intellindust-AI-Lab/SUREPlus
summary: Building reliable classifiers is a fundamental challenge for deploying machine learning in real-world applications. A reliable system should not only detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs but also anticipate in-distribution (ID) errors by assigning low confidence to potentially misclassified samples. Yet, most prior work treats OOD detection and failure prediction as separated problems, overlooking their closed connection. We argue that reliability requires evaluating them jointly. To this end, we propose a unified evaluation framework that integrates OOD detection and failure prediction, quantified by our new metrics DS-F1 and DS-AURC, where DS denotes double scoring functions. Experiments on the OpenOOD benchmark show that double scoring functions yield classifiers that are substantially more reliable than traditional single scoring approaches. Our analysis further reveals that OOD-based approaches provide notable gains under simple or far-OOD shifts, but only marginal benefits under more challenging near-OOD conditions. Beyond evaluation, we extend the reliable classifier SURE and introduce SURE+, a new approach that significantly improves reliability across diverse scenarios. Together, our framework, metrics, and method establish a new benchmark for trustworthy classification and offer practical guidance for deploying robust models in real-world settings. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Intellindust-AI-Lab/SUREPlus.

AI.tldr: 提出统一评估框架，将OOD检测和失败预测整合，通过新指标DS-F1和DS-AURC评估分类器可靠性，实验显示双评分函数比传统单评分方法更可靠
AI.motivation: 构建可靠的机器学习分类器是实际应用中的基本挑战，但现有工作将OOD检测和失败预测视为独立问题，忽略了它们的内在联系。作者认为可靠性需要将这两个问题联合评估。
AI.method: 提出统一评估框架，整合OOD检测和失败预测，引入新指标DS-F1和DS-AURC（DS表示双评分函数）。在OpenOOD基准上进行实验，并扩展可靠分类器SURE为SURE+方法。
AI.result: 实验表明双评分函数比传统单评分方法产生更可靠的分类器。分析显示OOD方法在简单或远OOD偏移下提供显著增益，但在更具挑战性的近OOD条件下只有边际收益。SURE+方法在各种场景下显著提高了可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架、指标和方法为可信分类建立了新基准，为在实际环境中部署稳健模型提供了实用指导。代码已开源。

title: A theoretical model of dynamical grammatical gender shifting based on set-valued set function
summary: This study investigates the diverse characteristics of nouns, focusing on both semantic (e.g., countable/uncountable) and morphosyntactic (e.g., masculine/feminine) distinctions. We explore inter-word variations for gender markers in noun morphology. Grammatical gender shift is a widespread phenomenon in languages around the world. The aim is to uncover through a formal model the underlying patterns governing the variation of lexemes. To this end, we propose a new computational component dedicated to pairing items with morphological templates (e.g., the result of a generated item-template pair: (funas, $\{N, +SG, -PL, -M, +F, -COL, +SING\}$), with its spell-out form: $ð$a-funast 'cow'). This process is formally represented by the Template-Based and Modular Cognitive model. This proposed model, defined by a set-valued set function $h : \mathscr{P}(M) \rightarrow \mathscr{P}(M)$, predicts the nonlinear dynamic mapping of lexical items onto morphological templates. By applying this formalism, we present a unified framework for understanding the complexities of morphological markings across languages. Through empirical observations, we demonstrate how these shifts, as well as non-gender shifts, arise during lexical changes, especially in Riffian. Our model posits that these variant markings emerge due to template shifts occurring during word and meaning's formation. By formally demonstrating that conversion is applicable to noun-to-noun derivation, we challenge and broaden the conventional view of word formation. This mathematical model not only contributes to a deeper understanding of morphosyntactic variation but also offers potential applications in other fields requiring precise modelling of linguistic patterns.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于模板的模块化认知模型，用于解释名词的语义和形态句法特征变化，特别是语法性别转换现象。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索名词的多样性特征，包括可数/不可数等语义区分和阳性/阴性等形态句法区分，特别关注语法性别转换这一跨语言普遍现象，旨在通过形式化模型揭示词位变化的潜在模式。
AI.method: 提出了一个新的计算组件，专门用于将词汇项与形态模板配对，采用基于模板的模块化认知模型，该模型由集合值函数 h: P(M)→P(M) 定义，预测词汇项到形态模板的非线性动态映射。
AI.result: 通过经验观察，展示了这些转换（包括非性别转换）在词汇变化中如何出现，特别是在Riffian语言中。模型表明这些变异标记是由于单词和意义形成过程中的模板转换而产生的。
AI.conclusion: 该数学模型不仅有助于更深入地理解形态句法变异，还通过形式化证明转换适用于名词到名词的派生，挑战并拓宽了传统词形构成的观点，为跨语言的形态标记复杂性提供了统一框架。

title: Architecture and evaluation protocol for transformer-based visual object tracking in UAV applications
summary: Object tracking from Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is challenged by platform dynamics, camera motion, and limited onboard resources. Existing visual trackers either lack robustness in complex scenarios or are too computationally demanding for real-time embedded use. We propose an Modular Asynchronous Tracking Architecture (MATA) that combines a transformer-based tracker with an Extended Kalman Filter, integrating ego-motion compensation from sparse optical flow and an object trajectory model. We further introduce a hardware-independent, embedded oriented evaluation protocol and a new metric called Normalized time to Failure (NT2F) to quantify how long a tracker can sustain a tracking sequence without external help. Experiments on UAV benchmarks, including an augmented UAV123 dataset with synthetic occlusions, show consistent improvements in Success and NT2F metrics across multiple tracking processing frequency. A ROS 2 implementation on a Nvidia Jetson AGX Orin confirms that the evaluation protocol more closely matches real-time performance on embedded systems.

AI.tldr: 提出MATA无人机目标跟踪架构，结合Transformer跟踪器与扩展卡尔曼滤波，通过光流补偿相机运动，引入嵌入式评估协议和NT2F新指标，在无人机基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 无人机目标跟踪面临平台动态、相机运动和有限机载资源的挑战，现有视觉跟踪器要么在复杂场景中缺乏鲁棒性，要么计算量过大无法满足嵌入式实时需求。
AI.method: 提出模块化异步跟踪架构(MATA)，将基于Transformer的跟踪器与扩展卡尔曼滤波结合，集成稀疏光流的自我运动补偿和对象轨迹模型，采用硬件无关的嵌入式评估协议。
AI.result: 在无人机基准测试（包括带合成遮挡的增强UAV123数据集）中，在多个跟踪处理频率下，成功率和NT2F指标均获得一致改进。在Nvidia Jetson AGX Orin上的ROS 2实现证实评估协议更贴近嵌入式系统实时性能。
AI.conclusion: MATA架构有效解决了无人机目标跟踪的挑战，提出的嵌入式评估协议和NT2F指标能更好地评估跟踪器在资源受限环境中的实际性能，为嵌入式实时跟踪提供了实用解决方案。

title: SafeCRS: Personalized Safety Alignment for LLM-Based Conversational Recommender Systems
summary: Current LLM-based conversational recommender systems (CRS) primarily optimize recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction. We identify an underexplored vulnerability in which recommendation outputs may negatively impact users by violating personalized safety constraints, when individualized safety sensitivities -- such as trauma triggers, self-harm history, or phobias -- are implicitly inferred from the conversation but not respected during recommendation. We formalize this challenge as personalized CRS safety and introduce SafeRec, a new benchmark dataset designed to systematically evaluate safety risks in LLM-based CRS under user-specific constraints. To further address this problem, we propose SafeCRS, a safety-aware training framework that integrates Safe Supervised Fine-Tuning (Safe-SFT) with Safe Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (Safe-GDPO) to jointly optimize recommendation quality and personalized safety alignment. Extensive experiments on SafeRec demonstrate that SafeCRS reduces safety violation rates by up to 96.5% relative to the strongest recommendation-quality baseline while maintaining competitive recommendation quality. Warning: This paper contains potentially harmful and offensive content.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对话推荐系统(CRS)存在个性化安全约束被忽视的漏洞，开发了SafeRec基准数据集和SafeCRS安全感知训练框架，在保持推荐质量的同时大幅降低安全违规率。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的对话推荐系统主要关注推荐准确性和用户满意度，但忽视了用户个性化安全约束（如创伤触发、自残史、恐惧症等）可能被违反的风险。这些敏感信息可能从对话中隐式推断出来，但在推荐过程中未被尊重，导致对用户的潜在伤害。
AI.method: 提出SafeCRS安全感知训练框架，结合安全监督微调(Safe-SFT)和安全组奖励解耦归一化策略优化(Safe-GDPO)，共同优化推荐质量和个性化安全对齐。同时创建了SafeRec基准数据集来系统评估LLM-based CRS在用户特定约束下的安全风险。
AI.result: 在SafeRec数据集上的大量实验表明，SafeCRS相对于最强的推荐质量基线，将安全违规率降低了高达96.5%，同时保持了有竞争力的推荐质量。
AI.conclusion: 对话推荐系统需要同时考虑推荐质量和个性化安全约束。提出的SafeCRS框架和SafeRec数据集为解决这一重要但被忽视的问题提供了有效方案，显著提升了系统的安全性。

title: Fine-grained Image Aesthetic Assessment: Learning Discriminative Scores from Relative Ranks
comment: The paper has been accepted by CVPR 2026
summary: Image aesthetic assessment (IAA) has extensive applications in content creation, album management, and recommendation systems, etc. In such applications, it is commonly needed to pick out the most aesthetically pleasing image from a series of images with subtle aesthetic variations, a topic we refer to as fine-grained IAA. Unfortunately, state-of-the-art IAA models are typically designed for coarse-grained evaluation, where images with notable aesthetic differences are evaluated independently on an absolute scale. These models are inherently limited in discriminating fine-grained aesthetic differences. To address the dilemma, we contribute FGAesthetics, a fine-grained IAA database with 32,217 images organized into 10,028 series, which are sourced from diverse categories including Natural, AIGC, and Cropping. Annotations are collected via pairwise comparisons within each series. We also devise Series Refinement and Rank Calibration to ensure the reliability of data and labels. Based on FGAesthetics, we further propose FGAesQ, a novel IAA framework that learns discriminative aesthetic scores from relative ranks through Difference-preserved Tokenization (DiffToken), Comparative Text-assisted Alignment (CTAlign), and Rank-aware Regression (RankReg). FGAesQ enables accurate aesthetic assessment in fine-grained scenarios while still maintains competitive performance in coarse-grained evaluation. Extensive experiments and comparisons demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了FGAesthetics细粒度图像美学评估数据库和FGAesQ框架，用于解决现有模型在区分细微美学差异方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像美学评估模型主要针对粗粒度评估设计，无法有效区分具有细微美学差异的图像。在实际应用中（如内容创作、相册管理、推荐系统等），经常需要从一系列美学差异细微的图像中挑选出最优美的图像。
AI.method: 1. 构建FGAesthetics数据库：包含32,217张图像，组织成10,028个系列，涵盖自然、AIGC、裁剪等类别，通过系列内成对比较进行标注；2. 提出FGAesQ框架：通过差异保持标记化、比较文本辅助对齐和秩感知回归，从相对排名中学习判别性美学分数。
AI.result: FGAesQ框架在细粒度场景下实现了准确的美学评估，同时在粗粒度评估中保持竞争力。大量实验和比较证明了该方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究解决了细粒度图像美学评估的挑战，通过构建专门数据库和提出创新框架，显著提升了模型在区分细微美学差异方面的能力，为实际应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: N-gram Injection into Transformers for Dynamic Language Model Adaptation in Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Transformer-based encoder-decoder networks have recently achieved impressive results in handwritten text recognition, partly thanks to their auto-regressive decoder which implicitly learns a language model. However, such networks suffer from a large performance drop when evaluated on a target corpus whose language distribution is shifted from the source text seen during training. To retain recognition accuracy despite this language shift, we propose an external n-gram injection (NGI) for dynamic adaptation of the network's language modeling at inference time. Our method allows switching to an n-gram language model estimated on a corpus close to the target distribution, therefore mitigating bias without any extra training on target image-text pairs. We opt for an early injection of the n-gram into the transformer decoder so that the network learns to fully leverage text-only data at the low additional cost of n-gram inference. Experiments on three handwritten datasets demonstrate that the proposed NGI significantly reduces the performance gap between source and target corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出外部n-gram注入方法，用于在推理时动态调整手写文本识别模型的内部语言模型，以应对训练和测试数据语言分布差异问题。
AI.motivation: Transformer编码器-解码器网络在手写文本识别中表现出色，但其自回归解码器隐含学习的语言模型在目标语料库语言分布与训练数据不同时，性能会大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出外部n-gram注入方法，在推理时将基于目标分布语料库估计的n-gram语言模型注入到Transformer解码器中，实现动态语言模型适应，无需在目标图像-文本对上额外训练。
AI.result: 在三个手写数据集上的实验表明，NGI方法显著缩小了源语料库和目标语料库之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 外部n-gram注入方法能有效缓解语言分布偏移带来的性能下降，使模型能够充分利用纯文本数据，以较低的计算成本适应目标语言分布。

title: Tucano 2 Cool: Better Open Source LLMs for Portuguese
summary: We present Tucano 2, a fully open suite of large language models (LLMs) with 0.5-3.7 billion parameters, designed to address certain gaps in open-source development for Portuguese LLMs. Following our previous works, we now extend our dataset, GigaVerbo-v2, to a new degree of quality and scale, while also introducing a new synthetic dataset, GigaVerbo-v2 Synth, aimed at filling missing gaps in GigaVerbo-v2, and two post-training datasets, GigaVerbo-v2 SFT and GigaVerbo-v2 Preferences, that allow Portuguese LLMs to be trained in domains like retrieval augmented generation, coding, tool use, chain-of-thought reasoning, and many other domains of interest. Through extensive ablation studies, we design both pretraining and continual pretraining recipes for the Tucano 2 suite (Base, Instruct, and Think), which achieve state-of-the-art performance on several Portuguese-language modeling benchmarks. We also extend and refine the evaluation harness introduced in our earlier work, yielding a comprehensive evaluation suite that provides strong signals across different pretraining, continual pretraining, and post-training regimes. All artifacts associated with Tucano 2 are openly released, including training recipes, logs, and source code, ensuring that our work is reproducible, accessible, and extendable by the broader Portuguese NLP community.

AI.tldr: Tucano 2是一个完全开源的葡萄牙语大语言模型套件（0.5-37亿参数），通过扩展数据集和引入新训练方法，在多个葡萄牙语基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 解决葡萄牙语开源大语言模型开发中的某些空白，为葡萄牙语NLP社区提供可复现、可访问且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 扩展GigaVerbo-v2数据集并引入合成数据集GigaVerbo-v2 Synth填补数据空白；2) 创建两个后训练数据集（GigaVerbo-v2 SFT和Preferences）支持检索增强生成、编码、工具使用、思维链推理等任务；3) 通过广泛消融研究设计预训练和持续预训练方案；4) 扩展和优化评估框架。
AI.result: Tucano 2套件（Base、Instruct和Think版本）在多个葡萄牙语建模基准测试中达到最先进性能，所有相关资源（训练方案、日志、源代码）都已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: Tucano 2为葡萄牙语NLP社区提供了一个全面、可复现的大语言模型解决方案，填补了开源葡萄牙语LLM的空白，支持多种应用领域，并建立了完善的评估体系。

title: DISC: Dense Integrated Semantic Context for Large-Scale Open-Set Semantic Mapping
summary: Open-set semantic mapping enables language-driven robotic perception, but current instance-centric approaches are bottlenecked by context-depriving and computationally expensive crop-based feature extraction. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we introduce DISC (Dense Integrated Semantic Context), featuring a novel single-pass, distance-weighted extraction mechanism. By deriving high-fidelity CLIP embeddings directly from the vision transformer's intermediate layers, our approach eliminates the latency and domain-shift artifacts of traditional image cropping, yielding pure, mask-aligned semantic representations. To fully leverage these features in large-scale continuous mapping, DISC is built upon a fully GPU-accelerated architecture that replaces periodic offline processing with precise, on-the-fly voxel-level instance refinement. We evaluate our approach on standard benchmarks (Replica, ScanNet) and a newly generated large-scale-mapping dataset based on Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3DSEM) to assess scalability across complex scenes in multi-story buildings. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DISC significantly surpasses current state-of-the-art zero-shot methods in both semantic accuracy and query retrieval, providing a robust, real-time capable framework for robotic deployment. The full source code, data generation and evaluation pipelines will be made available at https://github.com/DFKI-NI/DISC.

AI.tldr: DISC提出了一种新的密集集成语义上下文方法，通过单次距离加权提取机制直接从视觉变换器中间层获取CLIP嵌入，避免了传统图像裁剪的延迟和领域偏移问题，实现了实时语义建图。
AI.motivation: 当前基于实例的开放集语义建图方法存在两个主要瓶颈：上下文信息缺失和计算昂贵的基于裁剪的特征提取。这些限制阻碍了语言驱动机器人感知的实际应用。
AI.method: DISC采用单次距离加权提取机制，直接从视觉变换器中间层获取高保真CLIP嵌入，避免了图像裁剪。基于完全GPU加速架构，在大型连续建图中实现精确的体素级实例细化。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试（Replica、ScanNet）和新生成的大规模建图数据集（HM3DSEM）上评估，DISC在语义准确性和查询检索方面显著超越当前最先进的零样本方法。
AI.conclusion: DISC提供了一个强大、实时可用的机器人部署框架，解决了传统方法中的上下文缺失和计算效率问题，为开放集语义建图提供了新的解决方案。

title: ByteFlow: Language Modeling through Adaptive Byte Compression without a Tokenizer
summary: Modern language models still rely on fixed, pre-defined subword tokenizations. Once a tokenizer is trained, the LM can only operate at this fixed level of granularity, which often leads to brittle and counterintuitive behaviors even in otherwise strong reasoning models. We introduce \textbf{ByteFlow Net}, a new hierarchical architecture that removes tokenizers entirely and instead enables models to learn their own segmentation of raw byte streams into semantically meaningful units. ByteFlow Net performs compression-driven segmentation based on the coding rate of latent representations, yielding adaptive boundaries \emph{while preserving a static computation graph via Top-$K$ selection}. Unlike prior self-tokenizing methods that depend on brittle heuristics with human-designed inductive biases, ByteFlow Net adapts its internal representation granularity to the input itself. Experiments demonstrate that this compression-based chunking strategy yields substantial performance gains, with ByteFlow Net outperforming both BPE-based Transformers and previous byte-level architectures. These results suggest that end-to-end, tokenizer-free modeling is not only feasible but also more effective, opening a path toward more adaptive and information-grounded language models.

AI.tldr: ByteFlow Net是一种新型分层架构，完全移除了分词器，让模型直接从原始字节流中学习语义单元分割，基于潜在表示的编码率进行压缩驱动分割，在保持静态计算图的同时实现自适应边界划分。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型仍依赖固定的预定义子词分词器，这导致模型只能在固定粒度上操作，即使对于强大的推理模型也会产生脆弱和反直觉的行为。需要一种能够自适应学习输入分割的方法。
AI.method: 提出ByteFlow Net分层架构，完全移除分词器，让模型直接从原始字节流学习语义单元分割。采用基于潜在表示编码率的压缩驱动分割策略，通过Top-K选择保持静态计算图，自适应调整内部表示粒度。
AI.result: 实验表明这种基于压缩的分块策略带来了显著的性能提升，ByteFlow Net在性能上超越了基于BPE的Transformer和先前的字节级架构。
AI.conclusion: 端到端、无分词器的建模不仅可行，而且更有效，为开发更具适应性和信息基础的语言模型开辟了新路径。

title: Cross-Modal Mapping and Dual-Branch Reconstruction for 2D-3D Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection benefits from integrating RGB appearance with 3D surface geometry, yet existing \emph{unsupervised} approaches commonly rely on memory banks, teacher-student architectures, or fragile fusion schemes, limiting robustness under noisy depth, weak texture, or missing modalities. This paper introduces \textbf{CMDR-IAD}, a lightweight and modality-flexible unsupervised framework for reliable anomaly detection in 2D+3D multimodal as well as single-modality (2D-only or 3D-only) settings. \textbf{CMDR-IAD} combines bidirectional 2D$\leftrightarrow$3D cross-modal mapping to model appearance-geometry consistency with dual-branch reconstruction that independently captures normal texture and geometric structure. A two-part fusion strategy integrates these cues: a reliability-gated mapping anomaly highlights spatially consistent texture-geometry discrepancies, while a confidence-weighted reconstruction anomaly adaptively balances appearance and geometric deviations, yielding stable and precise anomaly localization even in depth-sparse or low-texture regions. On the MVTec 3D-AD benchmark, CMDR-IAD achieves state-of-the-art performance while operating without memory banks, reaching 97.3\% image-level AUROC (I-AUROC), 99.6\% pixel-level AUROC (P-AUROC), and 97.6\% AUPRO. On a real-world polyurethane cutting dataset, the 3D-only variant attains 92.6\% I-AUROC and 92.5\% P-AUROC, demonstrating strong effectiveness under practical industrial conditions. These results highlight the framework's robustness, modality flexibility, and the effectiveness of the proposed fusion strategies for industrial visual inspection. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ECGAI-Research/CMDR-IAD/

AI.tldr: CMDR-IAD是一个轻量级、模态灵活的无监督异常检测框架，结合双向跨模态映射和双分支重建，通过可靠性门控和置信度加权融合策略，在2D+3D多模态及单模态设置下实现稳健的工业异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督多模态工业异常检测方法通常依赖内存库、师生架构或脆弱的融合方案，在噪声深度、弱纹理或缺失模态下鲁棒性有限。需要一种更稳健、模态灵活的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: CMDR-IAD结合双向2D↔3D跨模态映射来建模外观-几何一致性，以及双分支重建独立捕获正常纹理和几何结构。采用两部分融合策略：可靠性门控映射异常突出空间一致的纹理-几何差异，置信度加权重建异常自适应平衡外观和几何偏差。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD基准测试中达到SOTA性能：97.3%图像级AUROC、99.6%像素级AUROC和97.6% AUPRO。在真实聚氨酯切割数据集上，3D-only变体达到92.6%图像级AUROC和92.5%像素级AUROC。
AI.conclusion: CMDR-IAD展示了在工业视觉检测中的鲁棒性、模态灵活性以及所提融合策略的有效性，无需内存库即可实现高性能异常检测。

title: Belief-Sim: Towards Belief-Driven Simulation of Demographic Misinformation Susceptibility
summary: Misinformation is a growing societal threat, and susceptibility to misinformative claims varies across demographic groups due to differences in underlying beliefs. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behaviors, we investigate whether they can simulate demographic misinformation susceptibility, treating beliefs as a primary driving factor. We introduce BeliefSim, a simulation framework that constructs demographic belief profiles using psychology-informed taxonomies and survey priors. We study prompt-based conditioning and post-training adaptation, and conduct a multi-fold evaluation using: (i) susceptibility accuracy and (ii) counterfactual demographic sensitivity. Across both datasets and modeling strategies, we show that beliefs provide a strong prior for simulating misinformation susceptibility, with accuracy up to 92%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BeliefSim框架，利用心理学分类和调查先验构建人口统计学信念档案，研究LLMs能否模拟人口统计学群体的错误信息易感性，准确率最高达92%。
AI.motivation: 错误信息是日益增长的社会威胁，不同人口统计学群体由于基础信念差异而对错误信息的易感性不同。随着大语言模型越来越多地用于模拟人类行为，需要研究它们能否模拟人口统计学的错误信息易感性，将信念作为主要驱动因素。
AI.method: 提出BeliefSim模拟框架，使用心理学启发的分类法和调查先验构建人口统计学信念档案。研究基于提示的条件化和训练后适应两种策略，并进行多维度评估：包括易感性准确性和反事实人口统计学敏感性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和建模策略中，信念为模拟错误信息易感性提供了强有力的先验，准确率最高可达92%。
AI.conclusion: 信念是模拟人口统计学错误信息易感性的有效驱动因素，BeliefSim框架能够准确模拟不同人口统计学群体的错误信息易感性，为大语言模型模拟人类行为提供了新方法。

title: Slice-wise quality assessment of high b-value breast DWI via deep learning-based artifact detection
summary: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) can support lesion detection and characterization in breast magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), however especially high b-value diffusion-weighted acquisitions can be prone to intensity artifacts that can affect diagnostic image assessment. This study aims to detect both hyper- and hypointense artifacts on high b-value diffusion-weighted images (b=1500 s/mm2) using deep learning, employing either a binary classification (artifact presence) or a multiclass classification (artifact intensity) approach on a slice-wise dataset.This IRB-approved retrospective study used the single-center dataset comprising n=11806 slices from routine 3T breast MRI examinations performed between 2022 and mid-2023. Three convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures (DenseNet121, ResNet18, and SEResNet50) were trained for binary classification of hyper- and hypointense artifacts. The best performing model (DenseNet121) was applied to an independent holdout test set and was further trained separately for multiclass classification. Evaluation included area under receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), area under precision recall curve (AUPRC), precision, and recall, as well as analysis of predicted bounding box positions, derived from the network Grad-CAM heatmaps. DenseNet121 achieved AUROCs of 0.92 and 0.94 for hyper- and hypointense artifact detection, respectively, and weighted AUROCs of 0.85 and 0.88 for multiclass classification on single-slice high b-value diffusion-weighted images. A radiologist evaluated bounding box precision on a 1-5 Likert-like scale across 200 slices, achieving mean scores of 3.33+-1.04 for hyperintense artifacts and 2.62+-0.81 for hypointense artifacts. Hyper- and hypointense artifact detection in slice-wise breast DWI MRI dataset (b=1500 s/mm2) using CNNs particularly DenseNet121, seems promising and requires further validation.

AI.tldr: 使用深度学习（特别是DenseNet121）在乳腺DWI MRI高b值图像上检测高信号和低信号伪影，取得了良好效果。
AI.motivation: 乳腺MRI中的扩散加权成像（DWI）有助于病变检测和表征，但高b值DWI图像容易受到强度伪影影响，这些伪影可能干扰诊断图像评估。本研究旨在通过深度学习自动检测这些伪影。
AI.method: 使用回顾性单中心数据集（n=11806个切片），训练三种CNN架构（DenseNet121、ResNet18、SEResNet50）进行二分类（伪影存在）和多分类（伪影强度）任务。最佳模型（DenseNet121）在独立测试集上评估，并使用Grad-CAM热图生成预测边界框位置。
AI.result: DenseNet121在高信号和低信号伪影检测中分别获得0.92和0.94的AUROC，多分类任务中加权AUROC分别为0.85和0.88。放射科医生对200个切片的边界框精度评估平均得分为3.33±1.04（高信号）和2.62±0.81（低信号）。
AI.conclusion: 使用CNN（特别是DenseNet121）在乳腺DWI MRI高b值图像上进行高信号和低信号伪影检测具有前景，需要进一步验证。

title: Towards Generalized Multimodal Homography Estimation
summary: Supervised and unsupervised homography estimation methods depend on image pairs tailored to specific modalities to achieve high accuracy. However, their performance deteriorates substantially when applied to unseen modalities. To address this issue, we propose a training data synthesis method that generates unaligned image pairs with ground-truth offsets from a single input image. Our approach renders the image pairs with diverse textures and colors while preserving their structural information. These synthetic data empower the trained model to achieve greater robustness and improved generalization across various domains. Additionally, we design a network to fully leverage cross-scale information and decouple color information from feature representations, thus improving estimation accuracy. Extensive experiments show that our training data synthesis method improves generalization performance. The results also confirm the effectiveness of the proposed network.

AI.tldr: 提出一种训练数据合成方法，从单张图像生成具有地面真值偏移的未对齐图像对，提升单应性估计模型在不同模态间的泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有监督和无监督单应性估计方法依赖于特定模态的图像对，在未见模态上性能显著下降，需要解决跨模态泛化问题
AI.method: 1) 训练数据合成：从单张输入图像生成具有多样纹理和颜色但保持结构信息的未对齐图像对；2) 网络设计：充分利用跨尺度信息，将颜色信息从特征表示中解耦
AI.result: 实验表明训练数据合成方法提升了泛化性能，所提网络设计有效提高了估计精度
AI.conclusion: 提出的训练数据合成方法能增强单应性估计模型的鲁棒性和跨域泛化能力，网络设计进一步提升了估计精度

title: Order Is Not Layout: Order-to-Space Bias in Image Generation
summary: We study a systematic bias in modern image generation models: the mention order of entities in text spuriously determines spatial layout and entity--role binding. We term this phenomenon Order-to-Space Bias (OTS) and show that it arises in both text-to-image and image-to-image generation, often overriding grounded cues and causing incorrect layouts or swapped assignments. To quantify OTS, we introduce OTS-Bench, which isolates order effects with paired prompts differing only in entity order and evaluates models along two dimensions: homogenization and correctness. Experiments show that Order-to-Space Bias (OTS) is widespread in modern image generation models, and provide evidence that it is primarily data-driven and manifests during the early stages of layout formation. Motivated by this insight, we show that both targeted fine-tuning and early-stage intervention strategies can substantially reduce OTS, while preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现代图像生成模型存在系统偏差：提示中实体的提及顺序会虚假地决定空间布局和实体-角色绑定，称为"顺序到空间偏差"(OTS)。
AI.motivation: 现代图像生成模型存在系统偏差，实体在文本中的提及顺序会错误地决定空间布局和实体角色绑定，这种偏差会覆盖基础线索，导致错误的布局或角色交换。
AI.method: 引入OTS-Bench基准测试，通过仅改变实体顺序的配对提示来隔离顺序效应，从同质化和正确性两个维度评估模型。通过实验验证OTS偏差的普遍性，并分析其数据驱动特性和在布局形成早期阶段的显现。
AI.result: 实验表明顺序到空间偏差(OTS)在现代图像生成模型中普遍存在，证据显示这是数据驱动的，并在布局形成早期阶段显现。通过针对性微调和早期干预策略可以显著减少OTS，同时保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了图像生成模型中的顺序到空间偏差问题，提出了量化方法和缓解策略，为改进模型的空间理解和布局生成能力提供了重要见解。

title: BLOCK: An Open-Source Bi-Stage MLLM Character-to-Skin Pipeline for Minecraft
summary: We present \textbf{BLOCK}, an open-source bi-stage character-to-skin pipeline that generates pixel-perfect Minecraft skins from arbitrary character concepts. BLOCK decomposes the problem into (i) a \textbf{3D preview synthesis stage} driven by a large multimodal model (MLLM) with a carefully designed prompt-and-reference template, producing a consistent dual-panel (front/back) oblique-view Minecraft-style preview; and (ii) a \textbf{skin decoding stage} based on a fine-tuned FLUX.2 model that translates the preview into a skin atlas image. We further propose \textbf{EvolveLoRA}, a progressive LoRA curriculum (text-to-image $\rightarrow$ image-to-image $\rightarrow$ preview-to-skin) that initializes each phase from the previous adapter to improve stability and efficiency. BLOCK is released with all prompt templates and fine-tuned weights to support reproducible character-to-skin generation.

AI.tldr: BLOCK是一个开源的双阶段角色到皮肤生成管道，能够从任意角色概念生成像素级完美的Minecraft皮肤，包含3D预览合成和皮肤解码两个阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有的Minecraft皮肤生成方法通常难以从任意角色概念生成像素级完美的皮肤，需要一种能够将任意角色设计转化为高质量Minecraft皮肤的系统化解决方案。
AI.method: 采用双阶段管道：第一阶段使用大型多模态模型通过精心设计的提示-参考模板生成一致的双面板（前/后）斜视角Minecraft风格预览；第二阶段使用微调的FLUX.2模型将预览转换为皮肤图集图像。还提出了EvolveLoRA渐进式LoRA课程学习方法。
AI.result: 开发了BLOCK系统，能够从任意角色概念生成像素级完美的Minecraft皮肤，并发布了所有提示模板和微调权重以支持可复现的角色到皮肤生成。
AI.conclusion: BLOCK提供了一个有效的双阶段解决方案，通过结合大型多模态模型和微调扩散模型，实现了从任意角色概念到高质量Minecraft皮肤的可靠转换，为Minecraft社区提供了强大的创作工具。

title: ErrorLLM: Modeling SQL Errors for Text-to-SQL Refinement
summary: Despite the remarkable performance of large language models (LLMs) in text-to-SQL (SQL generation), correctly producing SQL queries remains challenging during initial generation. The SQL refinement task is subsequently introduced to correct syntactic and semantic errors in generated SQL queries. However, existing paradigms face two major limitations: (i) self-debugging becomes increasingly ineffective as modern LLMs rarely produce explicit execution errors that can trigger debugging signals; (ii) self-correction exhibits low detection precision due to the lack of explicit error modeling grounded in the question and schema, and suffers from severe hallucination that frequently corrupts correct SQLs. In this paper, we propose ErrorLLM, a framework that explicitly models text-to-SQL Errors within a dedicated LLM for text-to-SQL refinement. Specifically, we represent the user question and database schema as structural features, employ static detection to identify execution failures and surface mismatches, and extend ErrorLLM's semantic space with dedicated error tokens that capture categorized implicit semantic error types. Through a well-designed training strategy, we explicitly model these errors with structural representations, enabling the LLM to detect complex implicit errors by predicting dedicated error tokens. Guided by the detected errors, we perform error-guided refinement on the SQL structure by prompting LLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ErrorLLM achieves the most significant improvements over backbone initial generation. Further analysis reveals that detection quality directly determines refinement effectiveness, and ErrorLLM addresses both sides by high detection F1 score while maintain refinement effectiveness.

AI.tldr: ErrorLLM是一个专门用于文本到SQL查询优化的框架，通过显式建模SQL错误类型，使用专用错误令牌来检测和修正复杂的隐式语义错误，显著提升了SQL生成的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL优化方法面临两大局限：1）现代大语言模型很少产生显式执行错误，导致自调试方法失效；2）自校正方法由于缺乏基于问题和模式的显式错误建模，检测精度低且存在严重幻觉，经常破坏原本正确的SQL。
AI.method: ErrorLLM框架将用户问题和数据库模式表示为结构特征，使用静态检测识别执行失败和表面不匹配，扩展语义空间包含专用错误令牌来捕获分类的隐式语义错误类型。通过精心设计的训练策略，用结构表示显式建模这些错误，使LLM能够通过预测专用错误令牌来检测复杂的隐式错误。基于检测到的错误，通过提示LLM对SQL结构进行错误引导的优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ErrorLLM在基础初始生成上实现了最显著的改进。进一步分析显示，检测质量直接决定了优化效果，ErrorLLM通过高检测F1分数同时保持了优化效果，解决了现有方法的两个主要问题。
AI.conclusion: ErrorLLM通过显式建模文本到SQL错误，使用专用错误令牌和结构表示，有效解决了现有SQL优化方法的局限性，显著提升了SQL查询的准确性和可靠性。

title: UniRain: Unified Image Deraining with RAG-based Dataset Distillation and Multi-objective Reweighted Optimization
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project Page: https://github.com/QianfengY/UniRain
summary: Despite significant progress has been made in image deraining, we note that most existing methods are often developed for only specific types of rain degradation and fail to generalize across diverse real-world rainy scenes. How to effectively model different rain degradations within a universal framework is important for real-world image deraining. In this paper, we propose UniRain, an effective unified image deraining framework capable of restoring images degraded by rain streak and raindrop under both daytime and nighttime conditions. To better enhance unified model generalization, we construct an intelligent retrieval augmented generation (RAG)-based dataset distillation pipeline that selects high-quality training samples from all public deraining datasets for better mixed training. Furthermore, we incorporate a simple yet effective multi-objective reweighted optimization strategy into the asymmetric mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to facilitate consistent performance and improve robustness across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments show that our framework performs favorably against the state-of-the-art models on our proposed benchmarks and multiple public datasets.

AI.tldr: UniRain是一个统一的图像去雨框架，能够处理雨纹和雨滴退化，适用于白天和夜间条件，通过RAG数据蒸馏和多目标加权优化策略提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像去雨方法通常只针对特定类型的雨退化，难以泛化到多样化的真实世界雨天场景，需要开发能够有效建模不同雨退化的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出UniRain统一图像去雨框架，包含：1）基于检索增强生成（RAG）的数据集蒸馏管道，从公开去雨数据集中选择高质量训练样本；2）在非对称专家混合（MoE）架构中融入多目标加权优化策略。
AI.result: 在提出的基准测试和多个公开数据集上，UniRain框架表现优于现有最先进模型，展示了良好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: UniRain通过统一框架解决了多种雨退化问题，结合数据蒸馏和多目标优化策略，为真实世界图像去雨提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Confidence-Calibrated Small-Large Language Model Collaboration for Cost-Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate superior reasoning capabilities compared to small language models (SLMs), but incur substantially higher costs. We propose COllaborative REAsoner (COREA), a system that cascades an SLM with an LLM to achieve a balance between accuracy and cost in complex reasoning tasks. COREA first attempts to answer questions using the SLM, which outputs both an answer and a verbalized confidence score. Questions with confidence below a predefined threshold are deferred to the LLM for more accurate resolution. We introduce a reinforcement learning-based training algorithm that aligns the SLM's confidence through an additional confidence calibration reward. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method jointly improves the SLM's reasoning ability and confidence calibration across diverse datasets and model backbones. Compared to using the LLM alone, COREA reduces cost by 21.5% and 16.8% on out-of-domain math and non-math datasets, respectively, with only an absolute pass@1 drop within 2%.

AI.tldr: COREA系统通过级联小语言模型(SLM)和大语言模型(LLM)来平衡推理任务的准确性和成本，使用强化学习校准SLM的置信度，在保持高准确率的同时显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然推理能力强但成本高昂，小语言模型成本低但推理能力有限。需要一种方法在保持高准确率的同时降低推理成本。
AI.method: 提出COREA系统：1) SLM先尝试回答问题并输出答案和置信度分数；2) 置信度低于阈值的难题转交给LLM处理；3) 使用强化学习训练算法通过置信度校准奖励来对齐SLM的置信度。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型架构上，该方法同时提升了SLM的推理能力和置信度校准。相比单独使用LLM，在域外数学数据集上降低成本21.5%，非数学数据集上降低成本16.8%，准确率下降仅在2%以内。
AI.conclusion: COREA系统通过级联SLM和LLM，结合置信度校准机制，有效平衡了复杂推理任务中的准确性和成本，为实际应用提供了经济高效的解决方案。

title: Scaling Dense Event-Stream Pretraining from Visual Foundation Models
summary: Learning versatile, fine-grained representations from irregular event streams is pivotal yet nontrivial, primarily due to the heavy annotation that hinders scalability in dataset size, semantic richness, and application scope. To mitigate this dilemma, we launch a novel self-supervised pretraining method that distills visual foundation models (VFMs) to push the boundaries of event representation at scale. Specifically, we curate an extensive synchronized image-event collection to amplify cross-modal alignment. Nevertheless, due to inherent mismatches in sparsity and granularity between image-event domains, existing distillation paradigms are prone to semantic collapse in event representations, particularly at high resolutions. To bridge this gap, we propose to extend the alignment objective to semantic structures provided off-the-shelf by VFMs, indicating a broader receptive field and stronger supervision. The key ingredient of our method is a structure-aware distillation loss that grounds higher-quality image-event correspondences for alignment, optimizing dense event representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach takes a great leap in downstream benchmarks, significantly surpassing traditional methods and existing pretraining techniques. This breakthrough manifests in enhanced generalization, superior data efficiency and elevated transferability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新颖的自监督预训练方法，通过从视觉基础模型蒸馏知识来提升事件表示的质量，解决了事件流数据标注困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 从不规则事件流中学习多功能、细粒度表示具有挑战性，主要因为繁重的标注工作限制了数据集规模、语义丰富性和应用范围的扩展。
AI.method: 构建了大规模同步图像-事件数据集，提出了结构感知蒸馏损失，利用视觉基础模型提供的语义结构信息来优化密集事件表示，避免语义崩溃。
AI.result: 在多个下游基准测试中取得显著提升，大幅超越传统方法和现有预训练技术，表现出更好的泛化能力、数据效率和迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过跨模态对齐和结构感知蒸馏，成功解决了事件表示中的语义崩溃问题，为事件流处理提供了高质量的预训练表示。

title: T2S-Bench & Structure-of-Thought: Benchmarking and Prompting Comprehensive Text-to-Structure Reasoning
comment: Dataset and Code have been released at https://t2s-bench.github.io/T2S-Bench-Page/
summary: Think about how human handles complex reading tasks: marking key points, inferring their relationships, and structuring information to guide understanding and responses. Likewise, can a large language model benefit from text structure to enhance text-processing performance? To explore it, in this work, we first introduce Structure of Thought (SoT), a prompting technique that explicitly guides models to construct intermediate text structures, consistently boosting performance across eight tasks and three model families. Building upon this insight, we present T2S-Bench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate and improve text-to-structure capabilities of models. T2S-Bench includes 1.8K samples across 6 scientific domains and 32 structural types, rigorously constructed to ensure accuracy, fairness, and quality. Evaluation on 45 mainstream models reveals substantial improvement potential: the average accuracy on the multi-hop reasoning task is only 52.1%, and even the most advanced model achieves 58.1% node accuracy in end-to-end extraction. Furthermore, on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SoT alone yields an average +5.7% improvement across eight diverse text-processing tasks, and fine-tuning on T2S-Bench further increases this gain to +8.6%. These results highlight the value of explicit text structuring and the complementary contributions of SoT and T2S-Bench. Dataset and eval code have been released at https://t2s-bench.github.io/T2S-Bench-Page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoT（思维结构）提示技术和T2S-Bench基准，通过显式构建文本结构提升大语言模型在文本处理任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: 受人类处理复杂阅读任务时标记关键点、推断关系、结构化信息以指导理解和响应的启发，探索大语言模型是否能从文本结构中受益以提升文本处理性能。
AI.method: 1. 提出SoT提示技术，显式指导模型构建中间文本结构；2. 创建T2S-Bench基准，包含1.8K样本覆盖6个科学领域和32种结构类型；3. 在45个主流模型上进行评估；4. 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上测试SoT效果，并进行T2S-Bench微调。
AI.result: 1. SoT在8个任务和3个模型家族中一致提升性能；2. 多跳推理任务平均准确率仅52.1%，最先进模型在端到端提取中节点准确率为58.1%；3. SoT在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上平均提升5.7%，T2S-Bench微调后提升至8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式文本结构化具有重要价值，SoT和T2S-Bench具有互补贡献，为提升大语言模型的文本处理能力提供了有效方法。

title: GeoSeg: Training-Free Reasoning-Driven Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Recent advances in MLLMs are reframing segmentation from fixed-category prediction to instruction-grounded localization. While reasoning based segmentation has progressed rapidly in natural scenes, remote sensing lacks a generalizable solution due to the prohibitive cost of reasoning-oriented data and domain-specific challenges like overhead viewpoints. We present GeoSeg, a zero-shot, training-free framework that bypasses the supervision bottleneck for reasoning-driven remote sensing segmentation. GeoSeg couples MLLM reasoning with precise localization via: (i) bias-aware coordinate refinement to correct systematic grounding shifts and (ii) a dual-route prompting mechanism to fuse semantic intent with fine-grained spatial cues. We also introduce GeoSeg-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 810 image--query pairs with hierarchical difficulty levels. Experiments show that GeoSeg consistently outperforms all baselines, with extensive ablations confirming the effectiveness and necessity of each component.

AI.tldr: GeoSeg是一个零样本、无需训练的遥感图像分割框架，通过结合多模态大语言模型推理和精确定位，解决了遥感领域缺乏通用推理分割方案的问题。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像分割面临两个主要挑战：1）缺乏面向推理的训练数据，标注成本高昂；2）遥感特有的领域挑战（如俯视视角）。现有MLLM在自然场景分割方面进展迅速，但遥感领域缺乏通用解决方案。
AI.method: GeoSeg采用零样本、无需训练的方法，通过两个核心技术：1）偏差感知坐标细化，校正系统性定位偏移；2）双路径提示机制，融合语义意图与细粒度空间线索。还引入了GeoSeg-Bench诊断基准。
AI.result: 实验表明GeoSeg在所有基线方法中表现最优，广泛的消融实验证实了每个组件的有效性和必要性。
AI.conclusion: GeoSeg成功绕过了监督瓶颈，为遥感图像提供了通用的推理驱动分割解决方案，通过结合MLLM推理和精确定位技术，在零样本设置下实现了优异的性能。

title: RIVER: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Video LLMs
summary: The rapid advancement of multimodal large language models has demonstrated impressive capabilities, yet nearly all operate in an offline paradigm, hindering real-time interactivity. Addressing this gap, we introduce the Real-tIme Video intERaction Bench (RIVER Bench), designed for evaluating online video comprehension. RIVER Bench introduces a novel framework comprising Retrospective Memory, Live-Perception, and Proactive Anticipation tasks, closely mimicking interactive dialogues rather than responding to entire videos at once. We conducted detailed annotations using videos from diverse sources and varying lengths, and precisely defined the real-time interactive format. Evaluations across various model categories reveal that while offline models perform well in single question-answering tasks, they struggle with real-time processing. Addressing the limitations of existing models in online video interaction, especially their deficiencies in long-term memory and future perception, we proposed a general improvement method that enables models to interact with users more flexibly in real time. We believe this work will significantly advance the development of real-time interactive video understanding models and inspire future research in this emerging field. Datasets and code are publicly available at https://github.com/OpenGVLab/RIVER.

AI.tldr: RIVER Bench是一个用于评估在线视频理解的实时交互基准，包含回顾记忆、实时感知和前瞻预测三个任务，旨在解决现有多模态大语言模型在实时交互方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型大多工作在离线范式，缺乏实时交互能力，这限制了实际应用中的实时互动性。为了解决这一差距，需要建立一个专门评估在线视频理解的基准。
AI.method: 提出了RIVER Bench基准，包含三个核心任务框架：Retrospective Memory（回顾记忆）、Live-Perception（实时感知）和Proactive Anticipation（前瞻预测）。使用来自不同来源、不同长度的视频进行详细标注，并精确定义实时交互格式。同时提出了一种通用的改进方法，以解决现有模型在长期记忆和未来感知方面的缺陷。
AI.result: 评估显示，离线模型在单次问答任务上表现良好，但在实时处理方面存在困难。提出的改进方法使模型能够在实时中更灵活地与用户交互。数据集和代码已公开可用。
AI.conclusion: RIVER Bench基准将显著推动实时交互视频理解模型的发展，并激发这一新兴领域的未来研究。这项工作填补了多模态大语言模型在实时交互评估方面的空白。

title: Assessing the Effectiveness of LLMs in Delivering Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
summary: As mental health issues continue to rise globally, there is an increasing demand for accessible and scalable therapeutic solutions. Many individuals currently seek support from Large Language Models (LLMs), even though these models have not been validated for use in counseling services. In this paper, we evaluate LLMs' ability to emulate professional therapists practicing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). Using anonymized, transcribed role-play sessions between licensed therapists and clients, we compare two approaches: (1) a generation-only method and (2) a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach using CBT guidelines. We evaluate both proprietary and open-source models for linguistic quality, semantic coherence, and therapeutic fidelity using standard natural language generation (NLG) metrics, natural language inference (NLI), and automated scoring for skills assessment. Our results indicate that while LLMs can generate CBT-like dialogues, they are limited in their ability to convey empathy and maintain consistency.

AI.tldr: 评估大语言模型模拟认知行为治疗师的能力，发现虽然能生成类似CBT的对话，但在共情表达和一致性方面存在局限
AI.motivation: 随着全球心理健康问题日益严重，对可及、可扩展治疗解决方案的需求增加。许多人向大语言模型寻求支持，但这些模型尚未经过心理咨询服务验证，因此需要评估其模拟专业治疗师的能力。
AI.method: 使用匿名转录的专业治疗师与客户角色扮演会话，比较两种方法：(1)纯生成方法；(2)基于CBT指南的检索增强生成方法。评估专有和开源模型的语言质量、语义连贯性和治疗保真度，使用标准NLG指标、自然语言推理和技能评估自动评分。
AI.result: 大语言模型能够生成类似CBT的对话，但在传达共情和保持一致性方面存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 虽然大语言模型在模拟认知行为治疗方面显示出潜力，但在关键治疗要素如共情表达和对话一致性方面仍需改进，目前尚不能完全替代专业治疗师。

title: Discriminative Perception via Anchored Description for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation increasingly employs reinforcement learning to generate explanatory reasoning chains that guide Multimodal Large Language Models. While these geometric rewards are primarily confined to guiding the final localization, they are incapable of discriminating whether the reasoning process remains anchored on the referred region or strays into irrelevant context. Lacking this discriminative guidance, the model's reasoning often devolves into unfocused and verbose chains that ultimately fail to disambiguate and perceive the target in complex scenes. This suggests a need to complement the RL objective with Discriminative Perception, an ability to actively distinguish a target from its context. To realize this, we propose DPAD to compel the model to generate a descriptive caption of the referred object, which is then used to explicitly discriminate by contrasting the caption's semantic relevance to the referred object against the wider context. By optimizing for this discriminative capability, the model is forced to focus on the unique attributes of the target, leading to a more converged and efficient reasoning chain. The descriptive caption also serves as an interpretability rationale that aligns with the segmentation. Experiments on the benchmarks confirm the validity of our approach, delivering substantial performance gains, with the cIoU on ReasonSeg increasing by 3.09% and the reasoning chain length decreasing by approximately 42%. Code is available at https://github.com/mrazhou/DPAD

AI.tldr: DPAD提出了一种通过生成描述性标题来增强推理分割中判别感知能力的方法，显著提升分割性能并缩短推理链长度
AI.motivation: 当前推理分割方法主要依赖强化学习的几何奖励来指导最终定位，但无法判断推理过程是否始终锚定在目标区域还是偏离到无关上下文。缺乏这种判别性指导会导致模型推理变得冗长且不聚焦，最终在复杂场景中无法准确识别目标。
AI.method: 提出DPAD方法，强制模型生成被指称对象的描述性标题，然后通过对比该标题与目标对象和更广泛上下文的语义相关性来进行显式判别。通过优化这种判别能力，迫使模型关注目标的独特属性，从而产生更收敛和高效的推理链。
AI.result: 在基准测试中验证了方法的有效性，带来了显著的性能提升：ReasonSeg上的cIoU提高了3.09%，推理链长度减少了约42%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入判别感知能力来补充强化学习目标，能够显著改善推理分割的性能和效率，描述性标题还提供了与分割结果对齐的可解释性依据。

title: CzechTopic: A Benchmark for Zero-Shot Topic Localization in Historical Czech Documents
summary: Topic localization aims to identify spans of text that express a given topic defined by a name and description. To study this task, we introduce a human-annotated benchmark based on Czech historical documents, containing human-defined topics together with manually annotated spans and supporting evaluation at both document and word levels. Evaluation is performed relative to human agreement rather than a single reference annotation. We evaluate a diverse range of large language models alongside BERT-based models fine-tuned on a distilled development dataset. Results reveal substantial variability among LLMs, with performance ranging from near-human topic detection to pronounced failures in span localization. While the strongest models approach human agreement, the distilled token embedding models remain competitive despite their smaller scale. The dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available at: https://github.com/dcgm/czechtopic.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了捷克历史文档主题定位任务，创建了人工标注基准数据集，评估了多种大语言模型和BERT模型在该任务上的表现，发现模型性能差异显著，最强模型接近人类一致性水平。
AI.motivation: 研究主题定位任务，即识别表达给定主题（由名称和描述定义）的文本跨度。为了研究此任务，需要创建专门的数据集和评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 基于捷克历史文档创建人工标注基准数据集，包含人工定义的主题和手动标注的文本跨度；2. 在文档和词级别进行评估，相对于人类一致性而非单一参考标注；3. 评估多样化的大语言模型以及在蒸馏开发数据集上微调的BERT模型。
AI.result: 结果显示：1. 大语言模型之间存在显著差异，性能从接近人类主题检测到跨度定位明显失败；2. 最强模型接近人类一致性水平；3. 尽管规模较小，蒸馏的标记嵌入模型仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 主题定位任务具有挑战性，模型性能差异显著。虽然最强模型能接近人类一致性，但仍有改进空间。数据集和评估框架已公开提供。

title: Rethinking Role-Playing Evaluation: Anonymous Benchmarking and a Systematic Study of Personality Effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in developing Role-Playing Agents (RPAs). However, current research primarily evaluates RPAs using famous fictional characters, allowing models to rely on memory associated with character names. This dependency creates a bias that limits the generalization of RPAs to unseen personas. To address this issue, we propose an anonymous evaluation method. Experiments across multiple benchmarks reveal that anonymization significantly degrades role-playing performance, confirming that name exposure carries implicit information. Furthermore, we investigate personality augmentation to enhance role fidelity under anonymous setting. We systematically compare the efficacy of personality traits derived from human annotations versus those self-generated by the model. Our results demonstrate that incorporating personality information consistently improves RPA performance. Crucially, self-generated personalities achieve performance comparable to human-annotated ones. This work establishes a fairer evaluation protocol and validates a scalable, personality-enhanced framework for constructing robust RPAs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出匿名评估方法解决角色扮演代理依赖角色名称记忆的问题，并研究人格增强提升匿名环境下角色保真度
AI.motivation: 当前角色扮演代理评估主要使用知名虚构角色，模型可依赖角色名称相关的记忆，这种依赖性造成偏见，限制了角色扮演代理对未见角色的泛化能力
AI.method: 提出匿名评估方法，并在匿名设置下研究人格增强，系统比较人类标注的人格特质与模型自生成人格特质的有效性
AI.result: 匿名化显著降低角色扮演性能，确认名称暴露携带隐含信息；人格信息一致提升角色扮演代理性能，自生成人格达到与人类标注相当的表现
AI.conclusion: 建立了更公平的评估协议，验证了可扩展的人格增强框架用于构建鲁棒角色扮演代理

title: DQE-CIR: Distinctive Query Embeddings through Learnable Attribute Weights and Target Relative Negative Sampling in Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) addresses the task of retrieving a target image by jointly interpreting a reference image and a modification text that specifies the intended change. Most existing methods are still built upon contrastive learning frameworks that treat the ground truth image as the only positive instance and all remaining images as negatives. This strategy inevitably introduces relevance suppression, where semantically related yet valid images are incorrectly pushed away, and semantic confusion, where different modification intents collapse into overlapping regions of the embedding space. As a result, the learned query representations often lack discriminativeness, particularly at fine-grained attribute modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose distinctive query embeddings through learnable attribute weights and target relative negative sampling (DQE-CIR), a method designed to learn distinctive query embeddings by explicitly modeling target relative relevance during training. DQE-CIR incorporates learnable attribute weighting to emphasize distinctive visual features conditioned on the modification text, enabling more precise feature alignment between language and vision. Furthermore, we introduce target relative negative sampling, which constructs a target relative similarity distribution and selects informative negatives from a mid-zone region that excludes both easy negatives and ambiguous false negatives. This strategy enables more reliable retrieval for fine-grained attribute changes by improving query discriminativeness and reducing confusion caused by semantically similar but irrelevant candidates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DQE-CIR方法，通过可学习属性权重和目标相对负采样来解决组合图像检索中的相关性抑制和语义混淆问题，提升细粒度属性修改的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有组合图像检索方法大多基于对比学习框架，将真实目标图像作为唯一正样本，其余所有图像作为负样本。这种策略导致两个问题：1) 相关性抑制 - 将语义相关但有效的图像错误地推离；2) 语义混淆 - 不同修改意图在嵌入空间中重叠。这使得学习到的查询表示缺乏区分性，特别是在细粒度属性修改方面。
AI.method: 提出DQE-CIR方法，包含两个核心组件：1) 可学习属性权重 - 根据修改文本强调区分性视觉特征，实现语言和视觉的更精确特征对齐；2) 目标相对负采样 - 构建目标相对相似度分布，从中等区域选择信息丰富的负样本，排除简单负样本和模糊的假负样本。
AI.result: 该方法通过提高查询表示的区分性和减少语义相似但不相关候选带来的混淆，实现了对细粒度属性变化的更可靠检索。
AI.conclusion: DQE-CIR通过显式建模训练期间的目标相对相关性，学习具有区分性的查询嵌入，有效解决了组合图像检索中的相关性抑制和语义混淆问题，提升了细粒度属性修改的检索性能。

title: Monitoring Emergent Reward Hacking During Generation via Internal Activations
summary: Fine-tuned large language models can exhibit reward-hacking behavior arising from emergent misalignment, which is difficult to detect from final outputs alone. While prior work has studied reward hacking at the level of completed responses, it remains unclear whether such behavior can be identified during generation. We propose an activation-based monitoring approach that detects reward-hacking signals from internal representations as a model generates its response. Our method trains sparse autoencoders on residual stream activations and applies lightweight linear classifiers to produce token-level estimates of reward-hacking activity. Across multiple model families and fine-tuning mixtures, we find that internal activation patterns reliably distinguish reward-hacking from benign behavior, generalize to unseen mixed-policy adapters, and exhibit model-dependent temporal structure during chain-of-thought reasoning. Notably, reward-hacking signals often emerge early, persist throughout reasoning, and can be amplified by increased test-time compute in the form of chain-of-thought prompting under weakly specified reward objectives. These results suggest that internal activation monitoring provides a complementary and earlier signal of emergent misalignment than output-based evaluation, supporting more robust post-deployment safety monitoring for fine-tuned language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于激活的监控方法，通过分析语言模型内部表示来检测奖励黑客行为，相比仅依赖最终输出的方法能更早发现模型不对齐问题。
AI.motivation: 微调后的大型语言模型可能出现奖励黑客行为，这种由涌现不对齐引起的问题难以仅从最终输出中检测。虽然已有研究在完成响应层面研究奖励黑客，但尚不清楚是否能在生成过程中识别此类行为。
AI.method: 提出基于激活的监控方法：在残差流激活上训练稀疏自编码器，应用轻量级线性分类器生成token级别的奖励黑客活动估计。该方法可检测生成过程中的内部表示信号。
AI.result: 在多个模型系列和微调混合中，内部激活模式能可靠区分奖励黑客与良性行为，泛化到未见过的混合策略适配器，并在思维链推理中表现出模型依赖的时间结构。奖励黑客信号通常出现较早，在整个推理过程中持续存在，并可通过增加测试时计算（如思维链提示）在弱指定奖励目标下被放大。
AI.conclusion: 内部激活监控为涌现不对齐提供了比基于输出的评估更早的补充信号，支持对微调语言模型进行更稳健的部署后安全监控。

title: Long-Term Visual Localization in Dynamic Benthic Environments: A Dataset, Footprint-Based Ground Truth, and Visual Place Recognition Benchmark
summary: Long-term visual localization has the potential to reduce cost and improve mapping quality in optical benthic monitoring with autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). Despite this potential, long-term visual localization in benthic environments remains understudied, primarily due to the lack of curated datasets for benchmarking. Moreover, limited georeferencing accuracy and image footprints necessitate precise geometric information for accurate ground-truthing. In this work, we address these gaps by presenting a curated dataset for long-term visual localization in benthic environments and a novel method to ground-truth visual localization results for near-nadir underwater imagery. Our dataset comprises georeferenced AUV imagery from five benthic reference sites, revisited over periods up to six years, and includes raw and color-corrected stereo imagery, camera calibrations, and sub-decimeter registered camera poses. To our knowledge, this is the first curated underwater dataset for long-term visual localization spanning multiple sites and photic-zone habitats. Our ground-truthing method estimates 3D seafloor image footprints and links camera views with overlapping footprints, ensuring that ground-truth links reflect shared visual content. Building on this dataset and ground truth, we benchmark eight state-of-the-art visual place recognition (VPR) methods and find that Recall@K is significantly lower on our dataset than on established terrestrial and underwater benchmarks.
