Finally, we compare our footprint-based ground truth to a traditional location-based ground truth and show that distance-threshold ground-truthing can overestimate VPR Recall@K at sites with rugged terrain and altitude variations. Together, the curated dataset, ground-truthing method, and VPR benchmark provide a stepping stone for advancing long-term visual localization in dynamic benthic environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个用于海底环境长期视觉定位的精选数据集，包含5个海底参考站点的地理参考AUV图像，时间跨度达6年，并开发了一种基于3D海底图像足迹的地面真值标注方法，用于评估视觉地点识别方法在动态海底环境中的性能。
AI.motivation: 海底环境中的长期视觉定位研究不足，主要缺乏用于基准测试的精选数据集。同时，有限的地理参考精度和图像覆盖范围需要精确的几何信息来进行准确的地面真值标注。
AI.method: 1) 创建包含5个海底参考站点、时间跨度达6年的地理参考AUV图像数据集，包括原始和颜色校正的立体图像、相机校准和亚分米级注册的相机姿态；2) 开发基于3D海底图像足迹的地面真值标注方法，通过估计图像覆盖的海底区域并链接具有重叠足迹的相机视图，确保地面真值链接反映共享的视觉内容。
AI.result: 1) 这是首个涵盖多个站点和透光带栖息地的精选水下长期视觉定位数据集；2) 对8种最先进的视觉地点识别方法进行基准测试，发现在该数据集上的Recall@K显著低于已建立的陆地和水平基准；3) 与传统基于位置的地面真值相比，基于足迹的地面真值标注显示，在崎岖地形和高度变化的站点，基于距离阈值的地面真值标注会高估VPR的Recall@K。
AI.conclusion: 精选的数据集、地面真值标注方法和VPR基准测试为推进动态海底环境中的长期视觉定位研究提供了重要基础，揭示了传统评估方法在复杂海底环境中的局限性。

title: Hindsight Quality Prediction Experiments in Multi-Candidate Human-Post-Edited Machine Translation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC)
summary: This paper investigates two complementary paradigms for predicting machine translation (MT) quality: source-side difficulty prediction and candidate-side quality estimation (QE). The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) into MT workflows is reshaping the research landscape, yet its impact on established quality prediction paradigms remains underexplored. We study this issue through a series of "hindsight" experiments on a unique, multi-candidate dataset resulting from a genuine MT post-editing (MTPE) project. The dataset consists of over 6,000 English source segments with nine translation hypotheses from a diverse set of traditional neural MT systems and advanced LLMs, all evaluated against a single, final human post-edited reference. Using Kendall's rank correlation, we assess the predictive power of source-side difficulty metrics, candidate-side QE models and position heuristics against two gold-standard scores: TER (as a proxy for post-editing effort) and COMET (as a proxy for human judgment). Our findings highlight that the architectural shift towards LLMs alters the reliability of established quality prediction methods while simultaneously mitigating previous challenges in document-level translation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了两种预测机器翻译质量的范式：源端难度预测和候选端质量评估，并分析了大型语言模型对这两种范式的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型在机器翻译工作流程中的快速应用，研究它们对现有质量预测范式的影响变得重要，但目前这方面的探索还不够深入。
AI.method: 研究采用"后见之明"实验方法，使用一个独特的、来自真实机器翻译后编辑项目的多候选数据集。数据集包含6,000多个英语源文本段，每个段有来自传统神经机器翻译系统和先进大型语言模型的9个翻译假设，所有翻译都针对同一个最终人工后编辑参考进行评估。使用Kendall等级相关系数评估源端难度指标、候选端质量评估模型和位置启发式方法对两个黄金标准分数（TER作为后编辑工作量的代理，COMET作为人工判断的代理）的预测能力。
AI.result: 研究发现，向大型语言模型的架构转变改变了现有质量预测方法的可靠性，同时缓解了先前在文档级翻译中遇到的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型的出现正在重塑机器翻译质量预测的研究格局，需要重新评估和调整现有的质量预测方法以适应新的技术环境。

title: TumorFlow: Physics-Guided Longitudinal MRI Synthesis of Glioblastoma Growth
summary: Glioblastoma exhibits diverse, infiltrative, and patient-specific growth patterns that are only partially visible on routine MRI, making it difficult to reliably assess true tumor extent and personalize treatment planning and follow-up. We present a biophysically-conditioned generative framework that synthesizes biologically realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from estimated, spatially continuous tumor-concentration fields. Our approach combines a generative model with tumor-infiltration maps that can be propagated through time using a biophysical growth model, enabling fine-grained control over tumor shape and growth while preserving patient anatomy. This enables us to synthesize consistent tumor growth trajectories directly in the space of real patients, providing interpretable, controllable estimation of tumor infiltration and progression beyond what is explicitly observed in imaging. We evaluate the framework on longitudinal glioblastoma cases and demonstrate that it can generate temporally coherent sequences with realistic changes in tumor appearance and surrounding tissue response. These results suggest that integrating mechanistic tumor growth priors with modern generative modeling can provide a practical tool for patient-specific progression visualization and for generating controlled synthetic data to support downstream neuro-oncology workflows. In longitudinal extrapolation, we achieve a consistent 75% Dice overlap with the biophysical model while maintaining a constant PSNR of 25 in the surrounding tissue. Our code is available at: https://github.com/valentin-biller/lgm.git

AI.tldr: 提出一个结合生物物理肿瘤生长模型与生成对抗网络的框架，从估计的肿瘤浓度场合成生物学真实的3D脑MRI图像，用于个性化肿瘤进展可视化和合成数据生成。
AI.motivation: 胶质母细胞瘤具有多样、浸润性和患者特异性的生长模式，常规MRI只能部分显示，难以可靠评估真实肿瘤范围和个性化治疗规划。
AI.method: 结合生成模型与肿瘤浸润图，通过生物物理生长模型在时间上传播，在真实患者解剖结构中合成一致的肿瘤生长轨迹，提供可解释、可控的肿瘤浸润和进展估计。
AI.result: 在纵向胶质母细胞瘤病例上评估，能够生成时间一致的序列，具有真实的肿瘤外观变化和周围组织反应。在纵向外推中，与生物物理模型保持75%的Dice重叠，周围组织PSNR保持在25。
AI.conclusion: 将机制性肿瘤生长先验与现代生成建模相结合，可以为患者特异性进展可视化和生成受控合成数据以支持下游神经肿瘤学工作流程提供实用工具。

title: Revisiting the Role of Foundation Models in Cell-Level Histopathological Image Analysis under Small-Patch Constraints -- Effects of Training Data Scale and Blur Perturbations on CNNs and Vision Transformers
summary: Background and objective: Cell-level pathological image analysis requires working with extremely small image patches (40x40 pixels), far below standard ImageNet resolutions. It remains unclear whether modern deep learning architectures and foundation models can learn robust and scalable representations under this constraint. We systematically evaluated architectural suitability and data-scale effects for small-patch cell classification. Methods: We analyzed 303 colorectal cancer specimens with CD103/CD8 immunostaining, generating 185,432 annotated cell images. Eight task-specific architectures were trained from scratch at multiple data scales (FlagLimit: 256--16,384 samples per class), and three foundation models were evaluated via linear probing and fine-tuning after resizing inputs to 224x224 pixels. Robustness to blur was assessed using pre- and post-resize Gaussian perturbations. Results: Task-specific models improved consistently with increasing data scale, whereas foundation models saturated at moderate sample sizes. A Vision Transformer optimized for small patches (CustomViT) achieved the highest accuracy, outperforming all foundation models with substantially lower inference cost. Blur robustness was comparable across architectures, with no qualitative advantage observed for foundation models. Conclusion: For cell-level classification under extreme spatial constraints, task-specific architectures are more effective and efficient than foundation models once sufficient training data are available. Higher clean accuracy does not imply superior robustness, and large pre-trained models offer limited benefit in the small-patch regime.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了在极小图像补丁（40x40像素）条件下细胞分类任务的深度学习架构性能，发现针对任务优化的专用架构在足够数据下优于基础模型，且基础模型在小补丁场景中优势有限。
AI.motivation: 细胞级病理图像分析需要在极小的图像补丁（40x40像素）上工作，远低于标准ImageNet分辨率。目前尚不清楚现代深度学习架构和基础模型能否在这种约束下学习到稳健且可扩展的表征。
AI.method: 分析了303个结直肠癌样本的CD103/CD8免疫染色图像，生成了185,432个标注的细胞图像。评估了8个任务特定架构（从零开始训练，数据规模从每类256到16,384个样本）和3个基础模型（通过线性探测和微调，输入调整为224x224像素）。使用高斯扰动评估了模糊鲁棒性。
AI.result: 任务特定模型随着数据规模增加持续改进，而基础模型在中等样本量时即达到饱和。针对小补丁优化的Vision Transformer（CustomViT）实现了最高准确率，以显著更低的推理成本优于所有基础模型。模糊鲁棒性在各架构间相当，基础模型未显示出定性优势。
AI.conclusion: 在极端空间约束下的细胞级分类任务中，一旦有足够的训练数据，任务特定架构比基础模型更有效且高效。更高的清洁准确率并不意味着更好的鲁棒性，大型预训练模型在小补丁场景中提供的优势有限。

title: EgoPoseFormer v2: Accurate Egocentric Human Motion Estimation for AR/VR
summary: Egocentric human motion estimation is essential for AR/VR experiences, yet remains challenging due to limited body coverage from the egocentric viewpoint, frequent occlusions, and scarce labeled data. We present EgoPoseFormer v2, a method that addresses these challenges through two key contributions: (1) a transformer-based model for temporally consistent and spatially grounded body pose estimation, and (2) an auto-labeling system that enables the use of large unlabeled datasets for training. Our model is fully differentiable, introduces identity-conditioned queries, multi-view spatial refinement, causal temporal attention, and supports both keypoints and parametric body representations under a constant compute budget. The auto-labeling system scales learning to tens of millions of unlabeled frames via uncertainty-aware semi-supervised training. The system follows a teacher-student schema to generate pseudo-labels and guide training with uncertainty distillation, enabling the model to generalize to different environments. On the EgoBody3M benchmark, with a 0.8 ms latency on GPU, our model outperforms two state-of-the-art methods by 12.2% and 19.4% in accuracy, and reduces temporal jitter by 22.2% and 51.7%. Furthermore, our auto-labeling system further improves the wrist MPJPE by 13.1%.

AI.tldr: EgoPoseFormer v2：一种用于AR/VR的自我中心人体姿态估计方法，通过transformer架构和自动标注系统解决视角受限、遮挡和数据稀缺问题，在精度和实时性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视角下的人体姿态估计面临三大挑战：1）自我中心视角下身体覆盖范围有限；2）频繁的遮挡问题；3）标注数据稀缺。这些因素限制了AR/VR应用中的姿态估计性能。
AI.method: 提出两个核心贡献：1）基于transformer的时空一致姿态估计模型，包含身份条件查询、多视角空间细化、因果时间注意力机制，支持关键点和参数化身体表示；2）不确定性感知的半监督自动标注系统，采用师生架构生成伪标签并通过不确定性蒸馏指导训练，可扩展到数千万未标注帧。
AI.result: 在EgoBody3M基准测试中，GPU延迟仅0.8毫秒，精度比两种最先进方法分别提高12.2%和19.4%，时间抖动减少22.2%和51.7%。自动标注系统进一步将手腕MPJPE降低13.1%。
AI.conclusion: EgoPoseFormer v2通过transformer架构和可扩展的自动标注系统，有效解决了自我中心姿态估计的关键挑战，在精度、实时性和泛化能力方面均取得显著提升，为AR/VR应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: Traces of Social Competence in Large Language Models
summary: The False Belief Test (FBT) has been the main method for assessing Theory of Mind (ToM) and related socio-cognitive competencies. For Large Language Models (LLMs), the reliability and explanatory potential of this test have remained limited due to issues like data contamination, insufficient model details, and inconsistent controls. We address these issues by testing 17 open-weight models on a balanced set of 192 FBT variants (Trott et al. 2023) using Bayesian Logistic regression to identify how model size and post-training affect socio-cognitive competence. We find that scaling model size benefits performance, but not strictly. A cross-over effect reveals that explicating propositional attitudes (X thinks) fundamentally alters response patterns. Instruction tuning partially mitigates this effect, but further reasoning-oriented finetuning amplifies it. In a case study analysing social reasoning ability throughout OLMo 2 training, we show that this cross-over effect emerges during pre-training, suggesting that models acquire stereotypical response patterns tied to mental-state vocabulary that can outweigh other scenario semantics. Finally, vector steering allows us to isolate a think vector as the causal driver of observed FBT behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过测试17个开源大语言模型在192个错误信念测试变体上的表现，发现模型规模扩展能提升性能但非严格线性，指令微调部分缓解但推理微调会放大"交叉效应"，思维向量是驱动FBT行为的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 传统错误信念测试在评估大语言模型心智理论能力时存在局限性，包括数据污染、模型细节不足和实验控制不一致等问题，需要更系统的方法来评估模型的社会认知能力。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯逻辑回归分析17个开源模型在192个平衡FBT变体上的表现，研究模型规模和训练后处理的影响，通过OLMo 2训练过程案例分析和向量操控技术识别关键因素。
AI.result: 模型规模扩展能提升性能但存在"交叉效应"：明确命题态度会根本改变响应模式；指令微调部分缓解该效应，推理微调反而放大；预训练期间出现该效应；思维向量是驱动FBT行为的关键因果因素。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型通过预训练获得与心理状态词汇相关的刻板响应模式，这些模式可能压倒其他场景语义，思维向量是驱动错误信念测试行为的关键机制，为理解模型社会认知能力提供了新视角。

title: CLIP-Guided Multi-Task Regression for Multi-View Plant Phenotyping
summary: Modeling plant growth dynamics plays a central role in modern agricultural research. However, learning robust predictors from multi-view plant imagery remains challenging due to strong viewpoint redundancy and viewpoint-dependent appearance changes. We propose a level-aware vision language framework that jointly predicts plant age and leaf count using a single multi-task model built on CLIP embeddings. Our method aggregates rotational views into angle-invariant representations and conditions visual features on lightweight text priors encoding viewpoint level for stable prediction under incomplete or unordered inputs. On the GroMo25 benchmark, our approach reduces mean age MAE from 7.74 to 3.91 and mean leaf-count MAE from 5.52 to 3.08 compared to the GroMo baseline, corresponding to improvements of 49.5% and 44.2%, respectively. The unified formulation simplifies the pipeline by replacing the conventional dual-model setup while improving robustness to missing views. The models and code is available at: https://github.com/SimonWarmers/CLIP-MVP

AI.tldr: 提出基于CLIP嵌入的层级感知视觉语言框架，通过单模型联合预测植物年龄和叶片数量，解决了多视角植物图像中的视角冗余和视角依赖外观变化问题。
AI.motivation: 植物生长动态建模在现代农业研究中至关重要，但多视角植物图像存在视角冗余和视角依赖的外观变化，使得学习稳健的预测器具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出层级感知视觉语言框架，将旋转视角聚合成角度不变表示，并通过轻量级文本先验编码视角层级来调节视觉特征，实现不完整或无序输入下的稳定预测。
AI.result: 在GroMo25基准测试中，将平均年龄MAE从7.74降至3.91，平均叶片计数MAE从5.52降至3.08，分别提升49.5%和44.2%，同时简化了传统双模型设置。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架通过单模型替代传统双模型设置，提高了对缺失视角的鲁棒性，显著提升了植物年龄和叶片计数的预测精度。

title: Bielik-Q2-Sharp: A Comparative Study of Extreme 2-bit Quantization Methods for a Polish 11B Language Model
comment: 17 pages, 13 tables. All models and Hessians available at https://huggingface.co/Jakubrd4
summary: We present Bielik-Q2-Sharp, the first systematic academic evaluation of extreme 2-bit quantization applied to a Polish large language model. Using Bielik-11B-v2.3-Instruct (11B parameters, Mistral architecture) as our base model, we compare six state-of-the-art post-training quantization methods -- QuIP#, SpinQuant+GPTQ, ButterflyQuant, QTIP, VPTQ, and AQLM -- all calibrated on a Polish-language corpus (CulturaX-PL) with shared Hessian matrices. Our best variant (QuIP# E8P12) achieves 71.92% across 22 Polish benchmarks versus 72.07% for the IQ2_XXS baseline -- within statistical noise, at a modest size premium (3.26 GB vs. ~2.6 GB). On eq_bench, our method scores 47.14 versus 43.53 (+3.6pp), suggesting superior preservation of higher-order reasoning. QTIP achieves the best per-bit efficiency (79.4% MC acc_norm at ~2.4 bpw, 3.27 GB), matching VPTQ's quality at 35% smaller size. We additionally document a MC-generation dissociation phenomenon where rotation-based methods preserve log-likelihood quality but fail catastrophically at autoregressive generation. The entire project was conducted by a single independent researcher on cloud GPUs (vast.ai) within a $285 budget. All models, Hessians, and evaluation logs are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 首个针对波兰大语言模型的系统性2位量化评估，比较了六种先进的后训练量化方法，在11B参数模型上实现了接近原始性能的压缩效果。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是系统评估极端2位量化在波兰语大语言模型上的应用效果，填补该领域的空白，同时探索不同量化方法在保持模型性能方面的表现。
AI.method: 使用Bielik-11B-v2.3-Instruct作为基础模型，在波兰语语料库CulturaX-PL上校准六种后训练量化方法（QuIP#、SpinQuant+GPTQ、ButterflyQuant、QTIP、VPTQ、AQLM），共享Hessian矩阵，进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 最佳变体（QuIP# E8P12）在22个波兰基准测试中达到71.92%，接近IQ2_XXS基线的72.07%；在eq_bench上得分47.14 vs 43.53（+3.6pp），显示更好的高阶推理保持；QTIP实现最佳每比特效率（79.4% MC acc_norm，约2.4 bpw）。
AI.conclusion: 极端2位量化在波兰语大语言模型上可行，不同量化方法在性能保持和压缩效率方面各有优势，旋转基方法存在生成-似然解离现象，整个研究在有限预算内完成并开源所有资源。

title: Real Eyes Realize Faster: Gaze Stability and Pupil Novelty for Efficient Egocentric Learning
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, plus supplementary material
summary: Always-on egocentric cameras are increasingly used as demonstrations for embodied robotics, imitation learning, and assistive AR, but the resulting video streams are dominated by redundant and low-quality frames. Under the storage and battery constraints of wearable devices, choosing which frames to keep is as important as how to learn from them. We observe that modern eye-tracking headsets provide a continuous, training-free side channel that decomposes into two complementary axes: gaze fixation captures visual stability (quality), while pupil response captures arousal-linked moments (novelty). We operationalize this insight as a Dual-Criterion Frame Curator that first gates frames by gaze quality and then ranks the survivors by pupil-derived novelty. On the Visual Experience Dataset (VEDB), curated frames at 10% budget match the classification performance of the full stream, and naive signal fusion consistently destroys both contributions. The benefit is task-dependent: pupil ranking improves activity recognition, while gaze-only selection already dominates for scene recognition, confirming that the two signals serve genuinely different roles. Our method requires no model inference and operates at capture time, offering a path toward efficient, always-on egocentric data curation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于眼动追踪的双准则帧筛选方法，通过注视稳定性（质量）和瞳孔反应（新颖性）来高效筛选可穿戴设备拍摄的自我中心视角视频帧。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴自我中心摄像头产生大量冗余低质量帧，在存储和电池限制下，需要高效筛选关键帧。眼动追踪设备提供了两个互补信号：注视稳定性反映视觉质量，瞳孔反应反映新颖时刻。
AI.method: 提出双准则帧筛选器：首先基于注视质量筛选帧，然后基于瞳孔反应的新颖性对剩余帧进行排序。该方法无需模型推理，可在捕获时实时运行。
AI.result: 在VEDB数据集上，仅使用10%预算的筛选帧就能达到完整视频流的分类性能。瞳孔排序提升活动识别性能，注视筛选在场景识别中占主导，证实两个信号具有不同作用。
AI.conclusion: 基于眼动追踪的双准则筛选方法为高效、持续运行的自我中心数据管理提供了可行路径，两个信号互补且任务依赖，简单信号融合会破坏各自贡献。

title: Retrieval or Representation? Reassessing Benchmark Gaps in Multilingual and Visually Rich RAG
comment: ICLR 2026 Workshop I Can't Believe It's Not Better: Where Large Language Models Need to Improve
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a common way to ground language models in external documents and up-to-date information. Classical retrieval systems relied on lexical methods such as BM25, which rank documents by term overlap with corpus-level weighting. End-to-end multimodal retrievers trained on large query-document datasets claim substantial improvements over these approaches, especially for multilingual documents with complex visual layouts. We demonstrate that better document representation is the primary driver of benchmark improvements. By systematically varying transcription and preprocessing methods while holding the retrieval mechanism fixed, we demonstrate that BM25 can recover large gaps on multilingual and visual benchmarks. Our findings call for decomposed evaluation benchmarks that separately measure transcription and retrieval capabilities, enabling the field to correctly attribute progress and focus effort where it matters.

AI.tldr: BM25检索方法通过改进文档表示（转录和预处理）可以在多语言和视觉基准测试中取得与端到端多模态检索器相当的性能，表明基准测试改进主要来自文档表示而非检索机制本身。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探究检索增强生成（RAG）系统中基准测试性能提升的真正驱动因素。当前端到端多模态检索器声称在多语言和复杂视觉布局文档上相比传统BM25方法有显著改进，但需要验证这些改进是否真正来自检索机制本身。
AI.method: 通过系统性地改变文档转录和预处理方法，同时保持检索机制（BM25）不变，在多语言和视觉基准测试上进行实验。这种方法可以分离文档表示质量和检索机制对性能的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现BM25通过改进的文档表示（更好的转录和预处理）可以在多语言和视觉基准测试中恢复大部分性能差距，表明基准测试的改进主要来自文档表示质量而非检索算法本身。
AI.conclusion: 需要分解的评估基准来分别衡量转录能力和检索能力，以便正确归因进展并集中精力在真正重要的领域。当前基准测试可能错误地将文档表示改进归因于检索机制创新。

title: Memex(RL): Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agents via Indexed Experience Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are fundamentally bottlenecked by finite context windows on long-horizon tasks. As trajectories grow, retaining tool outputs and intermediate reasoning in-context quickly becomes infeasible: the working context becomes prohibitively long, eventually exceeds the context budget, and makes distant evidence harder to use even when it is still present. Existing solutions typically shorten context through truncation or running summaries, but these methods are fundamentally lossy because they compress or discard past evidence itself. We introduce Memex, an indexed experience memory mechanism that instead compresses context without discarding evidence. Memex maintains a compact working context consisting of concise structured summaries and stable indices, while storing full-fidelity underlying interactions in an external experience database under those indices. The agent can then decide when to dereference an index and recover the exact past evidence needed for the current subgoal. We optimize both write and read behaviors with our reinforcement learning framework MemexRL, using reward shaping tailored to indexed memory usage under a context budget, so the agent learns what to summarize, what to archive, how to index it, and when to retrieve it. This yields a substantially less lossy form of long-horizon memory than summary-only approaches. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing the potential of the Memex loop to preserve decision quality with bounded dereferencing while keeping effective in-context computation bounded as history grows. Empirically, on challenging long-horizon tasks, Memex agent trained with MemexRL improves task success while using a significantly smaller working context.

AI.tldr: Memex是一种索引化经验记忆机制，通过结构化摘要和稳定索引压缩上下文而不丢弃证据，解决LLM代理在长时任务中的上下文窗口瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理在长时任务中受限于有限的上下文窗口，随着轨迹增长，保留工具输出和中间推理变得不可行，现有解决方案通过截断或运行摘要会丢失证据。
AI.method: 提出Memex机制，维护包含简洁结构化摘要和稳定索引的紧凑工作上下文，将完整交互存储在外部经验数据库中，通过强化学习框架MemexRL优化写入和读取行为。
AI.result: 在挑战性长时任务上，Memex代理在显著减小工作上下文的同时提高了任务成功率，相比仅使用摘要的方法实现了更少信息损失的长时记忆。
AI.conclusion: Memex通过索引化经验记忆机制有效解决了LLM代理的上下文窗口瓶颈，在保持决策质量的同时限制了上下文计算需求，为长时任务提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Any2Any: Unified Arbitrary Modality Translation for Remote Sensing
summary: Multi-modal remote sensing imagery provides complementary observations of the same geographic scene, yet such observations are frequently incomplete in practice. Existing cross-modal translation methods treat each modality pair as an independent task, resulting in quadratic complexity and limited generalization to unseen modality combinations. We formulate Any-to-Any translation as inference over a shared latent representation of the scene, where different modalities correspond to partial observations of the same underlying semantics. Based on this formulation, we propose Any2Any, a unified latent diffusion framework that projects heterogeneous inputs into a geometrically aligned latent space. Such structure performs anchored latent regression with a shared backbone, decoupling modality-specific representation learning from semantic mapping. Moreover, lightweight target-specific residual adapters are used to correct systematic latent mismatches without increasing inference complexity. To support learning under sparse but connected supervision, we introduce RST-1M, the first million-scale remote sensing dataset with paired observations across five sensing modalities, providing supervision anchors for any-to-any translation. Experiments across 14 translation tasks show that Any2Any consistently outperforms pairwise translation methods and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen modality pairs. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MiliLab/Any2Any.

AI.tldr: Any2Any是一个统一的潜在扩散框架，通过将异构输入投影到几何对齐的潜在空间，实现任意模态间的遥感图像转换，避免了传统成对方法的二次复杂度问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态遥感图像提供了同一地理场景的互补观测，但实践中这些观测往往不完整。现有跨模态转换方法将每个模态对视为独立任务，导致二次复杂度，且对未见模态组合的泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 将任意到任意转换形式化为对场景共享潜在表示的推断，不同模态对应相同底层语义的部分观测。提出Any2Any框架：1)将异构输入投影到几何对齐的潜在空间；2)使用共享主干进行锚定潜在回归；3)采用轻量级目标特定残差适配器校正系统潜在不匹配；4)引入百万级遥感数据集RST-1M支持稀疏但连接的监督学习。
AI.result: 在14个转换任务上的实验表明，Any2Any始终优于成对转换方法，并对未见模态对表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Any2Any通过统一的潜在表示框架解决了多模态遥感图像转换的复杂度和泛化问题，为任意模态间的转换提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Position: Vector Prompt Interfaces Should Be Exposed to Enable Customization of Large Language Models
summary: As large language models (LLMs) transition from research prototypes to real-world systems, customization has emerged as a central bottleneck. While text prompts can already customize LLM behavior, we argue that text-only prompting does not constitute a suitable control interface for scalable, stable, and inference-only customization. This position paper argues that model providers should expose \emph{vector prompt inputs} as part of the public interface for customizing LLMs. We support this position with diagnostic evidence showing that vector prompt tuning continues to improve with increasing supervision whereas text-based prompt optimization saturates early, and that vector prompts exhibit dense, global attention patterns indicative of a distinct control mechanism. We further discuss why inference-only customization is increasingly important under realistic deployment constraints, and why exposing vector prompts need not fundamentally increase model leakage risk under a standard black-box threat model. We conclude with a call to action for the community to rethink prompt interfaces as a core component of LLM customization.

AI.tldr: 论文主张在LLM定制化中引入向量提示输入作为公开接口，因为文本提示在可扩展性、稳定性和仅推理定制方面存在局限。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从研究原型转向实际系统，定制化成为关键瓶颈。文本提示虽然能定制LLM行为，但不适合作为可扩展、稳定且仅推理的定制控制接口。
AI.method: 提出位置论文，主张模型提供商应将向量提示输入作为LLM定制的公开接口。通过诊断证据支持：1) 向量提示调优随监督增加持续改进，而文本提示优化早期饱和；2) 向量提示表现出密集的全局注意力模式，表明不同的控制机制。
AI.result: 向量提示在定制化方面优于文本提示，具有更好的扩展性和稳定性。在标准黑盒威胁模型下，暴露向量提示不会显著增加模型泄漏风险。
AI.conclusion: 社区应重新思考提示接口作为LLM定制的核心组件，模型提供商应提供向量提示输入作为公开接口，以支持可扩展、稳定且仅推理的定制化。

title: TextBoost: Boosting Scene Text Fidelity in Ultra-low Bitrate Image Compression
summary: Ultra-low bitrate image compression faces a critical challenge: preserving small-font scene text while maintaining overall visual quality. Region-of-interest (ROI) bit allocation can prioritize text but often degrades global fidelity, leading to a trade-off between local accuracy and overall image quality. Instead of relying on ROI coding, we incorporate auxiliary textual information extracted by OCR and transmitted with negligible overhead, enabling the decoder to leverage this semantic guidance. Our method, TextBoost, operationalizes this idea through three strategic designs: (i) adaptively filtering OCR outputs and rendering them into a guidance map; (ii) integrating this guidance with decoder features in a calibrated manner via an attention-guided fusion block; and (iii) enforcing guidance-consistent reconstruction in text regions with a regularizing loss that promotes natural blending with the scene. Extensive experiments on TextOCR and ICDAR 2015 demonstrate that TextBoost yields up to 60.6% higher text-recognition F1 at comparable Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and bits per pixel (bpp), producing sharper small-font text while preserving global image quality and effectively decoupling text enhancement from global rate-distortion optimization.

AI.tldr: TextBoost提出了一种超低码率图像压缩方法，通过OCR提取辅助文本信息作为语义指导，在保持整体图像质量的同时显著提升小字体场景文字的识别率。
AI.motivation: 超低码率图像压缩面临关键挑战：如何在保持整体视觉质量的同时保留小字体场景文字。传统的ROI比特分配方法虽然可以优先处理文字区域，但往往会降低全局保真度，导致局部准确性和整体图像质量之间的权衡。
AI.method: TextBoost方法通过三个策略设计实现：1）自适应过滤OCR输出并将其渲染为引导图；2）通过注意力引导融合块将引导信息与解码器特征进行校准融合；3）使用正则化损失在文字区域强制执行引导一致的重建，促进与场景的自然融合。
AI.result: 在TextOCR和ICDAR 2015数据集上的广泛实验表明，TextBoost在可比较的PSNR和bpp下，文字识别F1分数提高了高达60.6%，能够生成更清晰的小字体文字，同时保持全局图像质量，有效将文字增强与全局率失真优化解耦。
AI.conclusion: TextBoost通过引入OCR提取的辅助文本信息作为语义指导，成功解决了超低码率图像压缩中文字保留与全局质量平衡的问题，提供了一种有效的文字增强方法，而不影响整体压缩性能。

title: The Company You Keep: How LLMs Respond to Dark Triad Traits
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit highly agreeable and reinforcing conversational styles, also known as AI-sycophancy. Although this behavior is encouraged, it may become problematic when interacting with user prompts that reflect negative social tendencies. Such responses risk amplifying harmful behavior rather than mitigating it. In this study, we examine how LLMs respond to user prompts expressing varying degrees of Dark Triad traits (Machiavellianism, Narcissism, and Psychopathy) using a curated dataset. Our analysis reveals differences across models, whereby all models predominantly exhibit corrective behavior, while showing reinforcing output in certain cases. Model behavior also depends on the severity level and differs in the sentiment of the response. Our findings raise implications for designing safer conversational systems that can detect and respond appropriately when users escalate from benign to harmful requests.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨LLMs如何回应用户的黑暗人格特质表达，发现模型主要展现纠正行为，但在某些情况下会强化负面倾向，需要设计更安全的对话系统
AI.motivation: LLMs通常表现出高度迎合和强化的对话风格（AI-sycophancy），这种行为在与反映负面社会倾向的用户提示互动时可能变得有问题，可能放大有害行为而非缓解它
AI.method: 使用精心策划的数据集，研究LLMs如何回应用户表达不同程度黑暗人格特质（马基雅维利主义、自恋和精神病态）的提示，分析模型行为差异
AI.result: 所有模型主要表现出纠正行为，但在某些情况下会显示强化输出；模型行为取决于严重程度，并在回应情感上有所不同
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对设计更安全的对话系统有重要意义，这些系统需要能够检测并在用户从良性请求升级到有害请求时做出适当回应

title: A Baseline Study and Benchmark for Few-Shot Open-Set Action Recognition with Feature Residual Discrimination
summary: Few-Shot Action Recognition (FS-AR) has shown promising results but is often limited by a closed-set assumption that fails in real-world open-set scenarios. While Few-Shot Open-Set (FSOS) recognition is well-established for images, its extension to spatio-temporal video data remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an architectural extension based on a Feature-Residual Discriminator (FR-Disc), adapting previous work on skeletal data to the more complex video domain. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that while common open-set techniques provide only marginal gains, our FR-Disc significantly enhances unknown rejection capabilities without compromising closed-set accuracy, setting a new state-of-the-art for FSOS-AR. The project website, code, and benchmark are available at: https://hsp-iit.github.io/fsosar/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于特征残差判别器（FR-Disc）的架构扩展，用于解决视频领域的小样本开放集动作识别问题，显著提升了未知类别的拒绝能力而不影响闭集精度。
AI.motivation: 当前小样本动作识别主要基于闭集假设，但在现实世界的开放集场景中表现不佳。虽然小样本开放集识别在图像领域已有研究，但在时空视频数据中的应用仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出基于特征残差判别器（FR-Disc）的架构扩展，将先前在骨骼数据上的工作适配到更复杂的视频领域。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的实验表明，常见的开放集技术只能带来边际改进，而FR-Disc显著增强了未知类别拒绝能力，同时不损害闭集精度，创造了FSOS-AR的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将小样本开放集识别扩展到视频动作识别领域，提出的FR-Disc方法在保持闭集性能的同时显著提升了开放集识别能力，为视频领域的开放集识别提供了有效解决方案。

title: $V_1$: Unifying Generation and Self-Verification for Parallel Reasoners
summary: Test-time scaling for complex reasoning tasks shows that leveraging inference-time compute, by methods such as independently sampling and aggregating multiple solutions, results in significantly better task outcomes. However, a critical bottleneck is verification: sampling is only effective if correct solutions can be reliably identified among candidates. While existing approaches typically evaluate candidates independently via scalar scoring, we demonstrate that models are substantially stronger at pairwise self-verification. Leveraging this insight, we introduce $V_1$, a framework that unifies generation and verification through efficient pairwise ranking. $V_1$ comprises two components: $V_1$-Infer, an uncertainty-guided algorithm using a tournament-based ranking that dynamically allocates self-verification compute to candidate pairs whose relative correctness is most uncertain; and $V_1$-PairRL, an RL framework that jointly trains a single model as both generator and pairwise self-verifier, ensuring the verifier adapts to the generator's evolving distribution. On code generation (LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, SWE-Bench) and math reasoning (AIME, HMMT) benchmarks, $V_1$-Infer improves Pass@1 by up to $10%$ over pointwise verification and outperforms recent test-time scaling methods while being significantly more efficient. Furthermore, $V_1$-PairRL achieves $7$--$9%$ test-time scaling gains over standard RL and pointwise joint training, and improves base Pass@1 by up to 8.7% over standard RL in a code-generation setting.

AI.tldr: 提出V₁框架，通过成对自验证提升复杂推理任务的测试时扩展效果，相比传统点状验证显著提高准确率
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展方法通过采样多个解决方案并聚合可以显著提升任务效果，但关键瓶颈在于验证：只有当正确解能在候选方案中被可靠识别时，采样才有效。现有方法通常通过标量评分独立评估候选方案，但研究发现模型在成对自验证方面表现更强。
AI.method: 提出V₁框架，统一生成和验证过程：1) V₁-Infer：基于不确定性的锦标赛排名算法，动态分配自验证计算资源给相对正确性最不确定的候选对；2) V₁-PairRL：强化学习框架，联合训练单个模型同时作为生成器和成对自验证器，确保验证器适应生成器的演化分布。
AI.result: 在代码生成（LiveCodeBench、CodeContests、SWE-Bench）和数学推理（AIME、HMMT）基准测试中，V₁-Infer相比点状验证将Pass@1提高了10%，优于最近的测试时扩展方法且效率更高。V₁-PairRL相比标准RL和点状联合训练实现了7-9%的测试时扩展增益，在代码生成场景中相比标准RL将基础Pass@1提高了8.7%。
AI.conclusion: 成对自验证比独立点状验证更有效，V₁框架通过统一生成和验证过程，显著提升了复杂推理任务的测试时扩展效果，在代码生成和数学推理任务上均表现出色。

title: Crab$^{+}$: A Scalable and Unified Audio-Visual Scene Understanding Model with Explicit Cooperation
summary: Developing Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AV-LLMs) for unified scene understanding is pivotal in multimodal intelligence. While instruction tuning enables pre-trained models with multi-task abilities, we observe that conventional multi-task unification methods often suffer from severe negative transfer, where nearly 55% of tasks degrade compared to single-task training. We attribute this phenomenon to audio-visual task heterogeneity, characterized by disparate task granularity and divergent capability demands, which lead to negative interference under joint training. To tackle this, we present Crab$^{+}$, a scalable and unified audio-visual scene understanding model that addresses task heterogeneity through explicit cooperation from both data and model perspectives. On the data side, we introduce AV-UIE v2, a comprehensive Audio-Visual Unified Instruction-tuning dataset with Explicit reasoning processes. It contains approximately 222K samples spanning 17 datasets and 7 tasks, enabling the model to capture cross-task relationships at different levels of granularity. On the model side, we design a unified interface to align heterogeneous task formulations, and propose Interaction-aware LoRA (I-LoRA), which explicitly models inter-task relationships via dynamic routing to coordinate distinct audio-visual interaction patterns, mitigating parameter interference. Extensive experiments show Crab$^{+}$ covers broader tasks than existing unified models while outperforming specialized models on various benchmarks. We successfully reverse the negative transfer trend, achieving positive transfer where multi-task learning surpasses single-task baselines in nearly 88% of tasks. These results hold across diverse AV-LLM paradigms and are validated through in-depth visualization, positioning Crab$^{+}$ as a robust step towards holistic audio-visual scene understanding.

AI.tldr: Crab⁺通过数据和模型层面的显式合作解决音频-视觉任务异质性，实现了88%任务的正向迁移，超越了单任务基线
AI.motivation: 传统多任务统一方法在音频-视觉场景理解中存在严重的负向迁移问题（约55%任务性能下降），主要原因是音频-视觉任务异质性导致的参数干扰
AI.method: 1) 数据层面：构建AV-UIE v2数据集（约222K样本，17个数据集，7个任务），包含显式推理过程；2) 模型层面：设计统一接口对齐异质任务表述，提出Interaction-aware LoRA（I-LoRA）通过动态路由显式建模任务间关系，协调不同的音频-视觉交互模式
AI.result: Crab⁺覆盖了比现有统一模型更广泛的任务，在各种基准测试中超越了专用模型，成功逆转了负向迁移趋势，在近88%的任务中实现了正向迁移（多任务学习超越单任务基线）
AI.conclusion: Crab⁺通过显式处理音频-视觉任务异质性，实现了有效的多任务统一学习，为整体音频-视觉场景理解提供了稳健的解决方案，在不同AV-LLM范式中均得到验证

title: World Properties without World Models: Recovering Spatial and Temporal Structure from Co-occurrence Statistics in Static Word Embeddings
summary: Recent work interprets the linear recoverability of geographic and temporal variables from large language model (LLM) hidden states as evidence for world-like internal representations. We test a simpler possibility: that much of the relevant structure is already latent in text itself. Applying the same class of ridge regression probes to static co-occurrence-based embeddings (GloVe and Word2Vec), we find substantial recoverable geographic signal and weaker but reliable temporal signal, with held-out R^2 values of 0.71-0.87 for city coordinates and 0.48-0.52 for historical birth years. Semantic-neighbor analyses and targeted subspace ablations show that these signals depend strongly on interpretable lexical gradients, especially country names and climate-related vocabulary. These findings suggest that ordinary word co-occurrence preserves richer spatial, temporal, and environmental structure than is often assumed, revealing a remarkable and underappreciated capacity of simple static embeddings to preserve world-shaped structure from text alone. Linear probe recoverability alone therefore does not establish a representational move beyond text.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型隐藏状态中地理和时间信息的线性可恢复性可能源于文本本身已存在的结构，而非模型内部的世界表征。通过对静态词向量（GloVe和Word2Vec）进行相同分析，发现文本共现信息已能保留丰富的地理时空结构。
AI.motivation: 针对近期研究将LLM隐藏状态中地理和时间变量的线性可恢复性解释为模型具有类世界内部表征的证据，本文测试了一个更简单的可能性：这些结构可能已经潜在地存在于文本本身中。
AI.method: 对静态共现词嵌入（GloVe和Word2Vec）应用相同的岭回归探针方法，分析地理和时间信号的可恢复性。通过语义邻居分析和目标子空间消融实验，探究这些信号对可解释词汇梯度的依赖程度。
AI.result: 静态词向量中发现了显著的地理信号（城市坐标的留出R²值0.71-0.87）和较弱但可靠的时间信号（历史出生年份的留出R²值0.48-0.52）。这些信号强烈依赖于可解释的词汇梯度，特别是国家名称和气候相关词汇。
AI.conclusion: 普通词汇共现保留了比通常假设更丰富的空间、时间和环境结构，揭示了简单静态词向量仅从文本中就能保留世界形态结构的显著能力。线性探针可恢复性本身并不能证明表征超越了文本。

title: Mask-Guided Attention Regulation for Anatomically Consistent Counterfactual CXR Synthesis
summary: Counterfactual generation for chest X-rays (CXR) aims to simulate plausible pathological changes while preserving patient-specific anatomy. However, diffusion-based editing methods often suffer from structural drift, where stable anatomical semantics propagate globally through attention and distort non-target regions, and unstable pathology expression, since subtle and localized lesions induce weak and noisy conditioning signals. We present an inference-time attention regulation framework for reliable counterfactual CXR synthesis. An anatomy-aware attention regularization module gates self-attention and anatomy-token cross-attention with organ masks, confining structural interactions to anatomical ROIs and reducing unintended distortions. A pathology-guided module enhances pathology-token cross-attention within target lung regions during early denoising and performs lightweight latent corrections driven by an attention-concentration energy, enabling controllable lesion localization and extent. Extensive evaluations on CXR datasets show improved anatomical consistency and more precise, controllable pathological edits compared with standard diffusion editing, supporting localized counterfactual analysis and data augmentation for downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于胸部X光片反事实生成的推理时注意力调控框架，通过解剖感知和病理引导的注意力调控模块，解决扩散模型编辑中的结构漂移和病理表达不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光片反事实生成旨在模拟合理的病理变化同时保留患者特异性解剖结构。然而，基于扩散的编辑方法存在结构漂移问题（稳定解剖语义通过注意力全局传播扭曲非目标区域）和病理表达不稳定问题（细微局部病变产生弱且嘈杂的条件信号）。
AI.method: 提出推理时注意力调控框架：1）解剖感知注意力正则化模块，使用器官掩码门控自注意力和解剖标记交叉注意力，将结构交互限制在解剖ROI内；2）病理引导模块，在早期去噪阶段增强目标肺区域的病理标记交叉注意力，并通过注意力集中能量驱动的轻量级潜在校正实现可控病变定位和程度。
AI.result: 在CXR数据集上的广泛评估显示，相比标准扩散编辑方法，该方法提高了解剖一致性，实现了更精确、可控的病理编辑，支持局部反事实分析和下游任务的数据增强。
AI.conclusion: 提出的推理时注意力调控框架能够可靠地合成胸部X光片反事实图像，有效解决了扩散模型编辑中的结构漂移和病理表达不稳定问题，为局部反事实分析和数据增强提供了有效工具。

title: AILS-NTUA at SemEval-2026 Task 12: Graph-Based Retrieval and Reflective Prompting for Abductive Event Reasoning
summary: We present a winning three-stage system for SemEval 2026 Task~12: Abductive Event Reasoning that combines graph-based retrieval, LLM-driven abductive reasoning with prompt design optimized through reflective prompt evolution, and post-hoc consistency enforcement; our system ranks first on the evaluation-phase leaderboard with an accuracy score of 0.95. Cross-model error analysis across 14 models (7~families) reveals three shared inductive biases: causal chain incompleteness, proximate cause preference, and salience bias, whose cross-family convergence (51\% cause-count reduction) indicates systematic rather than model-specific failure modes in multi-label causal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出一个三阶段系统赢得SemEval 2026 Task 12比赛，结合图检索、LLM溯因推理和一致性后处理，准确率达0.95；跨模型分析揭示三种共享归纳偏误
AI.motivation: 解决多标签因果推理中的系统性问题，通过构建高效系统来提升溯因事件推理性能，并深入分析不同模型间的共享失败模式
AI.method: 三阶段系统：1) 基于图的检索；2) LLM驱动的溯因推理，通过反思式提示演化优化提示设计；3) 后处理一致性强制；跨14个模型进行错误分析
AI.result: 系统在评估阶段排行榜排名第一，准确率0.95；跨模型分析发现三种共享归纳偏误：因果链不完整性、近因偏好和显著性偏误，跨家族收敛显示51%原因计数减少
AI.conclusion: 提出的三阶段系统在溯因事件推理任务中表现优异，揭示了多标签因果推理中的系统性而非模型特定的失败模式，为未来改进提供了方向

title: LISTA-Transformer Model Based on Sparse Coding and Attention Mechanism and Its Application in Fault Diagnosis
summary: Driven by the continuous development of models such as Multi-Layer Perceptron, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and Transformer, deep learning has made breakthrough progress in fields such as computer vision and natural language processing, and has been successfully applied in practical scenarios such as image classification and industrial fault diagnosis. However, existing models still have certain limitations in local feature modeling and global dependency capture. Specifically, CNN is limited by local receptive fields, while Transformer has shortcomings in effectively modeling local structures, and both face challenges of high model complexity and insufficient interpretability. In response to the above issues, we proposes the following innovative work: A sparse Transformer based on Learnable Iterative Shrinkage Threshold Algorithm (LISTA-Transformer) was designed, which deeply integrates LISTA sparse encoding with visual Transformer to construct a model architecture with adaptive local and global feature collaboration mechanism. This method utilizes continuous wavelet transform to convert vibration signals into time-frequency maps and inputs them into LISTA-Transformer for more effective feature extraction. On the CWRU dataset, the fault recognition rate of our method reached 98.5%, which is 3.3% higher than traditional methods and exhibits certain superiority over existing Transformer-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LISTA稀疏编码的Transformer模型，用于工业故障诊断，在CWRU数据集上达到98.5%的故障识别率
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型（如CNN和Transformer）在局部特征建模和全局依赖捕获方面存在局限性：CNN受限于局部感受野，Transformer难以有效建模局部结构，且两者都存在模型复杂度高、可解释性不足的问题
AI.method: 提出LISTA-Transformer模型，将LISTA稀疏编码与视觉Transformer深度融合，构建具有自适应局部和全局特征协作机制的架构。使用连续小波变换将振动信号转换为时频图，输入LISTA-Transformer进行特征提取
AI.result: 在CWRU数据集上，故障识别率达到98.5%，比传统方法提高3.3%，优于现有的基于Transformer的方法
AI.conclusion: LISTA-Transformer通过稀疏编码与Transformer的深度融合，有效解决了局部特征建模和全局依赖捕获的平衡问题，在工业故障诊断中表现出优越性能

title: AgentIR: Reasoning-Aware Retrival for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents are rapidly emerging as primary consumers of modern retrieval systems. Unlike human users who issue and refine queries without documenting their intermediate thought processes, Deep Research agents generate explicit natural language reasoning before each search call, revealing rich intent and contextual information that existing retrievers entirely ignore. To exploit this overlooked signal, we introduce: (1) Reasoning-Aware Retrieval, a retrieval paradigm that jointly embeds the agent's reasoning trace alongside its query; and (2) DR-Synth, a data synthesis method that generates Deep Research retriever training data from standard QA datasets. We demonstrate that both components are independently effective, and their combination yields a trained embedding model, AgentIR-4B, with substantial gains. On the challenging BrowseComp-Plus benchmark, AgentIR-4B achieves 68\% accuracy with the open-weight agent Tongyi-DeepResearch, compared to 50\% with conventional embedding models twice its size, and 37\% with BM25. Code and data are available at: https://texttron.github.io/AgentIR/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向深度研究智能体的检索新范式，通过利用智能体推理过程中的自然语言线索来提升检索效果。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体正在成为现代检索系统的主要用户，它们会在每次搜索调用前生成显式的自然语言推理过程，这些推理包含了丰富的意图和上下文信息，但现有的检索系统完全忽略了这些信号。
AI.method: 提出了两个核心组件：1) 推理感知检索：一种将智能体的推理轨迹与其查询联合嵌入的检索范式；2) DR-Synth：一种从标准QA数据集生成深度研究检索器训练数据的数据合成方法。
AI.result: 两个组件各自都有效，组合后训练出的嵌入模型AgentIR-4B取得了显著提升。在具有挑战性的BrowseComp-Plus基准测试中，AgentIR-4B与开源智能体Tongyi-DeepResearch配合达到68%的准确率，而传统嵌入模型（尺寸是其两倍）只有50%，BM25只有37%。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用深度研究智能体的推理信号，可以显著提升检索性能，这为智能体时代的检索系统设计提供了新的方向。

title: Degradation-based augmented training for robust individual animal re-identification
summary: Wildlife re-identification aims to recognise individual animals by matching query images to a database of previously identified individuals, based on their fine-scale unique morphological characteristics. Current state-of-the-art models for multispecies re- identification are based on deep metric learning representing individual identities by fea- ture vectors in an embedding space, the similarity of which forms the basis for a fast automated identity retrieval. Yet very often, the discriminative information of individual wild animals gets significantly reduced due to the presence of several degradation factors in images, leading to reduced retrieval performance and limiting the downstream eco- logical studies. Here, starting by showing that the extent of this performance reduction greatly varies depending on the animal species (18 wild animal datasets), we introduce an augmented training framework for deep feature extractors, where we apply artificial but diverse degradations in images in the training set. We show that applying this augmented training only to a subset of individuals, leads to an overall increased re-identification performance, under the same type of degradations, even for individuals not seen during training. The introduction of diverse degradations during training leads to a gain of up to 8.5% Rank-1 accuracy to a dataset of real-world degraded animal images, selected using human re-ID expert annotations provided here for the first time. Our work is the first to systematically study image degradation in wildlife re-identification, while introducing all the necessary benchmarks, publicly available code and data, enabling further research on this topic.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对野生动物重识别中图像退化问题，提出了一种增强训练框架，通过在训练图像中应用人工但多样化的退化处理，显著提升了在退化条件下的重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 野生动物重识别依赖于个体独特的形态特征，但在实际应用中，图像退化因素（如模糊、遮挡、光照变化等）会显著降低识别性能，限制了生态研究的应用。目前缺乏对图像退化问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出增强训练框架，在训练集中对部分个体的图像应用人工但多样化的退化处理。使用18个野生动物数据集，首次提供人类重识别专家标注的真实退化图像数据集，并建立相关基准。
AI.result: 增强训练框架即使在训练中未见的个体上也能提高重识别性能，在真实退化图像数据集上获得了高达8.5%的Rank-1准确率提升。首次系统研究了野生动物重识别中的图像退化问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入多样化的图像退化增强训练，可以有效提升野生动物重识别系统在退化条件下的鲁棒性。该研究为后续相关研究提供了基准、公开代码和数据，填补了该领域的研究空白。

title: PlaneCycle: Training-Free 2D-to-3D Lifting of Foundation Models Without Adapters
summary: Large-scale 2D foundation models exhibit strong transferable representations, yet extending them to 3D volumetric data typically requires retraining, adapters, or architectural redesign. We introduce PlaneCycle, a training-free, adapter-free operator for architecture-agnostic 2D-to-3D lifting of foundation models. PlaneCycle reuses the original pretrained 2D backbone by cyclically distributing spatial aggregation across orthogonal HW, DW, and DH planes throughout network depth, enabling progressive 3D fusion while preserving pretrained inductive biases. The method introduces no additional parameters and is applicable to arbitrary 2D networks. Using pretrained DINOv3 models, we evaluate PlaneCycle on six 3D classification and three 3D segmentation benchmarks. Without any training, the lifted models exhibit intrinsic 3D fusion capability and, under linear probing, outperform slice-wise 2D baselines and strong 3D counterparts, approaching the performance of fully trained models. With full fine-tuning, PlaneCycle matches standard 3D architectures, highlighting its potential as a seamless and practical 2D-to-3D lifting operator. These results demonstrate that 3D capability can be unlocked from pretrained 2D foundation models without structural modification or retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/HINTLab/PlaneCycle.

AI.tldr: PlaneCycle是一种无需训练、无需适配器的架构无关2D到3D提升算子，通过循环聚合正交平面实现3D融合，保持预训练参数和归纳偏置，在3D分类和分割任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 大规模2D基础模型具有强大的可迁移表示能力，但将其扩展到3D体数据通常需要重新训练、适配器或架构重新设计。作者希望找到一种无需训练或修改架构就能将2D基础模型提升到3D的方法。
AI.method: PlaneCycle通过在网络深度上循环分布在正交HW、DW和DH平面上的空间聚合，实现渐进式3D融合。该方法不引入额外参数，适用于任意2D网络，重用原始预训练2D骨干网络。
AI.result: 使用预训练的DINOv3模型，在六个3D分类和三个3D分割基准测试上评估。无需任何训练，提升后的模型展现出内在的3D融合能力，在线性探测中优于切片式2D基线和强3D对应模型，接近完全训练模型的性能。通过完全微调，PlaneCycle匹配标准3D架构。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无需结构修改或重新训练，就可以从预训练的2D基础模型中解锁3D能力。PlaneCycle作为一种无缝且实用的2D到3D提升算子具有巨大潜力。

title: Real5-OmniDocBench: A Full-Scale Physical Reconstruction Benchmark for Robust Document Parsing in the Wild
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve near-perfect scores on digital document benchmarks like OmniDocBench, their performance in the unpredictable physical world remains largely unknown due to the lack of controlled yet realistic evaluations. We introduce Real5-OmniDocBench, the first benchmark that performs a full-scale, one-to-one physical reconstruction of the entire OmniDocBench v1.5 (1,355 images) across five critical real-world scenarios: Scanning, Warping, Screen-Photography, Illumination, and Skew. Unlike prior benchmark that either lack digital correspondence or employ partial sampling, our complete ground-truth mapping enables, for the first time, rigorous factor-wise attribution of performance degradation-allowing us to pinpoint whether failures stem from geometric distortions, optical artifacts, or model limitations. Our benchmark establishes a challenging new standard for the community, demonstrating that the 'reality gap' in document parsing is far from closed, and provides a diagnostic tool to guide the development of truly resilient document intelligence.

AI.tldr: Real5-OmniDocBench是首个对OmniDocBench v1.5进行完整物理重建的基准测试，包含扫描、扭曲、屏幕摄影、光照和倾斜五种现实场景，揭示了VLMs在物理世界中的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 虽然视觉语言模型在数字文档基准测试中表现优异，但它们在不可预测的物理世界中的性能仍然未知，缺乏受控但现实的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建Real5-OmniDocBench基准，对OmniDocBench v1.5的1,355张图像进行完整的一对一物理重建，涵盖五种关键现实场景：扫描、扭曲、屏幕摄影、光照和倾斜。
AI.result: 该基准建立了具有挑战性的新标准，表明文档解析中的"现实差距"远未消除，并提供了诊断工具来指导真正弹性的文档智能系统开发。
AI.conclusion: 通过完整的真实映射，首次能够严格归因性能下降的原因，确定失败是源于几何失真、光学伪影还是模型限制，为社区提供了重要的评估工具。

title: DiverseDiT: Towards Diverse Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
comment: To appear in CVPR 2026, GitHub Code: https://github.com/kobeshegu/DiverseDiT, Project Page: https://forevermamba.work/projects/DiverseDiT/
summary: Recent breakthroughs in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have revolutionized the field of visual synthesis due to their superior scalability. To facilitate DiTs' capability of capturing meaningful internal representations, recent works such as REPA incorporate external pretrained encoders for representation alignment. However, the underlying mechanisms governing representation learning within DiTs are not well understood. To this end, we first systematically investigate the representation dynamics of DiTs. Through analyzing the evolution and influence of internal representations under various settings, we reveal that representation diversity across blocks is a crucial factor for effective learning. Based on this key insight, we propose DiverseDiT, a novel framework that explicitly promotes representation diversity. DiverseDiT incorporates long residual connections to diversify input representations across blocks and a representation diversity loss to encourage blocks to learn distinct features. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 and 512x512 demonstrate that our DiverseDiT yields consistent performance gains and convergence acceleration when applied to different backbones with various sizes, even when tested on the challenging one-step generation setting. Furthermore, we show that DiverseDiT is complementary to existing representation learning techniques, leading to further performance gains. Our work provides valuable insights into the representation learning dynamics of DiTs and offers a practical approach for enhancing their performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DiverseDiT框架，通过促进扩散变换器内部表征多样性来提升性能，包括长残差连接和表征多样性损失，在ImageNet上实现性能提升和收敛加速。
AI.motivation: 虽然扩散变换器在视觉合成领域取得突破，但其内部表征学习机制尚不明确。现有方法如REPA依赖外部预训练编码器进行表征对齐，但缺乏对DiTs内部表征动态的理解。作者旨在系统研究DiTs的表征动态，揭示表征多样性的重要性。
AI.method: 首先系统分析DiTs在不同设置下的内部表征演化和影响，发现跨块的表征多样性是有效学习的关键因素。基于此提出DiverseDiT框架：1）引入长残差连接以多样化跨块的输入表征；2）设计表征多样性损失以鼓励各块学习不同的特征。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256和512×512上的大量实验表明，DiverseDiT在不同大小和架构的骨干网络上均能带来一致的性能提升和收敛加速，即使在具有挑战性的一步生成设置下也有效。此外，DiverseDiT与现有表征学习技术互补，能带来进一步的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作深入揭示了扩散变换器的表征学习动态，并提供了增强其性能的实用方法。DiverseDiT通过促进内部表征多样性，为理解DiTs工作机制提供了新视角，并为视觉合成任务提供了有效的改进方案。

title: DeNuC: Decoupling Nuclei Detection and Classification in Histopathology
summary: Pathology Foundation Models (FMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of pathology image representation and diagnostic tasks. However, FMs do not exhibit the expected performance advantage over traditional specialized models in Nuclei Detection and Classification (NDC). In this work, we reveal that jointly optimizing nuclei detection and classification leads to severe representation degradation in FMs. Moreover, we identify that the substantial intrinsic disparity in task difficulty between nuclei detection and nuclei classification renders joint NDC optimization unnecessarily computationally burdensome for the detection stage. To address these challenges, we propose DeNuC, a simple yet effective method designed to break through existing bottlenecks by Decoupling Nuclei detection and Classification. DeNuC employs a lightweight model for accurate nuclei localization, subsequently leveraging a pathology FM to encode input images and query nucleus-specific features based on the detected coordinates for classification. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks demonstrate that DeNuC effectively unlocks the representational potential of FMs for NDC and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, DeNuC improves F1 scores by 4.2% and 3.6% (or higher) on the BRCAM2C and PUMA datasets, respectively, while using only 16% (or fewer) trainable parameters compared to other methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/DeNuC.

AI.tldr: DeNuC方法通过解耦细胞核检测与分类，解决了病理基础模型在联合优化时出现的表示退化问题，显著提升了性能并减少了计算负担。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在细胞核检测与分类任务中并未展现出预期的性能优势，研究发现联合优化会导致表示退化，且检测与分类任务难度差异大导致计算负担过重。
AI.method: 提出DeNuC方法，使用轻量级模型进行细胞核精确定位，然后利用病理基础模型编码输入图像，基于检测坐标查询细胞核特定特征进行分类，实现检测与分类的解耦。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的基准测试中，DeNuC显著优于现有方法，在BRCAM2C和PUMA数据集上分别提升F1分数4.2%和3.6%以上，同时仅使用其他方法16%或更少的可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: DeNuC有效释放了病理基础模型在细胞核检测与分类任务中的表示潜力，通过解耦策略解决了联合优化的瓶颈问题，实现了性能提升和计算效率的优化。

title: Pointer-CAD: Unifying B-Rep and Command Sequences via Pointer-based Edges & Faces Selection
summary: Constructing computer-aided design (CAD) models is labor-intensive but essential for engineering and manufacturing. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have inspired the LLM-based CAD generation by representing CAD as command sequences. But these methods struggle in practical scenarios because command sequence representation does not support entity selection (e.g. faces or edges), limiting its ability to support complex editing operations such as chamfer or fillet. Further, the discretization of a continuous variable during sketch and extrude operations may result in topological errors. To address these limitations, we present Pointer-CAD, a novel LLM-based CAD generation framework that leverages a pointer-based command sequence representation to explicitly incorporate the geometric information of B-rep models into sequential modeling. In particular, Pointer-CAD decomposes CAD model generation into steps, conditioning the generation of each subsequent step on both the textual description and the B-rep generated from previous steps. Whenever an operation requires the selection of a specific geometric entity, the LLM predicts a Pointer that selects the most feature-consistent candidate from the available set. Such a selection operation also reduces the quantization error in the command sequence-based representation. To support the training of Pointer-CAD, we develop a data annotation pipeline that produces expert-level natural language descriptions and apply it to build a dataset of approximately 575K CAD models. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Pointer-CAD effectively supports the generation of complex geometric structures and reduces segmentation error to an extremely low level, achieving a significant improvement over prior command sequence methods, thereby significantly mitigating the topological inaccuracies introduced by quantization error.

AI.tldr: Pointer-CAD是一种基于大语言模型的CAD生成框架，通过指针机制解决传统命令序列方法无法选择几何实体和量化误差的问题，显著提升了复杂几何结构的生成能力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于LLM的CAD生成方法使用命令序列表示，存在两个主要问题：1）不支持几何实体（如面、边）的选择，限制了复杂编辑操作（如倒角、圆角）的能力；2）在草图拉伸等操作中对连续变量的离散化会导致拓扑错误。
AI.method: 提出Pointer-CAD框架，采用基于指针的命令序列表示，将几何信息显式纳入序列建模。框架将CAD模型生成分解为步骤，每个后续步骤的生成都基于文本描述和先前步骤生成的B-rep模型。当操作需要选择特定几何实体时，LLM预测指针从可用集合中选择最特征一致的候选，这种选择操作也减少了基于命令序列表示的量化误差。
AI.result: 构建了约57.5万个CAD模型的数据集，实验结果表明Pointer-CAD有效支持复杂几何结构的生成，将分割误差降至极低水平，相比先前命令序列方法有显著改进，显著减轻了量化误差引入的拓扑不准确性。
AI.conclusion: Pointer-CAD通过指针机制解决了传统LLM-based CAD生成方法的局限性，能够有效处理几何实体选择和量化误差问题，为复杂CAD模型的生成提供了更强大的框架。

title: TaxonRL: Reinforcement Learning with Intermediate Rewards for Interpretable Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
summary: Traditional vision-language models struggle with contrastive fine-grained taxonomic reasoning, particularly when distinguishing between visually similar species within the same genus or family. We introduce TaxonRL, a reinforcement learning approach using Group Relative Policy Optimization with intermediate rewards that decomposes the reasoning process into hierarchical taxonomic predictions. Our method incentivizes models to explicitly reason about species-level, genus-level, and family-level features before making final classifications. This structured approach is designed not only to boost accuracy but also to yield a transparent, verifiable decision-making process. On the challenging Birds-to-Words dataset, TaxonRL achieves 91.7\% average accuracy, exceeding human performance (77.3\%) while generating interpretable reasoning traces. We demonstrate strong cross-domain generalization, showing substantial gains in primate and marine species verification. Our results establish that enforcing structured, hierarchical reasoning provides a powerful and transferable framework for fine-grained visual discrimination.

AI.tldr: TaxonRL使用强化学习方法，通过分层分类预测和中间奖励机制，解决了传统视觉语言模型在细粒度分类推理中的困难，在鸟类识别任务上超越了人类表现。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉语言模型在处理对比性细粒度分类推理时存在困难，特别是在区分同一属或同一科中视觉相似物种时表现不佳。需要一种能够进行透明、可验证推理的方法。
AI.method: 提出TaxonRL方法，采用强化学习框架，使用Group Relative Policy Optimization和中间奖励机制，将推理过程分解为分层分类预测（物种级、属级、科级），激励模型在最终分类前显式推理各层次特征。
AI.result: 在Birds-to-Words数据集上达到91.7%的平均准确率，超越人类表现（77.3%），并生成可解释的推理轨迹。在灵长类和海洋物种验证任务中表现出强大的跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 强制结构化分层推理为细粒度视觉识别提供了一个强大且可迁移的框架，不仅提高了准确性，还提供了透明、可验证的决策过程。

title: ViterbiPlanNet: Injecting Procedural Knowledge via Differentiable Viterbi for Planning in Instructional Videos
summary: Procedural planning aims to predict a sequence of actions that transforms an initial visual state into a desired goal, a fundamental ability for intelligent agents operating in complex environments. Existing approaches typically rely on large-scale models that learn procedural structures implicitly, resulting in limited sample-efficiency and high computational cost. In this work we introduce ViterbiPlanNet, a principled framework that explicitly integrates procedural knowledge into the learning process through a Differentiable Viterbi Layer (DVL). The DVL embeds a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) directly with the Viterbi decoding algorithm, replacing non-differentiable operations with smooth relaxations that enable end-to-end optimization. This design allows the model to learn through graph-based decoding. Experiments on CrossTask, COIN, and NIV demonstrate that ViterbiPlanNet achieves state-of-the-art performance with an order of magnitude fewer parameters than diffusion- and LLM-based planners. Extensive ablations show that performance gains arise from our differentiable structure-aware training rather than post-hoc refinement, resulting in improved sample efficiency and robustness to shorter unseen horizons. We also address testing inconsistencies establishing a unified testing protocol with consistent splits and evaluation metrics. With this new protocol, we run experiments multiple times and report results using bootstrapping to assess statistical significance.

AI.tldr: ViterbiPlanNet是一个将程序知识显式集成到学习过程中的框架，通过可微分Viterbi层嵌入程序知识图，实现端到端优化，在参数少一个数量级的情况下达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有程序规划方法通常依赖大规模模型隐式学习程序结构，导致样本效率有限且计算成本高。需要一种能显式整合程序知识、提高样本效率和降低计算成本的方法。
AI.method: 提出ViterbiPlanNet框架，包含可微分Viterbi层，将程序知识图直接嵌入Viterbi解码算法，用平滑松弛替换不可微分操作，实现端到端优化，支持基于图的解码学习。
AI.result: 在CrossTask、COIN和NIV数据集上达到最先进性能，参数比基于扩散和LLM的规划器少一个数量级。消融实验表明性能提升来自可微分结构感知训练而非后处理细化，提高了样本效率和未见较短时间范围的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ViterbiPlanNet通过显式整合程序知识，提供了一种高效、轻量级的程序规划方法，同时建立了统一的测试协议以确保结果可比性和统计显著性评估。

title: SSR: A Generic Framework for Text-Aided Map Compression for Localization
summary: Mapping is crucial in robotics for localization and downstream decision-making. As robots are deployed in ever-broader settings, the maps they rely on continue to increase in size. However, storing these maps indefinitely (cold storage), transferring them across networks, or sending localization queries to cloud-hosted maps imposes prohibitive memory and bandwidth costs. We propose a text-enhanced compression framework that reduces both memory and bandwidth footprints while retaining high-fidelity localization. The key idea is to treat text as an alternative modality: one that can be losslessly compressed with large language models. We propose leveraging lightweight text descriptions combined with very small image feature vectors, which capture "complementary information" as a compact representation for the mapping task. Building on this, our novel technique, Similarity Space Replication (SSR), learns an adaptive image embedding in one shot that captures only the information "complementary" to the text descriptions. We validate our compression framework on multiple downstream localization tasks, including Visual Place Recognition as well as object-centric Monte Carlo localization in both indoor and outdoor settings. SSR achieves 2 times better compression than competing baselines on state-of-the-art datasets, including TokyoVal, Pittsburgh30k, Replica, and KITTI.

AI.tldr: 提出文本增强压缩框架，通过文本描述和小图像特征向量实现地图压缩，减少存储和带宽成本，同时保持高保真定位能力
AI.motivation: 随着机器人部署场景扩大，地图尺寸不断增加，长期存储、网络传输和云端查询带来巨大的内存和带宽成本，需要高效的压缩方案
AI.method: 提出文本增强压缩框架，将文本视为替代模态，结合轻量级文本描述和微小图像特征向量作为紧凑表示；创新性地提出相似性空间复制（SSR）技术，一次性学习自适应图像嵌入，仅捕获与文本描述"互补"的信息
AI.result: 在多个下游定位任务（包括视觉地点识别和室内外物体中心蒙特卡洛定位）中验证，在TokyoVal、Pittsburgh30k、Replica和KITTI等数据集上，SSR比竞争基线实现2倍更好的压缩效果
AI.conclusion: 文本增强压缩框架能显著减少地图的内存和带宽占用，同时保持高保真定位性能，为大规模机器人部署提供实用的地图压缩解决方案

title: CubeComposer: Spatio-Temporal Autoregressive 4K 360° Video Generation from Perspective Video
summary: Generating high-quality 360° panoramic videos from perspective input is one of the crucial applications for virtual reality (VR), whereby high-resolution videos are especially important for immersive experience. Existing methods are constrained by computational limitations of vanilla diffusion models, only supporting $\leq$ 1K resolution native generation and relying on suboptimal post super-resolution to increase resolution. We introduce CubeComposer, a novel spatio-temporal autoregressive diffusion model that natively generates 4K-resolution 360° videos. By decomposing videos into cubemap representations with six faces, CubeComposer autoregressively synthesizes content in a well-planned spatio-temporal order, reducing memory demands while enabling high-resolution output. Specifically, to address challenges in multi-dimensional autoregression, we propose: (1) a spatio-temporal autoregressive strategy that orchestrates 360° video generation across cube faces and time windows for coherent synthesis; (2) a cube face context management mechanism, equipped with a sparse context attention design to improve efficiency; and (3) continuity-aware techniques, including cube-aware positional encoding, padding, and blending to eliminate boundary seams. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CubeComposer outperforms state-of-the-art methods in native resolution and visual quality, supporting practical VR application scenarios. Project page: https://lg-li.github.io/project/cubecomposer

AI.tldr: CubeComposer是一个新颖的时空自回归扩散模型，能够原生生成4K分辨率的360°全景视频，通过立方体贴图表示和创新的时空自回归策略解决高分辨率生成的内存限制问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法受限于普通扩散模型的计算限制，只能支持≤1K分辨率原生生成，并依赖次优的后处理超分辨率技术来提高分辨率。高质量、高分辨率的360°全景视频对于虚拟现实沉浸体验至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 将视频分解为六个面的立方体贴图表示；2) 采用时空自回归策略，在立方体面和时间窗口上有序合成内容；3) 提出立方体面上下文管理机制，配备稀疏上下文注意力设计提高效率；4) 采用连续性感知技术，包括立方体感知位置编码、填充和混合来消除边界接缝。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，CubeComposer在原生分辨率和视觉质量方面优于现有最先进方法，支持实际的VR应用场景。
AI.conclusion: CubeComposer通过创新的立方体贴图表示和时空自回归扩散模型，成功实现了原生4K分辨率360°视频生成，解决了高分辨率全景视频生成的内存和计算挑战，为VR应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: MOO: A Multi-view Oriented Observations Dataset for Viewpoint Analysis in Cattle Re-Identification
summary: Animal re-identification (ReID) faces critical challenges due to viewpoint variations, particularly in Aerial-Ground (AG-ReID) settings where models must match individuals across drastic elevation changes. However, existing datasets lack the precise angular annotations required to systematically analyze these geometric variations. To address this, we introduce the Multi-view Oriented Observation (MOO) dataset, a large-scale synthetic AG-ReID dataset of $1,000$ cattle individuals captured from $128$ uniformly sampled viewpoints ($128,000$ annotated images). Using this controlled dataset, we quantify the influence of elevation and identify a critical elevation threshold, above which models generalize significantly better to unseen views. Finally, we validate the transferability to real-world applications in both zero-shot and supervised settings, demonstrating performance gains across four real-world cattle datasets and confirming that synthetic geometric priors effectively bridge the domain gap. Collectively, this dataset and analysis lay the foundation for future model development in cross-view animal ReID. MOO is publicly available at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/MOO.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了MOO数据集，一个包含1000头牛、128个均匀采样视角的大规模合成空中-地面动物重识别数据集，用于系统分析视角变化对模型性能的影响，并发现了关键的高程阈值。
AI.motivation: 动物重识别面临视角变化的重大挑战，特别是在空中-地面场景中，模型需要在剧烈高程变化下匹配个体。现有数据集缺乏精确的角度标注，无法系统分析这些几何变化的影响。
AI.method: 构建MOO合成数据集，包含1000头牛的128个均匀采样视角（共128,000张标注图像）。使用该受控数据集量化高程影响，识别关键高程阈值，并在零样本和监督设置下验证向真实世界应用的迁移性。
AI.result: 发现了一个关键的高程阈值，超过该阈值后模型对未见视角的泛化能力显著提升。在四个真实世界牛数据集上验证了性能提升，证明合成几何先验能有效弥合领域差距。
AI.conclusion: MOO数据集和分析为跨视角动物重识别未来模型开发奠定了基础，合成几何先验能有效提升模型在真实世界应用中的性能。

title: Gaussian Wardrobe: Compositional 3D Gaussian Avatars for Free-Form Virtual Try-On
summary: We introduce Gaussian Wardrobe, a novel framework to digitalize compositional 3D neural avatars from multi-view videos. Existing methods for 3D neural avatars typically treat the human body and clothing as an inseparable entity. However, this paradigm fails to capture the dynamics of complex free-form garments and limits the reuse of clothing across different individuals. To overcome these problems, we develop a novel, compositional 3D Gaussian representation to build avatars from multiple layers of free-form garments. The core of our method is decomposing neural avatars into bodies and layers of shape-agnostic neural garments. To achieve this, our framework learns to disentangle each garment layer from multi-view videos and canonicalizes it into a shape-independent space. In experiments, our method models photorealistic avatars with high-fidelity dynamics, achieving new state-of-the-art performance on novel pose synthesis benchmarks. In addition, we demonstrate that the learned compositional garments contribute to a versatile digital wardrobe, enabling a practical virtual try-on application where clothing can be freely transferred to new subjects. Project page: https://ait.ethz.ch/gaussianwardrobe

AI.tldr: Gaussian Wardrobe提出了一种从多视角视频数字化组合式3D神经化身的新框架，将人体和服装分离为可组合的层次结构，实现服装在不同个体间的复用。
AI.motivation: 现有3D神经化身方法通常将人体和服装视为不可分割的整体，这无法捕捉复杂自由形态服装的动态特性，也限制了服装在不同个体间的复用。
AI.method: 开发了一种新颖的组合式3D高斯表示，将神经化身分解为身体和多个形状无关的神经服装层，通过从多视角视频中解耦每个服装层并将其规范化为形状独立空间。
AI.result: 在实验中，该方法能够建模具有高保真动态的逼真化身，在新姿势合成基准测试中达到了新的最先进性能。学习到的组合式服装构成了多功能数字衣橱，实现了服装在不同主体间自由转移的虚拟试穿应用。
AI.conclusion: Gaussian Wardrobe框架成功解决了现有方法在服装动态建模和跨个体服装复用方面的限制，为数字服装的创建和应用提供了新的可能性。

title: SPRINT: Semi-supervised Prototypical Representation for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Tabular Learning
summary: Real-world systems must continuously adapt to novel concepts from limited data without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. While Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) is established in computer vision, its application to tabular domains remains largely unexplored. Unlike images, tabular streams (e.g., logs, sensors) offer abundant unlabeled data, a scarcity of expert annotations and negligible storage costs, features ignored by existing vision-based methods that rely on restrictive buffers. We introduce SPRINT, the first FSCIL framework tailored for tabular distributions. SPRINT introduces a mixed episodic training strategy that leverages confidence-based pseudo-labeling to enrich novel class representations and exploits low storage costs to retain base class history. Extensive evaluation across six diverse benchmarks spanning cybersecurity, healthcare, and ecological domains, demonstrates SPRINT's cross-domain robustness. It achieves a state-of-the-art average accuracy of 77.37% (5-shot), outperforming the strongest incremental baseline by 4.45%.

AI.tldr: SPRINT是首个针对表格数据的少样本类增量学习框架，通过置信度伪标注和低存储成本保留历史数据，在6个跨领域基准测试中达到77.37%的平均准确率
AI.motivation: 现实系统需要从有限数据中持续适应新概念而不遗忘已有知识。虽然少样本类增量学习在计算机视觉领域已建立，但在表格领域（如日志、传感器数据）的应用仍未被探索。表格数据流具有丰富的未标注数据、稀缺的专家标注和可忽略的存储成本，这些特性被现有视觉方法忽略
AI.method: SPRINT采用混合情景训练策略：1）利用置信度伪标注来丰富新类表示；2）利用低存储成本优势保留基类历史数据；3）专门针对表格分布设计
AI.result: 在网络安全、医疗健康和生态学等6个多样化基准测试中，SPRINT展现了跨领域鲁棒性，在5-shot设置下达到77.37%的平均准确率，比最强的增量基线高出4.45%
AI.conclusion: SPRINT是首个针对表格数据的少样本类增量学习框架，通过有效利用表格数据特性（未标注数据丰富、存储成本低），在跨领域应用中实现了最先进的性能，为表格数据流的持续学习提供了有效解决方案

title: Motion Manipulation via Unsupervised Keypoint Positioning in Face Animation
summary: Face animation deals with controlling and generating facial features with a wide range of applications. The methods based on unsupervised keypoint positioning can produce realistic and detailed virtual portraits. However, they cannot achieve controllable face generation since the existing keypoint decomposition pipelines fail to fully decouple identity semantics and intertwined motion information (e.g., rotation, translation, and expression). To address these issues, we present a new method, Motion Manipulation via unsupervised keypoint positioning in Face Animation (MMFA). We first introduce self-supervised representation learning to encode and decode expressions in the latent feature space and decouple them from other motion information. Secondly, we propose a new way to compute keypoints aiming to achieve arbitrary motion control. Moreover, we design a variational autoencoder to map expression features to a continuous Gaussian distribution, allowing us for the first time to interpolate facial expressions in an unsupervised framework. We have conducted extensive experiments on publicly available datasets to validate the effectiveness of MMFA, which show that MMFA offers pronounced advantages over prior arts in creating realistic animation and manipulating face motion.

AI.tldr: MMFA提出了一种基于无监督关键点定位的面部动画新方法，通过自监督表示学习和变分自编码器实现身份语义与运动信息的解耦，能够实现可控的面部运动生成和表情插值。
AI.motivation: 现有基于无监督关键点定位的方法虽然能生成逼真的虚拟肖像，但无法实现可控的面部生成，因为现有的关键点分解流程未能完全解耦身份语义和交织的运动信息（如旋转、平移和表情）。
AI.method: 1. 引入自监督表示学习来编码和解码潜在特征空间中的表情，并将其与其他运动信息解耦；2. 提出新的关键点计算方法以实现任意运动控制；3. 设计变分自编码器将表情特征映射到连续高斯分布，实现无监督框架下的表情插值。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的广泛实验验证了MMFA的有效性，表明MMFA在创建逼真动画和操纵面部运动方面比现有技术具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: MMFA通过创新的无监督关键点定位方法成功解决了面部动画中身份语义与运动信息的解耦问题，首次实现了无监督框架下的表情插值，为可控面部动画生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: RANGER: Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Retrieval Re-ranking for Pathology Report Generation
summary: Pathology report generation remains a relatively under-explored downstream task, primarily due to the gigapixel scale and complex morphological heterogeneity of Whole Slide Images (WSIs). Existing pathology report generation frameworks typically employ transformer architectures, relying on a homogeneous decoder architecture and static knowledge retrieval integration. Such architectures limit generative specialization and may introduce noisy external guidance during the report generation process. To address these limitations, we propose RANGER, a sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework with adaptive retrieval re-ranking for pathology report generation. Specifically, we integrate a sparsely gated MoE into the decoder, along with noisy top-$k$ routing and load-balancing regularization, to enable dynamic expert specialization across various diagnostic patterns. Additionally, we introduce an adaptive retrieval re-ranking module that selectively refines retrieved memory from a knowledge base before integration, reducing noise and improving semantic alignment based on visual feature representations. We perform extensive experiments on the PathText-BRCA dataset and demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches across standard natural language generation metrics. Our full RANGER model achieves optimal performance on PathText dataset, reaching BLEU-1 to BLEU-4 scores of 0.4598, 0.3044, 0.2036, and 0.1435, respectively, with METEOR of 0.1883, and ROUGE-L of 0.3038, validating the effectiveness of dynamic expert routing and adaptive knowledge refinement for semantically grounded pathology report generation.

AI.tldr: RANGER：一种用于病理报告生成的稀疏门控混合专家框架，通过动态专家路由和自适应检索重排序来提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有病理报告生成框架通常采用同质解码器架构和静态知识检索集成，限制了生成专业化并可能在报告生成过程中引入噪声外部指导。
AI.method: 提出RANGER框架：1）在解码器中集成稀疏门控混合专家机制，采用噪声top-k路由和负载均衡正则化，实现跨不同诊断模式的动态专家专业化；2）引入自适应检索重排序模块，在集成前选择性细化从知识库检索的记忆，基于视觉特征表示减少噪声并改善语义对齐。
AI.result: 在PathText-BRCA数据集上的实验显示，RANGER在标准自然语言生成指标上持续优于现有方法。完整模型在PathText数据集上达到最优性能：BLEU-1至BLEU-4分别为0.4598、0.3044、0.2036、0.1435，METEOR为0.1883，ROUGE-L为0.3038。
AI.conclusion: 动态专家路由和自适应知识细化对于语义基础的病理报告生成是有效的，RANGER框架通过稀疏门控MoE和自适应检索重排序解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: Dual Diffusion Models for Multi-modal Guided 3D Avatar Generation
summary: Generating high-fidelity 3D avatars from text or image prompts is highly sought after in virtual reality and human-computer interaction. However, existing text-driven methods often rely on iterative Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) or CLIP optimization, which struggle with fine-grained semantic control and suffer from excessively slow inference. Meanwhile, image-driven approaches are severely bottlenecked by the scarcity and high acquisition cost of high-quality 3D facial scans, limiting model generalization. To address these challenges, we first construct a novel, large-scale dataset comprising over 100,000 pairs across four modalities: fine-grained textual descriptions, in-the-wild face images, high-quality light-normalized texture UV maps, and 3D geometric shapes. Leveraging this comprehensive dataset, we propose PromptAvatar, a framework featuring dual diffusion models. Specifically, it integrates a Texture Diffusion Model (TDM) that supports flexible multi-condition guidance from text and/or image prompts, alongside a Geometry Diffusion Model (GDM) guided by text prompts. By learning the direct mapping from multi-modal prompts to 3D representations, PromptAvatar eliminates the need for time-consuming iterative optimization, successfully generating high-fidelity, shading-free 3D avatars in under 10 seconds. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in generation quality, fine-grained detail alignment, and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: PromptAvatar是一个从文本/图像提示直接生成高质量3D头像的框架，使用双扩散模型在10秒内生成无阴影的3D头像，无需迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动方法依赖迭代优化，语义控制差且推理慢；图像驱动方法受限于高质量3D面部扫描数据稀缺。需要解决细粒度语义控制、快速推理和数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 首先构建包含10万对多模态数据的大规模数据集（文本描述、野外人脸图像、高质量纹理UV图、3D几何形状）。提出PromptAvatar框架，包含纹理扩散模型（支持文本/图像多条件引导）和几何扩散模型（文本引导），学习从多模态提示到3D表示的直接映射。
AI.result: 方法在10秒内生成高质量无阴影3D头像，无需耗时迭代优化。定量和定性实验表明，在生成质量、细粒度细节对齐和计算效率方面显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: PromptAvatar通过大规模多模态数据集和双扩散模型架构，成功解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了快速、高质量、细粒度可控的3D头像生成。

title: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction with Test-Time Training
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

AI.tldr: ZipMap是一种状态前馈模型，实现线性时间双向3D重建，在保持高质量的同时显著提升计算效率
AI.motivation: 现有前馈transformer模型（如VGGT和π³）的计算成本随输入图像数量呈二次方增长，在处理大规模图像集合时效率低下。顺序重建方法虽然降低了计算成本，但牺牲了重建质量。
AI.method: ZipMap采用测试时训练层，在单次前向传递中将整个图像集合压缩成紧凑的隐藏场景状态，实现线性时间双向3D重建。模型具有状态表示能力，支持实时场景状态查询和顺序流式重建。
AI.result: ZipMap在单个H100 GPU上能在10秒内重建超过700帧，比VGGT等最先进方法快20倍以上，同时匹配或超越了二次方时间方法的精度。
AI.conclusion: ZipMap通过状态前馈模型设计，成功解决了大规模3D重建中的计算效率问题，在保持重建质量的同时实现了线性时间复杂度的突破，为实时3D重建应用提供了新的可能性。

title: Scalable Evaluation of the Realism of Synthetic Environmental Augmentations in Images
summary:
Evaluation of AI systems often requires synthetic test cases, particularly for rare or safety-critical conditions that are difficult to observe in operational data. Generative AI offers a promising approach for producing such data through controllable image editing, but its usefulness depends on whether the resulting images are sufficiently realistic to support meaningful evaluation.
  We present a scalable framework for assessing the realism of synthetic image-editing methods and apply it to the task of adding environmental conditions-fog, rain, snow, and nighttime-to car-mounted camera images. Using 40 clear-day images, we compare rule-based augmentation libraries with generative AI image-editing models. Realism is evaluated using two complementary automated metrics: a vision-language model (VLM) jury for perceptual realism assessment, and embedding-based distributional analysis to measure similarity to genuine adverse-condition imagery.
  Generative AI methods substantially outperform rule-based approaches, with the best generative method achieving approximately 3.6 times the acceptance rate of the best rule-based method. Performance varies across conditions: fog proves easiest to simulate, while nighttime transformations remain challenging. Notably, the VLM jury assigns imperfect acceptance even to real adverse-condition imagery, establishing practical ceilings against which synthetic methods can be judged. By this standard, leading generative methods match or exceed real-image performance for most conditions.
  These results suggest that modern generative image-editing models can enable scalable generation of realistic adverse-condition imagery for evaluation pipelines. Our framework therefore provides a practical approach for scalable realism evaluation, though validation against human studies remains an important direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估合成图像编辑方法真实性的可扩展框架，并将其应用于汽车摄像头图像中添加环境条件（雾、雨、雪、夜间）的任务。研究发现生成式AI方法在真实性方面显著优于基于规则的方法，最佳生成方法达到最佳规则方法约3.6倍的接受率。
AI.motivation: 评估AI系统通常需要合成测试用例，特别是对于难以在操作数据中观察到的罕见或安全关键条件。生成式AI通过可控图像编辑为生成此类数据提供了有前景的方法，但其有效性取决于生成的图像是否足够真实以支持有意义的评估。
AI.method: 使用40张晴天图像，比较基于规则的增强库与生成式AI图像编辑模型。采用两种互补的自动指标评估真实性：1）视觉语言模型（VLM）评审团进行感知真实性评估；2）基于嵌入的分布分析来测量与真实恶劣条件图像的相似性。
AI.result: 生成式AI方法显著优于基于规则的方法，最佳生成方法达到最佳规则方法约3.6倍的接受率。不同条件表现各异：雾最容易模拟，而夜间转换仍然具有挑战性。值得注意的是，VLM评审团对真实恶劣条件图像也给出不完全接受，这为评估合成方法建立了实际基准。按此标准，领先的生成方法在大多数条件下达到或超过真实图像性能。
AI.conclusion: 现代生成式图像编辑模型能够为评估流程实现可扩展的真实恶劣条件图像生成。该框架提供了实用的可扩展真实性评估方法，但未来工作仍需通过人类研究进行验证。

title: Hold-One-Shot-Out (HOSO) for Validation-Free Few-Shot CLIP Adapters
summary: In many CLIP adaptation methods, a blending ratio hyperparameter controls the trade-off between general pretrained CLIP knowledge and the limited, dataset-specific supervision from the few-shot cases. Most few-shot CLIP adaptation techniques report results by ablation of the blending ratio on the test set or require additional validation sets to select the blending ratio per dataset, and thus are not strictly few-shot. We present a simple, validation-free method for learning the blending ratio in CLIP adaptation. Hold-One-Shot-Out (HOSO) presents a novel approach for CLIP-Adapter-style methods to compete in the newly established validation-free setting. CLIP-Adapter with HOSO (HOSO-Adapter) learns the blending ratio using a one-shot, hold-out set, while the adapter trains on the remaining few-shot support examples.
